The 's-Gravendijkwal is part of the tunnel crossing and the urban route S100 Centrumring, and lies between the 1st Middellandstraat and the Westzeedijk. The 's-Gravendijkwal is part of the urban planning plan that Gerrit J. de Jongh, director of Gemeentewe, has prepared.

The Eerste Petroleumhaven was dug between 1929 and 1933 and designed for the supply of crude oil for the refinery of Koninklijke Olie (Shell). Shell had started at the Sluisjesdijk in the Waalhaven area.

name: 1e Werkhaven

The bridge dating from 1901 has two spans and was designed by the Department of Municipal Works under the direction of F.J. Nieuwenhuis.

The bridge is only operated on request, not on Sundays.

en: The Boerengatbrug is a bascule bridge in the Maasboulevard in the Dutch city of Rotterdam. The bridge warden operates multiple bridges, which can cause waiting times.

name: Boezem
en: The Boezem is a river in Rotterdam, in the Dutch province of South Holland. It forms the connection between the Rotte and the Nieuwe Maas. Due to the drying works north of Rotterdam, an increasing number of polders were discharged into the Rotte.

name: Boezemsingelkerk
en: The Boezemsingelkerk is a church building of the Reformed Churches on Boezemsingel in the center of Rotterdam. The previous church was opened on March 31, 1901. Due to declining church attendance and the poor state of disrepair, this old church was demolished in 2018. In 2019, a new, smaller church building was put into use.

en: The Monument Bombardement Alexanderkazerne is a war monument along the Oude Waalsdorperweg in The Hague, which keeps alive the memory of 66 Dutch military personnel who died during a German bombing of 1940 on the Alexanderkazerne on May 10.

name: Boompjes

Each year, 250 PCTCs (Pure Car Transport Carriers) arrive here with cars on board, which are then distributed throughout Europe by train and road transport from here.

name: Brug 98
en: Brug 98 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge is located on the eastern quay of the Lijnbaansgracht and crosses the Passeerdersgracht.

name: Brug met de twaalf gaten
en: The Brug met de twaalf gaten is a nationally protected former bridge in the Dutch city of Utrecht. The bridge once belonged to the now almost disappeared Fort Vossegat. This fort rose around 1818 just southeast of that city in the New Holland Water Line. The bridge was built in 1862 in brick and also served as an inundation sluice.

name: Buchenwald Memorial
en: The Buchenwald monument is a monument placed on De Nieuwe Ooster cemetery. The monument, in the form of a gravestone, was unveiled on October 26, 1955. name: Buiksloterdraaibrug
en: The Buiksloterdraaibrug (number 2205) is a structure in Amsterdam-Noord.

name: Buiksloterkanaal
en: The Buiksloterkanaal in Amsterdam-North is the connection between the (western part of the) Johan van Hasselt Canal and the IJ. The canal with north-south orientation lies between Buiksloterham in the west and Volewijck in the east. The canal was dug in 1926 in the polder Buiksloterham.

name: Buiksloterkerk
en: The Buiksloterkerk is the (former) village church of the dike village Buiksloot in Amsterdam-Noord. The church building is not along the Buiksloterdijk, but slightly lower on the Buiksloterkerkpad. The church is located nationally and is surrounded by a cemetery. The building was included in the register of national monuments in 1970.

name: Buitenhaven
en: The Buitenhaven of Vlaardingen is located south of the Delflandse Buitensluis and runs to the Nieuwe Maas, with which the port is in open connection. North of the Buitenhaven is the Oude Haven. name: Buitenveldertselaan
en: The Buitenveldertselaan is a street in Amsterdam by Buitenveldert that connects the Zuid district with Amstelveen.

name: Buizengat
en: The Buizengat in the east of Rotterdam is a harbor dating back to 1699. The Buizengat is located east of the Boerengat (excavated in 1591) and is also connected to the Nieuwe Maas via a sluice canal. name: Bullebak
en: The Bullebak, bridge 149, is a double bascule bridge in Amsterdam over the Brouwersgracht, which connects the Marnixkade, the Marnixstraat with the Korte Marnixstraat at the level of the Marnixkade. The bridge is made of wood, steel, brick and concrete.

name: Bullebaksluis
en: The Bullebakssluis (bridge number 160) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is a different bridge from De Bullebak, further along the Marnixstraat.

name: Bullewijkpadbrug
en: The Bullewijkpadbrug (bridge 1083) is a structure from 1981 in Amsterdam-Zuid. It has been the only existing bridge in the series 1080-1089 since the construction of the Gaasperdammertunnel. The design for the bridge in the form of a viaduct came from Dirk Sterenberg working at the Department of Public Works.

name: Burgemeester Cramergracht
en: The Burgemeester Cramergracht is a canal and a street running parallel to it in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The canal was named in 1952 and was named after Willem Daniël Cramer (1788-1856), mayor of Amsterdam from 1836 to 1841.

name: Burgemeester De Vlugtlaan
en: The Burgemeester De Vlugtlaan is a street in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The street was named in 1952 after Willem de Vlugt (1872-1945), mayor of Amsterdam from 1921 to 1941, when he was removed from office after the February Strike.

name: Burgemeester Eliasstraat
en: The Burgemeester Eliasstraat is a street in Amsterdam Nieuw-West, located in the Slotermeer Zuid neighborhood. The Burgemeester Eliasstraat is located between the Haarlemmerweg and the Louis Couperusstraat in Slotermeer. The street is crossed by the Burgemeester Vening Meineszlaan, the Burgemeester De Vlugtlaan and the Burgemeester Van Tienhovengracht.

name: Burgemeester Fockstraat
en: The Burgemeester Fockstraat is a street in Slotermeer, Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The street was named on July 9, 1952 and was named after Cornelis Fock (1828-1910), mayor of Amsterdam from 1866 to 1868, then Commissioner of the King for South Holland. Several streets in the district were named after Amsterdam mayors.

name: Burgemeester Hogguerstraat
en: The Burgemeester Hogguerstraat is a street in Slotermeer in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The street begins at Burgemeester Van de Pollstraat and runs to Burgemeester Rendorpstraat. name: Burgemeester Norbruislaan
en: The Burgemeester Norbruislaan is a street in the Dutch city of Utrecht.

name: Burgemeester Röellstraat
en: The Burgemeester Röellstraat is a street in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The street runs from the Jan van Galenstraat metro station and lies along the extension of Jan van Galenstraat. name: Burgemeester Stramanweg
en: The Burgemeester Stramanweg is an important main road in the municipality of Ouder-Amstel and the municipality of Amsterdam, Zuidoost district.

name: Burgemeester van Tienhovengracht
en: The Burgemeester Van Tienhovengracht in Amsterdam Nieuw-West was built in the 1950s as part of the Western Garden Cities. The canal is located in Slotermeer and is the extension of the Erasmusgracht. The canal ends in a bend at the Plein '40-'45. name: Burgemeester Vening Meineszlaan
en: The Burgemeester Vening Meineszlaan is located in the district ("garden city") Slotermeer in the Amsterdam municipality of Nieuw-West.

name: Calandkanaal
en: The Calandkanaal runs from Hoek van Holland parallel to the Nieuwe Waterweg, and provides access to the industrial areas in the Europoort. The canal ends in the Britannia harbor south of Rozenburg, an important transfer point for cars. The Rozenburg lock has been providing access to the Hartel Canal since April 19, 1971.

name: Calandmonument
en: The Calandmonument in the Shipping Quarter, in the Dutch city of Rotterdam, commemorates engineer Pieter Caland, who designed the Nieuwe Waterweg, the direct connection to the sea. name: Camera Obscurabrug
en: The Camera Obscurabrug (bridge 322) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. It is located in the extension of the Leeuwendalersweg southwards. It spans the Erasmusgracht, which west of the bridge is named Burgemeester Van Tienhovengracht.

name: Carel Willinkplantsoen
en: The Carel Willinkplantsoen is a relatively small park in Amsterdam.

name: Caroline Herschelbrug
en: Caroline Herschelbrug (bridge 115) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Oost. This pedestrian bridge connects Celebesstraat with the Ooster Ringdijk and spans the ring canal of Watergraafsmeer. A bridge with a budget of 5500 guilders was built there in 1927. The bridge was designed at the time by Piet Kramer of the Department of Public Works.

name: Cecilia van Alphen-Jagtmanbrug
en: The Cecilia van Alphen-Jagtmanbrug (bridge 912) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Noord. It forms the connection between the western Buiksloterdijk and a T-intersection on the eastern side. The Buiksloterdijk has a side road here between house numbers 240-242 (a municipal monument) and 248, which runs northeast.

name: Ceintuurbrug
en: The Ceintuurbrug (bridge no. 116) is a plate bridge over the Boerenwetering in Amsterdam-Zuid. The bridge connects the Ceintuurbaan with the Roelof Hartstraat and is part of the ring of streets that lie just outside the inner city ring.

name: Centrale Bibliotheek
en: The Centrale Bibliotheek Rotterdam is the main branch of the Rotterdam Library and is located on the Binnenrotte in the center of the city. The building was designed in 1983 by the architectural firm Van den Broek & Bakema.

name: Charley Tooropbrug
en: The Charley Tooropbrug (bridge 656) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The bridge is located on Postjesweg and spans a ditch that runs parallel to the Ringspoorbaan and metro line 50 there. Postjesweg transitions into Robert Fruinlaan here. On the other side of the Ringspoorlijn there is also a ditch but there is no bridge over it.

name: Chemiehaven
en: The Chemiehaven is a port in the Botlek area in Rotterdam with an area of 22 hectares. name: Chinatown
en: Chinatown is the Chinese quarter of Amsterdam. It lies around the Geldersekade and the Zeedijk in the old inner city, Amsterdam-Centrum.

name: Christoffel Plantijngracht
en: The Christoffel Plantijnpad (and the Christoffel Plantijngracht) in Amsterdam-Slotervaart have been named after the South Dutch printer and lexicographer Christoffel Plantijn (1514-1589), who owned a famous printing house and publishing house in Antwerp. name: Christus Koning
en: The Christus Koningkerk is a former Roman Catholic church on the Statenplein in Rotterdam.

name: Christus Triumfatorkerk
en: The Christus Triumfatorkerk at Juliana van Stolberglaan 154 (corner Laan van Nieuw Oost-Indië) in the Bezuidenhout in The Hague is a Protestant church. It was inaugurated on March 21, 1962.

name: Church of England
en: Christ Church in Amsterdam is a former cloth hall on the Groenburgwal converted into an Anglican church. It is one of the first, possibly the first, buildings in the Netherlands in the neo-Gothic manner. It was entered in the monuments register on 28 April 1970.

name: Church of St. John & St. Philip
en: The Church or St. John and St. Philip, short for the English church, is an Anglican church building on the Ary van der Spuyweg in The Hague. The priest's house is next to it at the beginning of the Riouwstraat.

name: Churchilllaan
en: Churchilllaan is a street in the Rivierenbuurt in Amsterdam-Zuid. Until May 1946 it was called Noorder Amstellaan.

name: Cinecenter
en: Cinecenter is an Amsterdam cinema in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is located at Lijnbaansgracht 236 near Leidseplein. The cinema or film house was in 1979 the continuation of the CinéTol cinema, which was closed approximately at the same time by Cor Koppies. That came into conflict with the municipality of Amsterdam, which first wants the complex on Tolstraat

name: Coenhaven
en: The Coenhaven is a port in the Amsterdam Western Port Area north of the Vlothaven, south of the North Sea Canal near the Coentunnel named after the port, east of the Petroleum Port and west of the Mercuriushaven. The port has provided space for ships and activities that are no longer desired in the Eastern Port Area

name: Colignybrug
en: The Colignybrug is a monumental bridge in the Dutch city of Utrecht. It spans the Minstroom and forms a connection between Louise de Colignystraat and Hobbemastraat. name: Collectie Six
en: The Collectie Six is the common name for the patrimony of the Six family that, in addition to the family portraits, includes the family archive and art and antique objects related to the family, among other things.

name: Commandantsbrug
en: Commandantsbrug is the unofficial name of bridge 2361 in Amsterdam-Centrum.

name: Compagnietheater
en: The Compagnietheater is housed in the former church of the Reformed Lutheran church on the Kloveniersburgwal in Amsterdam.

name: Constantiahofje
en: Constantia is a residential complex around a green courtyard on Willemsstraat 149-165 in Amsterdam, which was built in neoclassical style in 1863. name: Constantyn Huygens
en: The monument to Constantine Huygens was established in 1897 in Scheveningen.

name: Coolhaven
en: The Coolhaven is a harbor in Rotterdam. The Coolhaven was dug in 1922 as a new connection between the Delfshavense Schie and the Nieuwe Maas. In addition to being a waterway, it is also a basin of the High Authority of Delfland. The connection between the Coolhaven and the Nieuwe Maas runs via the Parksluis and the Parkhaven, which were opened in 1933.

name: Coolsingel Gate
en: The Coolsingel gate on the Lijnbaan in the Dutch city of Rotterdam was the rear gate of the former Coolsingel hospital on the Coolsingel. Through the gate on the then Crispijnlaan, ambulances came and went. The hospital was destroyed during the bombing of Rotterdam in May 1940, leaving some outer walls and the gate standing.

name: Cor van der Hartbrug
en: The Cor van der Hartbrug is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Oost. It is located on the edge of the Sportheldenbuurt on the Zeeburgereiland. It is located along the Alida van den Bosstraat, spans the ring ditch of the district and leads to the Bobby Harmslaan. From the bridge, three silos of the former sewage treatment plant can be seen heading towards the city.

name: Cornelis Lelylaan
en: The Cornelis Lelylaan is a city motorway in Amsterdam (part of the city route s106) that connects the districts West and Nieuw-West. The Amsterdam Lelylaan train and metro station is located across the road and is named after it. On the site of the road was originally the Slotervaart which was drowned and disappeared under the sand.

name: Corry Tendeloobrug
en: The Corry Tendeloobrug (bridge 713) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The bridge is located on Johan Huizingalaan and spans a canal that runs parallel to Aletta Jacobslaan and Louwesweg on the north side. Aletta Jacobslaan becomes Louwesweg at the intersection with Johan Huizingalaan.

name: Corsgenbrug
en: The Corsgenbrug (bridge 12) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum.

name: Court Square Fountain
en: The Hofpleinfontein is a fountain centrally located in the traffic square Hofplein in the Dutch city of Rotterdam, designed by architect J.R.A. Koops. The fountain was completed in 1955. name: Croeselaan
en: The Croeselaan is a street in the Dutch city of Utrecht. It runs from Westplein to Vondellaan and lies between Utrecht Central Station and the Jaarbeurs.

name: Da Costagracht
en: The Da Costagracht is a canal in Amsterdam-West. The canal connects the Hugo de Grootgracht in the north with the Jacob van Lennepkanaal in the south. The canal is named after the 19th-century poet and prose writer Isaäc da Costa (1798-1860).

name: Daalwijkdreef
en: The Daalwijkdreef is a promenade in the Bijlmermeer in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The first part of the elevated promenade, exclusively for fast traffic, was opened in 1971. The promenade connects the Dolingadreef in the west of the Bijlmermeer with the Elsrijkdreef in the east where the promenade turns right at a bend. Originally, the promenade began at the m

name: Dafne Schippersbrug
en: The Dafne Schippersbrug is a bicycle and pedestrian bridge over the Amsterdam-Rhine Canal in Utrecht. This bridge is located on the shortest cycling route between Utrecht City Center on the east side and the geographical center of the Utrecht district of Leidsche Rijn and the hometown of De Meern on the west side.

name: Dageraadsbrug
en: The Dageraadsbrug (bridge 353) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum.

name: Dam Square Victims 7 mei 1945
en: A plaque and thirty-two street stones on the Dam in Amsterdam-Centrum commemorate the victims of the Shooting on the Dam on May 7, 1945.

name: Damesleesmuseum
en: The Damesleesmuseum is a private library in The Hague, founded on May 15, 1894. It is the only still existing Dutch 'reading museum' for women. Since 1974, membership has also been open to men. The library has a collection of about 35,000 books in the four modern languages. New books are purchased every month without

name: Darwinplantsoen
en: Darwinplantsoen is a street and a park in the Dutch capital Amsterdam, more specifically in Amsterdam-Oost, Watergraafsmeer.

name: David van Mollembrug
en: The David van Mollembrug is a bascule bridge over the Vecht River in the Dutch city of Utrecht. The bridge was opened in 1965 and forms a connection between David van Mollemstraat and the Draaiweg. The bridge is named after silk merchant David van Mollem (1670-1746), who had his country house Zijdebalen here.

name: David Vilbach
en: The List of Stolpersteine in Hillegersberg-Schiebroek provides an overview of the commemorative stones placed in the city district of Hillegersberg-Schiebroek in the Dutch municipality of Rotterdam as part of the Stolpersteine project of the German sculptor-artist Gunter Demnig. Stolpersteine are dedicated to victims of the National Socialism

name: De Alpen
en: De Alpen is a street in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The street was named on October 20, 1993, but was finally determined on September 24, 1997. It was named after the Alpine mountain range. name: De Arendbrug
en: De Arendbrug (bridge 1973) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-West. The bridge forms the connection between the Haarlemmerweg and the Polonceaukade, both of which are the quays of the Haarlemmertrekvaart, which it spans. The bridge lies approximately along the Van Hallstraat. North of the bridge are the former gas holders of the Westergasfabriek.

name: De Ark
en: De Ark is a church building in the Slotervaart district in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The church was built in 1960-'61 according to the design of architect Piet Zanstra. The building has been on the municipal monument list since 2008 and on the Top-100 of young monuments of Amsterdam.

name: De Boeg
en: De Boeg is a war monument in Rotterdam. It commemorates the 3500 passengers of Dutch merchant ships who lost their lives in World War II. name: De Boelelaan
en: The De Boelelaan in Amsterdam-Buitenveldert was named on January 15, 1958 and was named after Gerrit de Boele, bailiff of Amstelland and Waterland (1354/55).

name: De Dokwerker
en: De Dokwerker is a statue and monument on Jonas Daniël Meijerplein in Amsterdam in memory of the February Strike of 1941. The statue was designed and made by the sculptor Mari Andriessen on commission of the Amsterdam municipal government. The Haarlem carpenter/contractor Willem Termetz, who already knew Andriessen before the war, in 1951

name: De Dolphijn
en: The house De Dolphijn is a canal house at Singel 140-142 in Amsterdam. Its best-known resident was Frans Banninck Cocq, who lived there when Rembrandt painted Cocq's militia company between 1640 and 1642, in the painting now known as The Night Watch.

name: De Drie Stoepen
en: De Drie Stoepen is the collective name of three adjacent national monuments from the first half of the eighteenth century, in the center of The Hague. In addition to their original function as a residence, they would later serve as a museum, court, official residence, and (temporary) seat of the Permanent Court of Arbitration, among other things.

name: De Duifbrug
en: De Duifbrug, Duyfjesbrug or Duyfjessluis is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is located on the eastern quay of the Reguliersgracht across the Prinsengracht.

name: De Gesloten Steen
en: De Gesloten Steen (also known as devil's stone) is a heavy stray stone in the center of Utrecht. The national monument stone is chained to the corner of Oudegracht and the Eligenhof on a corner building that has taken its name from it.

name: De Groene Kop
en: Park De Groene Kop is a park on the north side of Tuindorp Oost, a neighborhood in the Noordoost district in Utrecht. The park is located between the Eykmanlaan, Winklerlaan, the community garden park de Driehoek and the Utrecht-Amersfoort railway line.

name: De Hallen
en: The Hallen is a cultural center in the Kinkerbuurt in Amsterdam-West, with more than two million visitors per year. It houses the Filmhallen, FoodHallen, De Hallen Studios, Kanarie Club, Hal West, various shops, a hotel, a daycare center, the Beeldend Gesproken gallery and a branch of the Openbare Bibliotheek Amsterdam with reading café Belcampo. name: De hongerwinter
en: De hongerwinter is a war monument on the Eastern Islands in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is about the hunger winter of 1944/1945. It exists in two versions: The original, by Hildo Krop, is located in the Oosterkerk. name: De Hoop
en: Korenmolen De Hoop on Molenweg in Rozenburg was founded in 1887, to replace a mill dating back to 1658 that was located on the inside of the Kooilandsedijk. That mill had to disappear in 1887 due to waterworks works on the Scheur. The new tower mill has been in use as a grain mill until the early 1960s of the 20th century.

name: De Inktpot
en: De Inktpot is the largest brick building in the Netherlands, designed by George van Heukelom on behalf of the public interest association Dutch Railways (NS). The national monument is located in Moreelsepark in Utrecht near Utrecht Central Station and has been used since 1995 as the headquarters of ProRail.

name: De Kom
en: De Kom is an unofficial name for a body of water in Amsterdam-Zuid. It is a crossroads of five waterways. These waterways also have a bridge on "De Kom" except for one.

name: De Krommert
en: De Krommert (also known as De Krommerdt) is a neighborhood in the Amsterdam district of West, named after the De Krommert waterway.

name: De Meernbrug
en: The De Meernbrug, not to be confused with the Meern Bridge (without article De) in the center of De Meern, is a arched bridge over the Amsterdam-Rhine Canal near the Utrecht Jaarbeurs and not far from De Meern.

name: De Nieuwe Stad
en: Kerkcentrum De Nieuwe Stad is a church in Amsterdam-Zuidoost (Bijlmermeer), built in 1992/1993 and designed by the architects Lafour and Wijk.

name: De Nieuwlandse Molen
en: De Nieuwlandse Molen or the Van der Knijff mill (in popular parlance so named after the millers' family who have been running the mill for generations) is an old mill in the Nieuwlandsche polder between 's-Gravenzande and Hoek van Holland, which was originally built as an inland cruiser and as a ground sealer.

name: De Rijpgracht
en: The De Rijpgracht is a canal in the Amsterdam neighborhood of Landlust. The canal was named after the explorer Jan Corneliszoon Rijp (1570-1630) by a council decision of April 27, 1933, with the understanding that the canal and associated street have an article (the De Rijpgracht).

name: De Ruijterkade
en: The De Ruijterkade in Amsterdam is located along the IJ on the north side of Central Station. The quay was built in 1880 on the new Station Island, as part of a restructuring project of the traffic flows, in connection with the construction of the North Sea Canal and the expansions of train traffic. The De Ruijterkade is named after Michiel Adria

name: De Vriendschap
en: De Vriendschap is a windmill built in 1900 on the site of a mill that burned down in 1899. It stands at Utrechtseweg 11a on the Utrechtse Vecht in Weesp.

name: De Vrouwenbibliotheek
en: De Vrouwenbibliotheek and Documentatiecentrum Utrecht (VDU), founded in 1984, was a place where women in the Dutch city of Utrecht and its surroundings could find feminist literature, documentary material and non-fiction about women's culture, and where they also had a meeting place. De Vrouwenbibliotheek was thus part of the women's movement

name: De Vulkaan
en: De Vulkaan is the highest dune top of the Westduinpark in The Hague. This 33-meter-high dune is located on the north side of the De Savornin Lohmanpad, the connection between Strandslag 7 and the corner of the De Savornin Lohmanlaan and the Laan van Poot.

name: Delfshavensche Schie
en: The Delfshavense Schie is a canal between the Delftse Schie near Overschie and Delfshaven in the municipality of Rotterdam.

name: Delfshavense Schie
en: The Delfshavense Schie is a canal between the Delft Schie near Overschie and Delfshaven in the municipality of Rotterdam.

name: Delftsche Schie
en: The Schie is a name used for four canals in the area around the Dutch Overschie. The Delfshavense Schie, the Delftse Schie, the Rotterdamse Schie and the Schiedamse Schie are distinguished. The existence of four Schees is the result of the medieval rivalry between the cities of Delft, Rotterdam and Schiedam over toll rights.

name: Delftsche Vliet
en: The Delftsche Vliet is a canal with a length of 4.6 kilometers between Delft and Rijswijk, and is part of the Rhine-Schie Canal, which forms the connection between the Old Rhine near Leiden and Overschie.

name: Demka-spoorbrug
en: The Demka-spoorbrug is a railway bridge over the Amsterdam-Rhine Canal in Utrecht. The bridge is a steel reinforced beam arch bridge and was built in 1966 to replace the old, much smaller railway bridge that had to disappear due to the widening of the canal. The span is 173 meters. The bridge is named after the nearby former steelworks

name: Diaconessenbrug
en: Diaconessenbrug (bridge 454, was also known as: Willemsbrug) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid. The bridge formed the connection between Vondelpark (on the northern side of the bridge) and Willemspark (on the southern side), from which it derives its popular name.

name: Dick Schmüllbrug
en: Dick Schmüllbrug (bridge 415) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid. The traffic bridge, over which GVB bus 15 also runs, is located on Parnassusweg and spans the Zuider Amstelkanaal. In the north, the Stadionkade runs along the bridge and in the south the Locatellikade and Henri Viottakade.

name: Diepenbrockstraat
en: The Diepenbrockstraat is a street in Amsterdam - Zuid. The street runs along the Wielingenstraat, which runs along the RAI exhibition center. The street begins on Bridge 422 over the Boerenwetering, from there the street runs in a circular shape over a bridge over the Zuider Amstel Canal. The street ends on the Stadionweg. name: Dintelhaven
en: The Dintelhaven is a inland port in Rotterdam-Europoort. The Dintelhaven was completed in 1970. The main company at the Dintelhaven is the Ertsoverslagbedrijf Europoort, where dump trucks are loaded with ores and coal. name: Dintelhavenbrug
en: The Dintelhavenbrug connects the two shores of the Dintelhaven in the Dutch city of Rotterdam, the A15 runs over the car bridge. Next to the car bridge is a railway bridge, the Dintelhavenspoorbrug. The bridges are located at the point where the Dintel Canal discharges into the Hartel Canal.

name: Dintelhavenspoorbrug
en: The Dintelhavenspoorbrug connects the two shores of the Dintelhaven in the Dutch city of Rotterdam. The bridge is part of the Rotterdam harbor railway line that transitions into the Betuweroute. Next to the railway bridge is a bridge for car traffic, the Dintelhaven Bridge. The railway bridge is part of the Rotterdam harbor railway line.

name: Dirk de Waterduikerbrug
en: The Dirk de Waterduikerbrug (bridge 617) is a fixed bridge in the Slotermeer district in the Amsterdam Nieuw-West district. The bridge is located in the Noordzijde street and crosses a culvert, which connects the water of the marina on the north side of the Sloterplas with a narrow canal that runs in a northerly direction.

name: Dockyard V
en: The Dockyard V is a Dutch steam tugboat built under construction number 227 at the Rotterdamsche Droogdok Maatschappij (RDM). It was launched in 1946. The Dockyard V was part of a series of a total of eight ships. Some of these ships have survived from this series, namely Dockyard III, Dockyard IV and the Dockyard IX. Originally true

name: Doctor Zamenhofstraat
en: The Dr. Zamenhofstraat is a street in the Dutch city of Rotterdam and runs from the Vredenoordlaan to the Oostzeedijk Beneden. The only side street that borders the Dr. Zamenhofstraat is the Plantagestraat.

name: Doelensluis
en: The Doelensluis (bridge 220) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum.

name: Doenbrug
en: The Doenbrug is a bascule bridge over the Delftse Schie in the district of Overschie of the Dutch municipality of Rotterdam. The Doenbrug dates back to 1988 and was built to connect the Rotterdam North-West business park. Through the Doenbrug, traffic from the Spanish Polder and the North-west business park has a connection to the A13 near Zest airport

name: Dolingadreef
en: The Dolingadreef is a dike in the Bijlmermeer in Amsterdam-Zuidoost.

name: Domela Nieuwenhuisplantsoen
en: The Domela Nieuwenhuisplantsoen is a small garden in the shape of a triangle in the Spaarndammerbuurt neighborhood in Amsterdam-West.

name: Dominicuskerk
en: The Dominicuskerk is a neo-Gothic church building on Spuistraat in Amsterdam. It was built as a Roman Catholic Parish Church of St. Dominic by Pierre Cuypers and served by the Dominicans. The church is no longer part of the Catholic Church, but is used by the Dominican community and rented out.

name: Domplein
en: The Domplein is a square in the city center of the Dutch city of Utrecht. It is named after the Dom Church, which is located on the square.

name: Donau
en: The Donau is the longest river within the European Union and, after the Volga, the longest in Europe. The Donau is a mixed river, which means that the river is fed by meltwater, groundwater and rainwater.

name: Donauhaven
en: The Donauhaven is a port in Rotterdam-Europoort, in the Seventh Petroleum Port. The Donauhaven has a water depth of 7.65 meters.

name: Doopsgezinde kerk
en: The Doopsgezinde kerk "Vermaning" in the Dutch city of Utrecht is located on the Oudegracht. It was established in 1773 by a thorough renovation of a medieval canal house under the leadership of the Haarlem architect Willem de Haan. Until then, the Baptists had used a building on Springweg. The new front facade on the Oudegra

name: Dorpskerk Durgerdam
en: The Dorpskerk Durgerdam, originally the Reformed church of Durgerdam, is the Protestant church of Durgerdam in Amsterdam-Noord. It does not stand along the Durgerdammerdijk but slightly lower behind it. Its congregation belongs to the Protestant Church in the Netherlands.

name: Dorpsweg
en: The Dorpsweg is a busy connecting road between the Groene Kruisweg and the Maastunnel in the Rotterdam district of Charlois and runs through the district of Pendrecht

name: Dr. Samuel de Ranitzbrug
en: The Dr. Samuel de Ranitzbrug (bridge no. 187), also known as the Spinozabrug, is a former railway bridge over the Singelgracht in Amsterdam, between the Mauritskade and the Spinozastraat. The Municipality of Amsterdam also refers to the bridge as bridge 187. The bridge is part of the waterway between the Open Havenfront and the Amstel.

name: Drieharingenbrug

name: Drift
en: The Drift is a canal and street in the city center of the Dutch city of Utrecht. It connects to the Kromme Nieuwegracht in the south and continues into the Plompetorengracht in the north. name: Driftbrug
en: The Driftbrug is a fixed bridge in the Dutch city of Utrecht. It is located in the northeast of the city center. The bridge spans the Drift which at this point flows into the Plompetorengracht. By land, the Driftbrug connects the Voorstraat with the Wittevrouwenstraat.

name: Drs. P-brug
en: The Drs. P-brug (bridge 2115) is a structure in Amsterdam-Noord. Its working name was the Ridderspoorbrug.

name: Druivenbrug
en: The Druivenbrug (bridge 1796) is a double lift bridge in Amsterdam-Noord. The bridge spans the Noordelijke singel in the 21st-century district of De Bongerd. It connects Druivenstraat (its namesake, itself named after the grape) with the Bongerdkade and lies parallel to the outlet of Zijkanaal I, along which the mentioned cycle path runs.
machine: The Druivenbrug (bridge 1796) is a double lift bridge in Amsterdam-North. The bridge spans the Northern Singel in the 21st-century district of De Bongerd. Stolpersteine are dedicated to victims of the National Socialism

name: Duinzichtkerk
en: The Duinzichtkerk is a church building on Van Hogenhoucklaan in The Hague. The parish belongs to the Protestant Church of The Hague. In the new part of Benoordenhout, construction began in 1934 on a new church. The initiator was the Zanen family. The design was by the well-known architect Willem Verschoor. The first stone was laid

name: Duivendrechtsevaart
en: The Duivendrechtsevaart is a canal in Amsterdam and Duivendrecht (Ouder-Amstel municipality). The waterway runs from the Amstel near the Omval to the Van der Madeweg in the Overamstel industrial area. The municipal border between Amsterdam and Ouder-Amstel runs across the canal. The waterway is named after the nearby village of Duivendrecht.

name: Dutch National Opera & Ballet
en: National Opera & Ballet (formerly Het Muziektheater Amsterdam) is a theater in Amsterdam that was specially built for the performance of operas, ballets and other forms of music theater. name: Eben Haëzerkerk
en: The Eben-Haëzerkerk is the church building of the Reformed Church in Scheveningen. The church is located on the Nieuwe Laantjes and also has an entrance in the Keizerstraat. The Eben-Haëzerkerk was removed from worship as of January 1, 2018. Since the fall of 2019, the Christian meeting center Het Kompas has been located in the church building.

name: Ecuplein
en: The Ecuplein is a square in the De Aker district in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. It is located at the end of Pieter Calandlaan. The square was named in 1997 after the 'European Currency Unit' (ECU), the financial unit of account of the European Community, which was replaced by the euro on January 1, 1999.

name: Eemhaven
en: The Eemhaven is the central channel of a complex of harbors in Rotterdam located between Pernis and the Waalhaven. The adjacent harbor basins are the 1st Eemhaven, the repair quay of Niehuis, the Prins Johan Frisohaven, the Prinses Beatrixhaven and the Prins Willem Alexanderhaven.

name: Eén Honderd Roedebrug
en: Brug 347 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam Oud-West.

name: Eendrachtspark
en: The Eendrachtspark is a city park in Amsterdam Nieuw-West.

name: Eendrachtsplein
en: The Eendrachtsplein is a well-known square in the center of Rotterdam. The square is connected to the Westblaak, the Eendrachtsweg, the Westersingel, the Rochussenstraat, the Mauritsweg and the Oude Binnenweg. The Eendrachtsplein forms the border between the districts Centrum, Cool, Dijkzigt and the Oude Westen.

name: Eenhoornsluis
en: The Eenhoornsluis (bridge no. 313) is a bridge over the Korte Prinsengracht in Amsterdam. The bridge lies between the Haarlemmerstraat and Haarlemmerdijk and dates from 1618. The bridge and the associated Eenhoornschutsluis (lock no. 103) were planned as a connection of the then new canals with the IJ, since 1832 the Westerdok, when the canal belt was built.

en: The Elbehaven is a port in the west of the Europoort area in Rotterdam and is located in the Benelux port on the Caland Canal.

name: Elsje Christiaensbrug
en: The Elsje Christiaensbrug (bridge 2474) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Noord. The traffic bridge is located over the Buiksloterkanaal and is located on Tolhuisweg.

name: Elthetokerk

name: Emmauskerk
en: The Emmauskerk is a Roman Catholic parish church on the Leyweg in the Dutch city of The Hague.

name: Entrepothaven
en: The Entrepothaven in Amsterdam is a trumpet-shaped body of water in the Eastern Harbor Area of Amsterdam. name: Entrepothaven
en: The Entrepothaven is a marina in Rotterdam. Originally it was a transhipment port. At the end of the nineteenth century, a number of new ports were dug in Feijenoord due to the strong increase in trade.

name: Erasmusgracht
en: The Erasmusgracht in Amsterdam-West was built in the 1940s as part of the new Bos en Lommer district. name: Erasmuspark
en: The Erasmuspark is a city park in Amsterdam-West. It is also the name of the neighborhood in which it is located.

name: Ernst Cahn en Alfred Kohnbrug
en: The Ernst Cahn en Alfred Kohnbrug is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid. The traffic bridge over which tram line 4 also runs forms the connection between Van Woustraat and Rijnstraat. It spans the Amstelkanaal here with the northern Jozef Israëlskade and southern Amstelkade.

name: Ertshaven
en: The Ertshaven is a port in the Eastern Port Area of Amsterdam. The port is located east of the Connecting Dam, with the Blauwehoofdbrug in it, and flows into the Amsterdam-Rhine Canal.

name: Esperantomonument
en: Esperanto monuments in the Netherlands were established in honor of the Esperanto language and/or the creator of that language, Lejzer Zamenhof. In the Netherlands there are six of these types of monuments: in the towns of Bergen op Zoom, Den Burg, Leeuwarden, Utrecht and Zwolle.

name: Essalam
en: The Essalam Mosque is a large mosque in the Rotterdam district of Feijenoord, near the football stadium de Kuip. The mosque is strongly defining for the district due to its size. The dome is 25 meters high and the minarets are 50 meters high.

name: Etty Hillesumbrug
en: The Etty Hillesumbrug (bridge 409) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid.

name: Europaboulevard
en: The Europaboulevard is a street in Buitenveldert in Amsterdam-Zuid. name: Europahaven
en: The Europahaven is a seaport on the Rotterdam Maasvlakte, and is a branch of the Beerkanaal. The Europahaven was built in the 1980s when Europe Container Terminals opened a terminal on the Maasvlakte. Today, APM Terminals of the Maersk group is located on the Europahaven. name: Europaplein
en: The Europaplein is a square in Amsterdam-Zuid. The Europaplein metro station is named after it. The square consists of a traffic road and the area in front of the RAI complex. The other side of the road is also called Europaplein and on the site of the former tram loop is a small park.

name: Eva Schalkbrug
en: The Eva Schalkbrug (bridge 997) is a fixed bridge for pedestrians and cyclists in Amsterdam-Noord. It is located in Noorderpark and spans both part of the park and the Noord-Hollandsch Kanaal. In the 2000s and 2010s, as a result of the construction of the North-South Line, the entire surrounding area here was adapted.

name: Evangelisch Lutherse Gemeente
en: The Evangelical Lutherse church in The Hague is located on the Lutherse Burgwal. Where the church stands, there has been a hidden church since 1615. In the 1620s-1656, pieces of land around that building were purchased and so a complex of a church with annexes was created.

name: Evert van der Wallbrug
en: The Evert van der Wallbrug is a fixed bridge for pedestrians and cyclists in Amsterdam-Oost. It is located in the Watergraafsmeer in the extension of the Mr. P.N. Arntzeniusweg and spans the Ringvaart van de Watergraafsmeer. It connects the Linnaeuskade and Oranje-Vrijstaatkade, both banks of that ringvaart.

name: Exbunker
en: The bunker in Wilhelminapark was built in 1943 as a bombproof German personnel bunker in Wilhelminapark in Utrecht. After 1945, the bunker was mainly a hindrance. Due to its cultural historical value, it has been a municipal monument since 2001 and has been used since 2014 by visual artists as an exhibition space.

name: Ezelsbrug
en: The Ezelsbrug (bridge no. 1904) is a structure in Amsterdam-Centrum.

name: Faralda NDSM Crane Hotel Amsterdam

name: Fatih
en: The Fatih mosque is a mosque on the Rozengracht in the Jordaan, Amsterdam-Centrum. It is located in the former Roman Catholic St. Ignatius Church, also known as De Zaaier.

name: Filmhallen
en: The Filmhallen, also known as FilmHallen, is a movie theater in the De Hallen complex in the former tram depot Tollensstraat in Amsterdam-West. The operators are Kadir Selçuk and Alex Rutten of The Movies. The cinema has been open since September 4, 2014, with the premiere of the Dutch feature film Nena by Saskia Diesing on September 8.

name: Filmhuis Cavia
en: Filmhuis Cavia is a film theater in the Van Hallstraat in the Amsterdam Staatsliedenbuurt that is run entirely by volunteers. The cinema emerged in the 1980s from the squatting movement and has a simple formula: it shows what cannot be seen elsewhere. Filmhuis Cavia is located in the former Prinses Beatrix Schipp

name: Filmhuis Den Haag
en: Filmhuis Den Haag is a cinema in the center of The Hague. This non-commercial cinema was founded in 1981 and is located at the Spui. Since 2012, the cinema has also had a room in Theater Dakota, in the Hague district of Escamp. Since October 2012, both locations have been participating in Cineville. The Filmhuis has received two European awards.

name: Fokhaven
en: The Fokhaven is a watersport harbor on the Schie-Schie Canal in the north of Rotterdam in the Blijdorpse polder. The harbor was dug in 1960 at the initiative of the municipality of Rotterdam. Three water sports associations were accommodated there that had previously been located elsewhere.

name: Fort aan de Klop
en: Fort aan de Klop is a defensive work on the Vecht River in Utrecht. The fort was built in 1819. The function of the fort consisted, among other things, of protecting the city of Utrecht. It was also part of the New Holland Water Line.

name: Fort aan den Hoek van Holland
en: The Fort aan den Hoek van Holland, also known as Fort 1881, is a former armored fort in Hoek van Holland. The fort, located on the Nieuwe Waterweg, served to protect the waterway during wartime from an enemy fleet and the beach from an invasion. To this end, the fort had six cannons in three rotating armored cupolas. In addition, a mine could be used

name: Fort bij Rijnauwen
en: Fort bij Rijnauwen is a Dutch fort near the hamlet of Rhijnauwen in the municipality of Bunnik. It is part of the Nieuwe Hollandse Waterlinie (NHW).

name: Fort bij Uitermeer
en: Fort Uitermeer is an old fort that was included in the New Holland Water Line and later the Stelling of Amsterdam. It is located in the North Holland municipality of Weesp on the eastern bank of the Vecht, southeast of Weesp near the hamlet of Uitermeer. To the southwest is the Fort at Hinderdam and to the northwest is the Weesp Fortress.

name: Fort Blauwkapel
en: Fort Blauwkapel (also known as: Blaucapel) is a Dutch fort near Utrecht. The fort was built in 1818-1821 as part of the Nieuwe Hollandse Waterlinie and is one of the largest forts of the line. Blauwkapel is a protected cityscape.

name: Fort de Bilt
en: Fort de Bilt, also known as Fort op de Biltstraat, is one of the defensive works of the Nieuwe Hollandse Waterlinie in the municipality of Utrecht.

name: Fort De Gagel
en: Fort De Gagel is a fort in Utrecht. The fort was built between 1819 and 1821 as part of the Nieuwe Hollandse Waterlinie. The fort consists of several national monuments.

name: Frans Hendriksz Oetgensbrug
en: The Frans Hendricksz. Oetgensbrug (bridge 76) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is located on the western quay of the Amstel and spans the Prinsengracht. The bridge is the last bridge of the Prinsengracht before it flows into the same Amstel. The bridge is also on the southeastern border of the Amsterdam canal belt.

en: The Fré Cohenbrug is a fixed bridge with a culvert in Watergraafsmeer, Amsterdam. name: Frederiksplein
en: The Frederiksplein is a square in Amsterdam-Centrum, named in 1870 after Prince Frederick, uncle of King William III. The square extends along Utrechtsestraat, between the Weteringschans and the Sarphatistraat. De Nederlandsche Bank is located on the square.

name: Frederiksstraat
en: The Frederiksstraat is a relatively short street in Amsterdam Oud-West.

name: Freek Oxstraat
en: Freek Oxstraat is a street in the Amsterdam garden city of Slotermeer. The street was named after resistance fighter Freek Ox on July 9, 1952.

name: Furkabaan
en: The Furkabaan is a street in the Lunetten subdistrict in the Dutch city of Utrecht. The Furkabaan, built in 1976, together with the "Stelviobaan", "Brennerbaan" and "Simplonbaan" forms the Lunetten bypass. The Furkabaan starts at Utrecht Lunetten Station and transitions into the "Simplonbaan" in the south of Lunetten.

name: Fusillade
en: Fusillade, also known as The Fallen Hornblower, is a bronze statue in the Eerste Weteringplantsoen in Amsterdam, made in 1954 by Gerrit Bolhuis. Here, the German army executed thirty political prisoners on March 12, 1945 as a reprisal for a resistance act.

name: G.J. de Jonghweg
en: The G.J. de Jonghweg is a Rotterdam road extending from the Parkhaven, connecting the Westzeedijk with Rochussenstraat. The road runs along the Coolhaven and is named after Gerrit Johannes de Jongh, who held the scepter over the Municipal Works Rotterdam department from 1879 to 1910.

name: Gaardbrug
en: The Gaardbrug is a nationally protected arched bridge in the city center of Utrecht. The bridge spans the Oudegracht. Around 1400, the Oudegracht could already be crossed at this location and the location belonged to the market area that used to be located in and around the trading district of Stathe.

name: Gaasperpark
en: The Gaasperpark is a park in Gaasperdam, Amsterdam-Zuidoost district, on the northern bank of the Gaasperplas, an artificial recreation lake, created by sand mining for the elevation for the construction of Gaasperdam. The Gaasperpark is managed by Groengebied Amstelland and Recreatie Noord-Holland NV. It belongs to the Nature Network Nede

name: Gaasperzoom
en: The Gaasperzoom is a park and nature reserve in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The area is located east of the Gein residential district, west of the Gein stream, north of the Ruwelswal and south of the Gaasperplas. The area was developed at the beginning of the 1980s, at the same time as the Gein district was ready. A bicycle path crosses it

name: Galecopperbrug
en: The Galecopperbrug is a steel tube bridge over the Amsterdam-Rhine Canal near the city of Utrecht. The bridge actually consists of two parts, the first part of which was opened in 1971 and the second part in 1976. The bridge serves as part of the A12 motorway and replaced a 1936 arch bridge. name: Galgenbrug
en: The Galgenbrug (bridge 315) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge is located between Bickerseiland and Prinseneiland. It was built between 1625 (the map by Balthasar Florisz. van Berckenrode from 1625 does not show the bridge) and 1649 (the map by Joan Blaeu does show the bridge).
machine: The Galgenbrug (bridge 315) is a permanent bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge is located between Bickerseiland and Prinseneiland. It was built between 1625 (the map by Balthasar Florisz. van Berckenrode from 1625 does not show the bridge) and 1649 (the map by Joan Blaeu does show the bridge).

name: Galileïplantsoen
en: The Galileïplantsoen is a park with associated streets in Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Gedenksteen
en: The Gedenksteen for the former Detention Center, also known as Gedenksteen 4 May, is a work of art in Amsterdam-Centrum. The plastic was designed by architect Pieter Zaanen, he was responsible for the new building around 1990 on the Max Euweplein. The statue stands on a separate part of the square on the side of the Kleine-Gartmanplantsoen,

name: Geert Geertsenbrug
en: The Geert Geertsenbrug (bridge 395) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-West. The pedestrian bridge is located on the western edge of Erasmus Park and provides access from Hondiusstraat and Mercatorstraat. It spans the ring moat surrounding the park. Near the entrance is the restaurant Terrasmus (location 2022) located in the park.

name: Geertebrug
en: The Geertebrug is a nationally protected arched bridge in the city center of Utrecht. The bridge spans the Oudegracht.

name: Geertekerk
en: The Geertekerk is a church in the Dutch city of Utrecht. In the Middle Ages it was one of the four parish churches in that city, and the smallest and youngest, dedicated to the saint Gertrude of Nijvel. The first building was built on a site outside the walls, but between 1248 and 1259 the church was moved inside the city walls. Since then, n

name: Geertje Wielemaplein
en: The Geertje Wielemaplein is a square in Amsterdam-Oost. The square is located on the Zeeburgereiland, the front line of IJburg northeast of the intersection of Zuiderzeeweg and IJburglaan, both busy main routes in Amsterdam Oost. The square was named in 2016, after swimmer Geertje Wielema, after the earlier decision to name a street after

name: Geestbrug
en: The Geestbrug is a bascule bridge over the Haagvliet or Trekvliet from 1933, located in the Dutch province of South Holland. The bridge connects Rijswijk with Voorburg-West.

name: Gein
en: Gein is a residential area in Amsterdam-Zuidoost in the Gaasperdam district. The name of the area is derived from the Gein stream running east of the area. The first houses were completed in 1982 and the area was largely completed in the late 1980s.

name: Geloof en Vrijheid
en: Geloof en Vrijheid is a monument to the building in the 1st Pijnackerstraat in Rotterdam, where on October 18, 1942, a group of underground workers was attacked by the Germans. Three resistance members died. The relief consists of a torch, in which at the top a figure depicts the resistance. Under his outstretched arms, men, women and children search

name: Gemeenlandshuis
en: The Gemeenlandshuis of Diemen stands at Diemerzeedijk 27 in Amsterdam-Oost. As the name suggests it was originally a water board house. The building stands in the shadow of the Zeeburgerbrug.

name: George Madurobrug
en: The George Madurobrug (bridge 1036) is a structure in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The bridge is a combination of a bridge and viaduct. It crosses a foot and bicycle path in Nelson Mandelapark and a drainage ditch from the same park. The structure is located in Karspeldreef, a main route in Amsterdam-Zuidoost, which cuts through the park in half.

name: Ger van Zanenbrug
en: Ger van Zanenbrug (bridge 2372) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam Nieuw-West, serving as the successor to bridge 700.

name: Gerard Dou Synagogue
en: The Synagoge Gerard Doustraat in the Amsterdam district of de Pijp was built in 1892 at the behest of Ashkenazi chevre Tesjoe'at Israel (Hulpe Israëls). Architect E.M. Rood (1851–1929) chose a neo-Renaissance architectural style. Between the residential houses on the street, the synagogue Gerard Doustraat 238 hardly stands out.

name: Gerard Revebrug
en: Gerard Revebrug (bridge 403) is a fixed plate bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid. The fixed traffic bridge spans the Amstelkanaal (called the Zuider-Amstelkanaal while it was being built) and connects the Tweede van der Helststraat with the Maasstraat.
machine: Gerard Revebrug (bridge 403) is a fixed plate bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid. The fixed traffic bridge spans the Amstel Canal (during the construction of the Zuider-Amstel Canal) and connects the Tweede van der Helststraat with the Maasstraat.

name: Gerardus Majellakerk
en: The Gerardus Majellakerk is a Roman Catholic parish church in Utrecht. The church building was designed by the architect H.C. van de Leur and built around 1934. The building is valued as a municipal monument. The architecture of the church building is typical of the interwar period and is inspired by the formal style of Dom Paul Bellot.

name: Gerbrandypark
en: The Gerbrandypark is a city park in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The park is located along the Burgemeester Van Tienhovengracht in Slotermeer between the Ringspoorbaan and the Plein '40-'45. The park was laid out between 1957 and 1965 and was named in 1963 after the Dutch politician and statesman Pieter Sjoerds Gerbrandy (1885-1961).

name: Gerda Tarobrug
en: The Gerda Tarobrug (bridge 2125) is a structure under construction in Amsterdam-Oost. From August 2021, work began on the construction of this bridge that is to connect Centrumeiland and Strandeiland in IJburg. The bridge will be located over the Merdekagracht.

name: Gerrie Mührenbrug
en: The Gerrie Mührenbrug (bridge 2235) is a structure in Amsterdam-Oost. The bridge is one of the traffic bridges (the others are for slow traffic) that forms the connection within the Park de Meer neighborhood within the Watergraafsmeer, which rose from the ground here between 1998 and 2002.

name: Gerstkamp
en: The Molen van het Aldt Huys is a vanished watermill on the Lingsforterbeek in Arcen in the Dutch municipality of Venlo.

name: Geulhaven
en: The Geulhaven is a port in the Botlek area in Rotterdam. Nearby is the Nautical Service Center Botlek.

name: Geurt Brinkgrevebrug
en: The Geurt Brinkgrevebrug (bridge number 296) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The traffic bridge is located on the eastern quay of the Krom Boomssloot and crosses the Recht Boomssloot. It is the middle bridge in the Recht Boomssloot.
machine: The Geurt Brinkgrevebrug (bridge number 296) is a permanent bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The traffic bridge is located on the eastern quay of the Krom Boomssloot and crosses the Recht Boomssloot. It is the middle bridge in the Recht Boomssloot.

name: Geuzenbos
en: The Geuzenbos is a nature reserve in the Groote IJpolder between the Spaarnwoude Recreation Area, the De Heining business park and the Spaarndammerdijk northeast of Halfweg in the Amsterdam district of Westpoort. The area with an area of 60 hectares is divided in two by the Essenweg alderman. One of the entrances to the Geuzenbos

name: Gierzwaluwbrug
en: Bridge 1189 or Gierzwaluwbrug is a structure in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The bridge is located in a footpath in the Bijlmerweide park and spans a ring water around an island. It is along the extension of bridge 1187. The first bridge built here dates back to 1970.

name: Giessenbrug
en: The Giessenbrug is a complex of three bascule bridges over the Delfshavense Schie in the district of Overschie of the Dutch municipality of Rotterdam. The Giessenbrug dates back to 1967 and includes two adjacent bascule bridges on the A20 and a bascule bridge for local traffic on the Giessenweg.

name: Goereesestraat
en: The Goereesestraat is a street in Rotterdam-Charlois in the Carnisse district. The street was named by B&W of Rotterdam on December 23, 1938 after the island of Goeree. It lies along the extension of the Mijnsherenlaan, on the other side of the Pleinweg. Built as two streets separated by large grassy fields as a median strip with chestnuts on both sides.

name: Gooiseweg
en: The Gooiseweg is part of the Amsterdam city route s112 and runs from Prins Bernhardplein near Amstel station to Gaasperdam. The road is built as a motorway with level crossings, but on the first section there is also a bicycle path on both sides.

name: Goudriaankanaal
en: The Goudriaankanaal is an unfinished canal through Waterland, between IJdoorn (Durgerdam) and the east coast of Marken. It was supposed to form a new connection between Amsterdam and the North Sea. Construction began in 1826 and was stopped in 1828.

name: Goudsesingel
en: The Goudsesingel is an old, now demoted, single lane road in Rotterdam and forms the northeastern side of the Stadsdriehoek.

name: Goudvinkbrug
en: Bridge 1187 or Goudvinkbrug is a structure in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The bridge is located on a footpath in the Bijlmerweide park and spans a ring lake around an island. The first bridge built here dates back to 1970. Dirk Sterenberg of the Public Works Department designed a nearly ten-meter-long wooden footbridge that did not have bridge pillars.

name: Graadt van Roggenweg
en: The Graadt van Roggenweg is a street in the Dutch city of Utrecht. The street separates the Leidseweg and surrounding neighborhoods and the Dichterswijk, and is located near the Jaarbeurs.

name: Grenspaal
en: Grenspaal, also known as the Column-bearing Turtle or Monument of Jacob Israël de Haan is a statue in Amsterdam-Centrum. It was made by Hans 't Mannetje. The statue is located at the beginning of Jodenbreestraat, at the point where the road begins at Sint Anthoniesluis. The monument somewhat resembles a so-called banpole, once a marking point for city limits

name: Griftpark
en: The Griftpark is a park in the Dutch city of Utrecht, located in the Noordoost district on the streets Blauwkapelseweg and Kleine Singel. The stream the Biltsche Grift runs through the park, which is where the park gets its name.

name: Grimnessesluis
en: The Grimnessesluis (bridge 202) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The short traffic bridge provides the connection between the east side of the street section of the Rokin and the Oude Turfmarkt. It spans the small waterway between the Grimburgwal and the same Rokin, but then open water.

name: Groene Kruisweg
en: The Groene Kruisweg is a road of a total length of 34 kilometers, which runs from Brielle to Rotterdam, via Vierpolders, Zwartewaal, Heenvliet, Geervliet, Spijkenisse, the Spijkenisserbrug, Hoogvliet, Poortugaal and Rhoon.

name: Groene spechtbrug
en: Bridge 1186 or Groene spechtbrug is a structure in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The bridge is located on a footpath in the Bijlmerweide park and spans a ring lake around an island. The first bridge built here dates back to 1970.

name: Groene Tunnel
en: The Groene Tunnel is a 35-meter-wide canal between Haveneiland and the Grote Rieteiland, and between the northern and southern part of Haveneiland-Oost, in the residential district IJburg in the Oost district of Amsterdam. The canal crosses the district from northwest to southeast.

name: Groenewegbrug
en: The Groenewegbrug is a collection bridge in the Dutch municipality of Rotterdam. The bridge over the ring canal of the Zuidplaspolder connects the Rotterdam district of Nesselande on the west side with the municipality of Zuidplas on the east side. The Groenewegbrug is named after the nearby Groeneweg.

name: Groentemarktbrug
en: The Groentemarktbrug (bridge 156) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The traffic bridge is located in Marnixstraat. It spans a passage between on the one hand (on the center side) the Lauriergracht (with bridge 110 over it) and Lijnbaansgracht and on the other hand (west side) the Singelgracht.

name: Groentepraambrug
en: The Groentepraambrug (bridge 129) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-West. The footbridge connects Van Kinsbergenstraat with Cabotstraat and spans the Admiralengracht. The bridge is located between the Molenslootbrug and the Machineslootbrug and was built because the distance between these two traffic bridges, about 700 meters, is quite large for pedestrians.

name: Grondwetsherziening van 1848
en: De Heulstraat in The Hague is a short, centuries-old street between the Noordeinde and the Kneuterdijk. The name refers to the heul or wooden bridge that gave access to the street over the Haagse Beek.

name: Groote Museum
en: The Groote Museum is a museum on the Plantage Middenlaan in Amsterdam exploring the connections between people, animals, plants, microbes and the earth. It occupies the first floor of the former main building of Artis and is run by Artis, but can be visited independently of the zoo.

name: Grote Brouwerssluis
en: Bridge 62 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge is located on the eastern quay of the Prinsengracht and crosses the Leliegracht. The bridge forms the end of the Leliesluis, a former lock complex from the time when the Prinsengracht formed the edge of the city.
machine: Bridge 62 is a permanent bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge is located on the eastern quay of the Prinsengracht and crosses the Leliegracht. The bridge forms the end of the Leliesluis, a former lock complex from the time when the Prinsengracht formed the edge of the city.

name: Grote Wijnbrug
en: The Grote Wijnbrug is a lift bridge in the center of the Dutch city of Rotterdam. The bridge connects the Zwartehondstraat with the Wijnbrugstraat. It spans the Wijnhaven. Its name is partly due to the disappeared Kleine Wijnbrug. This is the fourth bridge in this place. The first was built between 1613 and 1616. In the 17th century this bridge was also

name: Gustav Leonhardtbrug
en: Gustav Leonhardtbrug (bridge 449 is a fixed bridge in Beatrixpark in Amsterdam-Zuid. The bridge is only suitable for pedestrians and cyclists, and leads to entrance/exit Willem Landréstraat in the composers' neighborhood.

name: Gwijde van Henegouwenbrug
en: The Gwijde van Henegouwenbrug (bridge 805) is a structure in Amsterdam-Zuid. The bridge dates back to 1960/1962 when architect Dirk Sterenberg worked for the Department of Public Works. He was allowed to design all the foot and bicycle bridges in the Gijsbrecht van Aemstelpark and even lay out the Ontmoetingseiland.

name: H. Teresia van Avila
en: The Teresia of Avilakerk, also known as the Church of the Holy Teresia of Avila, is a Roman Catholic church from 1841 located in the former city palace "Het Spaansche Hof" on the Westeinde in the Dutch city of The Hague, province of South Holland.

name: Haags Openbaar Vervoer Museum
en: The Haags Openbaar Vervoer Museum (HOVM) has been located in an old tram depot since 1989, the Frans Halsstraat depot in The Hague. This depot was built in 1906 and was in use until 1983 by the Haagsche Tramweg Maatschappij (HTM).

name: Haagse Beek
en: The Haagse Beek is a watercourse in The Hague, between the Schapenatjesduin at the end of the Machiel Vrijenhoeklaan and the Scheveningseweg. It is originally an old dune relic that collected the groundwater from the dunes. That stream was canalized from the 14th century to the Hofvijver. Part of that historic canal was dammed over in 1917. d

name: Haagse Trekvliet
en: The Haagse Trekvliet, also known as Haagse Vliet, Haagvliet or Trekvliet, is a canal that was dug in 1344-1345 at the behest of Count William IV of Holland, as a connection of the Hague canal system with the Vliet.

name: Haagseveer
en: The Haagseveer is a street in the center of Rotterdam. The Haagseveer runs parallel to the Coolsingel of the Meent to the Pompenburg. The name Haagseveer refers to a ferry connection that was maintained from this place via the Delftsevaart and the Rotterdamse Schie to The Hague. The name Haagseveer was already used in the middle of the 17th century, m

name: Haagweg
en: The Haagweg is an important route to the center of Leiden. The street is named after the Haagweg-Noord district in this Dutch city.

name: Haardsteebrug
en: The Haardsteebrug (bridge 1063) is a structure in Amsterdam-Zuidoost.

name: Haarlemmermeerstraat
en: The Haarlemmermeerstraat is a street in Amsterdam-Zuid. The street connects the Hoofddorpplein with the Surinameplein and was named in 1927 after the Haarlemmermeer. Other streets in the neighborhood are also named after places southwest of Amsterdam. The street is about 650 meters long. Halfway between Theophile de Bockstraat and the Albert Neuhuyss

name: Haarlemmerpoort
en: The Haarlemmerpoort on the Haarlemmerplein in Amsterdam is officially called Willemspoort but is never called that in the city. It is in fact the fifth gate on the side of Haarlem that appears in the history of Amsterdam. The earlier gates were part of the fortifications of Amsterdam. With each city expansion, the city gate moved a little further forward

name: Haarlemmersluis
en: The Haarlemmersluis is a 17th-century lock in the center of Amsterdam. The lock is located at the eastern end of the Brouwersgracht, on the site where the Singel flows into the IJ. The fixed bridge (bridge number 14) near the lock connects the Nieuwendijk and Haarlemmerstraat. The lock is a popular tourist attraction.

name: Haarlemmervaart
en: The Haarlemmertrekvaart is a canal built in 1631 between Amsterdam and Haarlem.

name: Haarlemmerweg
en: The Haarlemmerweg is a road in the municipality of Amsterdam, towards Haarlem. The road runs from the Nassaukade to Halfweg. The Haarlemmerweg is the longest street in Amsterdam and has a length of 8.3 kilometers.

name: Halvemaansbrug
en: The Halvemaansbrug (bridge 221) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It forms the connection between the two embankments of the Amstel (here called Binnen Amstel) in the city center of Amsterdam. On the north side there is still another embankment of the Kloveniersburgwal and 's-Gravelandseveer (embankment of the Amstel).

name: Hamburgerbrug
en: The Hamburgerbrug is a nationally protected arched bridge in the city center of the Dutch city of Utrecht. The bridge spans the Oudegracht. The Hamburgerbrug is named in a modified form after the former medieval city castle Rodenburg that stood on the northeast side of the bridge. In earlier times, the bridge was also called the Romanburg Bridge there.

name: Han Lammersbrug
en: The Han Lammersbrug (bridge no. 2202) is a pedestrian and cyclist bridge over the Westerdok in Amsterdam. The bridge connects the Westerdokskade with the Westerdokseiland, a former railway yard of NS that was redeveloped in the early 21st century as a residential area.

name: Han van Zomerenbrug
en: The Han van Zomerenbrug (bridge 402) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid. The wooden bridge that is only accessible to pedestrians (a traffic sign indicates that cyclists should disembark!) has been the connection between Pieter Lodewijk Takstraat and Waalstraat since 2009.

name: Hannie Schaftbrug
en: The Hannie Schaftbrug (bridge no. 601) is a structure in the Slotermeer district of Amsterdam Nieuw-West.

name: Hanny Michaelisbrug
en: The Hanny Michaelisbrug (bridge 405) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid. The bridge is one of the four bridges that enclose the De Kom road network. The bridge crosses the Noorder Amstelkanaal, whose south bank is called Mozartkade. It connects Stadionweg with Hobbemakade.
machine: The Hanny Michaelisbrug (bridge 405) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid. The bridge is one of the four bridges that enclose the De Kom road network. The bridge crosses the Noorder Amstel Canal, whose south bank is called Mozartkade. It connects Stadionweg with Hobbemakade.

name: Hans Kressebrug
en: Bridge 716 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The pedestrian and bicycle bridge spans the Christoffel Plantijngracht, which runs parallel to the Christoffel Plantijnpad. It is located at the height of the Johan Brakensiekhof and the Theo Mann-Bouwmeesterhof.

name: Hans Snoekfontein
en: The Hans Snoekfontein is a work of art in Amsterdam-Centrum. The fountain is named after Hans Snoek, founder of the Scapino Ballet, who financially contributed to the construction of the fountain and the renovation of the square through a legacy. Other contributions came from American Hotel and Holland Casino.

name: Haparandadam
en: The Haparandadam is a dam in Amsterdam-West. The dam forms the border between the Houthaven district and the Western Port Area. The dam is named after the Swedish port city of Haparanda on the Gulf of Bothnia, on the border with Finland, where much wood came from to Amsterdam.

name: Haringpakkersbrug
en: The Haringpakkersbrug (bridge 58) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is named after the Haring Pakkerye, the herring packers' works once located here. The name also survived in the Haringpakkerstoren, demolished in 1829 and standing north-west of the bridge's present position, and in the Haringpakkerssteeg.

name: Haringvliet
en: The Haringvliet, formerly Harinckvliet, on the east side of the center of Rotterdam is a 1590-year-old inner harbor, named after the fishermen of the herring fleet who anchored here. Later this was the harbor where the ships of the Admiralty of Rotterdam were moored and resupplied. The harbor is an eastern branch of the Old Harbor

name: Harmsenbrug
en: The Harmsenbrug is a bridge in South Holland, and part of the national highway N57. The 1968 bridge spans the Hartel Canal and the national highway A15. The bridge includes a bascule bridge over the south side of the canal that can be opened for shipping and a tunnel bridge over the north side of the canal.

name: Hartelbrug
en: The Hartelbrug or Zoetwaterkanaalbrug is a bridge in the Netherlands that forms the connection between the A15 and Spijkenisse, and spans both the Hartel Canal and the Shipping and Food Canal. The provincial road N218 (here called Hartelweg) runs over this bridge. The current bascule bridge was opened in 1968. Originally, the bridge had two lanes for

name: Hartelhaven
en: The Hartelhaven is a inland port on the Rotterdam Maasvlakte, at the end of the Hartel Canal. The Hartelhaven was ready in 1973. The main company at the Hartelhaven is the European Bulk Goods Transfer Company, where dump trucks are loaded with ores and coal. At the far northeast end of the Hartelhaven are two container cranes

name: Hartelkanaal
en: The Hartelkanaal is a canal in the Europoort. The canal runs between the left bank of the Old Maas, just before it flows into the New Maas, and the Beerkanaal on the First Maasvlakte. The canal is suitable for inland navigation CEMT class VIc. The canal is in open connection with the sea, and therefore also has a tide. The Hartelkanaal becomes

name: Hartmanbrug
en: The Hartmanbrug (bridge no. 190) is a plate bridge in Amsterdam-Oost. It is located in the Molukkenstraat and spans the Ringvaart. The bridge thus connects the Indische Buurt with the Watergraafsmeer. The quay along the Ringvaart is called Valentijnkade on the north side and Ooster Ringdijk on the south side.

name: Havankbrug
en: The Havankbrug (bridge 1265) is a structure in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The bridge was built around 1984 as a connection between two parts of the Venserpolder district, which are separated by a canal. It was built in a series of four foot and bicycle bridges: bridge 1263, bridge 1264, bridge 1265 and bridge 1266.

name: Havendienst 20
en: The Havendienst 20 was laid down in 1939 as a tugboat for a private individual on the Roode Vaart near the Gebroeders Paans shipyard in Moerdijk. The oral tradition teaches that on the shipyard there was a chance that the boat would never be dismantled during World War II. name: Havenmuseum
en: The Havenmuseum is located in and near the Leuvehaven in the South Holland city of Rotterdam. The museum collection includes ships, harbor cranes and other harbor-related objects from the period 1850-1970. The Havenmuseum has been merged with the Maritime Museum Rotterdam since September 2014.

name: Havenspoorlijn Rotterdam West
en: The Havenspoorlijn Rotterdam West was a freight railway line with four depots in Rotterdam-West on the right bank of the Maas.

name: Havenstraat
en: The Havenstraat is a street in the Schinkel neighborhood, Amsterdam-Zuid.

name: Hederabrug
en: The Hederabrug (bridge 998) is a fixed bridge in the form of a viaduct in Amsterdam-Noord. It is located over the Nieuwe Leeuwarderweg, which is surrounded here by the Noorderpark and formerly the Volewijkspark.
machine: The Hederabrug (bridge 998) is a fixed bridge in the form of a viaduct in Amsterdam-North. name: Heemraadssingel
en: The Heemraadssingel is a well-known single in Rotterdam.

name: Heemtuin Sloterpark
en: The Heemtuin Sloterpark is located in the Sloterpark west of the Sloterplas in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. After the land was raised in the 1950s, this area remained untouched for a long time. Here a rough area spontaneously developed with wild plants, reeds and willows.

name: Heibrug
en: The Heibrug (bridge no. 4) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge spans the Singel and forms the connection between the Heisteeg (towards the center) and Wijde Heisteeg (towards the west). The bridge became necessary after the city expansion at the end of the 16th century, during which the western bank of the Singel was also built up.

name: Heilige Antonius Abtkerk
en: The Antonius Abtkerk is a Roman Catholic church at the end of Scheveningseweg in The Hague. The Antonius Abtkerk is a national monument, built in 1926-1927 by architect Joseph Cuypers and his son Pierre Cuypers jr. in a commercial-expressionist style with a richly decorated art deco interior. name: Heilige Kruisvindingkerk
en: The Heilige Kruisvindingkerk is a Roman Catholic church building at Beukendaal 2 in Rotterdam.

name: Heiligewegsluis
en: The Heiligewegsluis (bridge no. 2) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge provides the connection between the western quay of the Singel and the Heiligeweg.

en: Bridge 2037 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Oost, IJburg. It is located in the Jan Olphert Vaillantlaan and runs from the Steigereiland across the IJmeer to the Diemerzeedijk on the "mainland" (there are many ponds and inland waters here).

name: Hein Donnerbrug
en: The Hein Donnerbrug (bridge number 1922) is a structure on the border of Amsterdam-Centrum and Amsterdam-Zuid. The bridge was named after Jan Hein Donner in his capacity as a chess player in 1991. The fixed concrete bridge has spanned the Singelgracht since around 1988.

name: Helsingforsbrug

name: Henriette Schwarzpark
en: The Henriette Schwarzpark is a small park in Osdorp, Amsterdam-Nieuw West. It is located between the Baden Powellweg, Ookmeerweg and Osdorper Ban. It is crossed by a foot and bicycle path section of the Osdorperweg. The park of 311 (north-south) at 78 meters (east-west) was laid out on an already existing green strip and was renovated on September 1, 2022.

name: Henriëtte van Heukelom-van den Brandelerbrug
en: Henriëtte van Heukelom-van den Brandelerbrug is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid. The bridge leads to the entrance and exit of Beatrixpark from/to Prinses Irenestraat. The bridge is located over an edge water/drainage ditch of the aforementioned park. It was designed in 1969 by architect Dirk Sterenberg working at and for the Department of Public Works.

name: Herdenkingsmonument
en: Herdenkingsmonument, also known as Commemoration and remembrance, is an artistic work of art in the Gijsbrecht van Amstelpark, Buitenveldert, Amsterdam-Zuid. The image of artist Mischa Rakier (born Delft 1970) was placed in 2014 after an order from the municipality of Amsterdam and the South District.

name: Herenbrug

name: Herepoort
en: The Herepoort was originally one of the city gates of the city of Groningen. The first Herepoort was probably built in the 11th century, the second in the 13th century, the third in the 15th century and the fourth at the beginning of the 17th century. Since 1885, the 17th-century outer gate has been in the garden of the Rijksmuseum in Amsterdam.

name: Hertogswetering
en: The Hertogswetering is a watercourse in the northeast of the Dutch province of North Brabant.

name: Hervormde Adriaen Janszkerk
en: The Adriaen Janszkerk is a Dutch church in IJsselmonde, a district of Rotterdam.

name: Het Kanaal
en: Het Kanaal (partly called Koninginnegracht) is a waterway that connects the Dutch city of The Hague and Scheveningen.

name: Het Nieuwe Verbond
en: The Onze-Lieve-Vrouw-van-Lourdes church, today the Church of Het Nieuwe Verbond, is a Roman Catholic church in the garden city Slotermeer in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The church was built in the middle of a nearly vacant area near the corner of Burgemeester Röellstraat and Slotermeerlaan, in the middle of a number of (Catholic) emergency schools.

name: Het Nutshuis
en: Het Nutshuis is the former headquarters of the Hague Nutsspaarbank. Since 2004, the building has been used as a business assembly building in which various organizations have their offices. The building is located on the Riviervismarkt at the corner of Jan Hendrikstraat, opposite the Grote Kerk in The Hague.

name: Het Slochter
en: Het Slochter is part of the North Holland Canal in North Holland.

name: Het Steiger
en: Het Steiger is a former Roman Catholic parish church and adjacent Dominican monastery in the city center of Rotterdam. Officially, the church was dedicated to St. Dominic and the monastery to St. Peter of Verona.

name: Het Veem Theater
en: Veem House for Performance, called Het Veem Theater until 2014, is a production house, workshop, stage, laboratory and centre of expertise for contemporary mime theatre, based in the Het Veem building in Amsterdam. The building stands on the Van Diemenstraat and the Oude Houthaven along the IJ, west of Centraal Station.

name: Heulstraat
en: The Heulstraat in The Hague is a short, centuries-old street between the Noordeinde and the Kneuterdijk. The name refers to the heul or wooden bridge that gave access to the street over the Haagse Beek.

name: Heysehaven
en: De Heijsehaven or Heysehaven is a port in the Rotterdam port area. The port is a branch of the Nieuwe Maas on the south side of the river and is located northwest of Heijplaat. name: HH. Laurentius- en Elisabethkathedraal
en: The HH. Laurentius- en Elisabethkathedraal is a Roman Catholic church building on Mathenesserlaan in Rotterdam, since 1967 the seat of the bishop of Rotterdam.

name: Hillegondakerk
en: The Hillegondakerk is a Dutch Reformed church in Rotterdam-Hillegersberg and is the oldest church in Rotterdam. The church has been designated as a national monument. The church was built on a dune, a sand ridge in the peatland area. The exact age of the church cannot be determined. The oldest charter about Hillegersberg dates back to the year 993.

name: Hobbemakade
en: The Hobbemakade is a street in Amsterdam-Zuid. It is the western quay of the Boerenwetering between Singelgracht and De Kom. The quay on the other side is called the Ruysdaelkade and is located in the De Pijp district.

name: Hoeckelingsdam
en: The Hoeckelingsdam is a low, 1.6 kilometer long dam in the IJmeer, intended to create calm water between the dam and the Uitdammerdijk and thereby increase the natural value of the area.
