name: Hoekenesgracht
en: Hoekenes in a street in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The street is located in several neighborhoods (including Wildemanbuurt) in Osdorp due to its length.

name: Hofbogen
en: The Hofplein Line viaduct (also known as the De Hofbogen) is a 1.9 kilometer long disused railway viaduct in Rotterdam-North. On October 1, 1908, it was put into use as part of the first electric railway line in the Netherlands, the Hofplein Line from Rotterdam Hofplein to Scheveningen. Until August 16, 2010, RandstadRail ran over the viaduct.

name: Hofkerk
en: The Parish Church of the Holy Martyrs of Gorkum is a Roman Catholic church in Amsterdam-Watergraafsmeer. As the Hofkerk it forms part of the Linnaeushof complex designed by the architect Alexander Kropholler.

name: Hoflaankerk
en: The Hoflaankerk on the corner of Hoflaan and Oudedijk is the oldest church building in the Rotterdam district of Kralingen.

name: Hoge Brug
en: The Hoge Brug is a steel lifting bridge over the Delfshavense Schie, in the district of Overschie in the Dutch municipality of Rotterdam.

name: Hoge Sluis
en: The Hogesluis (bridge no. 246) is an Amsterdam monumental double bascule bridge with ten passages, designed by Willem Springer in Parisian style. The older bridge from the 17th century was replaced by the current one in 1883.

name: Hogeweidebrug
en: The Hogeweidebrug is a steel arch bridge from 2008 over the Amsterdam-Rhine Canal. It connects the city of Utrecht with the district of Leidsche Rijn. It is a design by architect Maarten Struijs, the client was the 'Urban Development' department of the municipality of Utrecht.

name: Holendrecht
en: Holendrecht is a residential area (neighborhood) in Gaasperdam in the Amsterdam district Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The neighborhood takes its name from the river of the same name on the border of the provinces of North Holland and Utrecht.

name: Hollandse Iepbrug
en: The Hollandse Iepbrug (bridge 2470) is a movable bridge over the Noord-Hollandsch Kanaal in Amsterdam-Noord. The name is derived from the monumental Dutch elm that had to be moved out of the way in 2021 for the construction of the embankment connection.

name: Hollandse Tuin

name: Holysloter Die
en: The Holysloter Die is a creek, called "Die", located mostly in the municipality of Amsterdam and a small one in the municipality of Waterland. It is located north of the village of Holysloot, which belongs to the municipality of Amsterdam, and south of Broek in Waterland.

name: Hoofddorpweg
en: The Hoofddorpweg in the Hoofddorpplein neighborhood of Amsterdam-Zuid was built in the 1920s on the territory of the municipality of Sloten, which was annexed by Amsterdam in 1921.

name: Hooigracht
en: The Hague canal belt is the (partly 16th and especially early) 17th-century Singelsgracht that is still intact. A belt is ring-shaped, or circular, the Singelsgracht in The Hague has a different (angular) shape. That is not unique. Old Rotterdam had a triangular shape. A canal belt should not be confused with a system of interconnected waterways.

name: Hoornbeeck College
en: The Hoornbeeck College is a Reformed school that offers education at mbo level. The main branch is located in Amersfoort and there are branch offices in Apeldoorn, Goes, Gouda, Kampen and Rotterdam. The name of the school is derived from the Reformed professor Johannes Hoornbeeck. In 2020, the Hoornbeeck College was named best m for the eleventh time.

name: Horst Blankenburgbrug
en: The Horst Blankenburgbrug (bridge 2293) is a structure in Amsterdam. The bridge is one of the few traffic bridges (most are only for slow traffic) that forms the connection between Watergraafsmeer and the Park de Meer neighborhood, which was built here between 1998 and 2002.

name: Hortusbrug
en: The Hortusbrug (bridge no. 239) is a bascule bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge spans the Nieuwe Herengracht and thus connects the Muiderstraat with the Plantage Middenlaan.

name: Hortusplantsoen
en: The Hortusplantsoen is a park and street in the center of Amsterdam. The park is located on the south side of the Hortus Botanicus, between the Nieuwe Herengracht (corner Weesperstraat) and the Nieuwe Keizersgracht (near the bend where the canal transitions into the Plantage Muidergracht).

name: Houten Huis
en: Het Houten Huys is a building dating from 1528 or shortly thereafter on the Begijnhof in Amsterdam. It is one of the oldest houses in Amsterdam and, along with a building at the beginning of the Zeedijk, one of the two remaining houses with a wooden facade in Amsterdam.

name: Houtensepad
en: The Houtensepad is a street in the Dutch city of Utrecht in the Bokkenbuurt. The approximately 320-meter-long street runs from the Laan van Kovelswade to the Schaapstraat, Lamstraat and the railway.

name: Houthavenpark
en: The Houthavenpark is a park in Amsterdam-West, located between the Spaarndammerbuurt and the Houthavens district. The southern boundary of the park is formed by the Spaarndammerdijk and Tasmanstraat, the northern border is the Stavangerweg. The park is partly located on the Spaarndammertunnel, which was opened in 2018.

name: Houtmankade
en: The Houtmankade is the designation of two Amsterdam canals. The canals are located on the western and eastern shores of the Westerkanaal with the side canals being the Le Mairegracht, the Van Noordtgracht and the Zoutkeetsgracht. The western canal is located in the Spaarndammer neighborhood, the eastern one is located in the Zeehelden neighborhood.

name: Houtzaagmolen De Ster
en: Houtzaagmolen de Ster is the center of Molenerf de Ster, one of the few almost completely preserved sawmill complexes in the Netherlands. name: Houweling Telecom Museum
en: The Houweling Telecom Museum was founded in 1974 and houses the history of telecommunications in the South Holland city of Rotterdam and the region. name: Hugo de Grootgracht
en: The Hugo de Grootgracht is a canal in Amsterdam-West.

name: Hugo de Vrieslaan
en: The Hugo de Vrieslaan is a street in the Watergraafsmeer neighborhood Jerusalem in Amsterdam-Oost. The street forms a busy traffic artery. The street is named after Hugo de Vries, a Dutch biologist, botanist and geneticist (1848-1935).

en: Het Huis Bartolotti (also Het Bonte Huis) is a canal house at Herengracht 170-172 in Amsterdam. en: Bridge 8 is the official designation of a bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge had the unofficial name Huiszittenbrug until July 5, 2016, which referred to the Huiszitten warehouse. However, this name has become obsolete. The fixed plate bridge is located in the Raadhuisstraat and spans the Singel.

name: Huntumbrug
en: The Huntumbrug (bridge 1041) is a structure in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The viaduct was built in the Karspeldreef, an important traffic route for fast traffic that runs from east to west through the district. It spans the Bijlmerpleinpad, a foot and bicycle path that winds from north to south through the district.

name: HvA
en: The University of Applied Sciences for Economic Studies (HES) in Amsterdam was an HBO educational institution with programs in the field of economics and was a school with a tradition of more than 125 years. Today, it has become part of the economic education institute of the University of Amsterdam.

name: Ibisbrug
en: The Ibisbrug is a lifting bridge in the center of the Dutch city of Rotterdam. The bridge spans the Scheepmakershaven and connects the north side of the Scheepmakershaven near the Wijnbrugstraat to the Hertekade. Construction began in May 2012 and in April 2013 the bridge was put into use.

name: IJdoornlaan
en: The IJdoornlaan is an important east-west through route in Amsterdam-North. The street connects the Zuiderzeeweg in Nieuwendam-North, with Buikslotermeer, Banne Buiksloot and Landsmeer and runs under the A10 through to the Zuideinde in Landsmeer. The street is the northernmost through road in Amsterdam.

name: IJhaven
en: The Eastern Harbor Area is a residential district in the Dutch city of Amsterdam. It is also one of the fifteen districts within the Amsterdam-Oost district.

name: IJsbaanpad
en: The IJsbaanpad is a street in Amsterdam-Zuid, between the Amstelveenseweg and the Schinkel. The Amsterdamsche IJsclub (AIJC) had a field near the Schinkel in use, which was submerged in winter to create an ice surface. The road to it was therefore named IJsbaanpad in 1949. On the former ice club grounds are now tennis courts.

name: IJsselhaven
en: The IJselhaven is a pre-war port in Nieuw-Mathenesse in Rotterdam-West. The IJselhaven was dug between 1912 and 1915 and designed for the transhipment of bulk goods. After the development of the Eemhaven and the rise of the container, bulk cargo transfer in the IJselhaven has declined.

name: IJsselwetering
en: The IJsselwetering is a drainage channel in the municipalities of Utrecht and IJsselstein, which belong to the Dutch province of Utrecht. name: Il grande miracolo
en: Il grande miracolo is a war monument on the Pleinweg in the Dutch city of Rotterdam. The monument commemorates the twenty Dutch resistance fighters who were executed on March 12, 1945 by the German occupiers in Goereesestraat in Rotterdam-Zuid. The work of art by Marino Marini was purchased in 1955 to replace a simple memorial plaque.

name: Ina Boekbinderbrug
en: Ina Boekbinderbrug (bridge 416) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid. The bridge is located in the Minervalaan and spans the Zuider Amstelkanaal. Hendrik Petrus Berlage already drew this bridge on his plan for Plan Zuid from 1915. The width of the bridge was already quite narrow compared to the width of the Minervalaan.

en: The Ina Boudier-Bakkerbrug (bridge 609) is a fixed bridge in the Slotermeer district of Amsterdam. The bridge is located in Burgemeester Fockstraat and spans the Burgemeester van Tienhovengracht. The bridge was built to open up Slotermeer-Noord. The bridge has its landheads in Gerbrandypark and the southern quay of the aforementioned canal.

name: Indië-monument
en: The Indië-monument in The Hague was founded in memory of approximately 161 military personnel who were killed during the struggle in former Dutch East Indies between 1945 and 1950. The monument is located just like the Indian monument in the Scheveningen Bosjes, between the pond and the professor B.M. Teldersweg, near the Ver Huellweg.

name: Industriehavenbrug
en: The Industriehavenbrug is a steel traffic bridge in the Dutch city of Utrecht. The bridge has a passage width of 14 meters and a road surface of 8 meters wide. It was built in 1920 and renovated in 1997. It is a municipal monument. The movable bridge is located on the Keulsekade over the connection of the Industrial Port with the Amsterdam-Rhine Canal.

name: Insulindeweg
en: The Insulindeweg in Amsterdam-Oost was named in 1923 and was named after the Insulinde, the name that Multatuli had given to the then Dutch East Indies, derived from the Latin 'insula' = island. en: The Internationaal Esperanto-Instituut Foundation (Esperanto: Internacia Esperanto-Instituto; IEI) is an institute founded in 1930 in The Hague by Esperantists Julia Isbrücker and András Cseh. name: Internationaal Homomonument
en: Internationaal Homomonument The Hague is a monument from 1993 on the Koekamp in The Hague, designed by Theo ten Have. It serves as a memorial to all lesbian women and gay men in the world who have been persecuted and oppressed or are being persecuted and oppressed because of their sexual orientation.

name: Ir. B. Bijvoetbrug
en: The Ir. B. Bijvoetbrug (bridge 229) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge spans the Zwanenburgwal.

name: Isa van Eeghenbrug
en: The Isa van Eeghenbrug is a fixed slab bridge with three openings in Amsterdam-Centrum.

name: Isaac Israëlsbrug
en: The Isaac Israëlsbrug, (Bridge 408), also known as Schildersbrug, is a bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid. The bridge spans the Noorder Amstelkanaal and forms the connection between the Cornelis Schuytstraat and the Breitnerstraat.

name: J.M. de Muinck Keizerbrug
en: The J.M. de Muinck Keizerbrug in the Dutch city of Utrecht is named after the namesake of the Demka steelworks. It is a flyover bridge with four lanes that spans the Vecht River. It connects the J.M. de Muinck Keizerlaan with the Franciscusdreef. It was built around 1970 and forms the second direct connection between the Zuilen and Overvecht subdistricts.

name: Jaap Kunstbrug
en: The Jaap Kunstbrug (bridge 1926) is a structure in Amsterdam-Oost. The bridge is one of the three bridges that span the large pond of the Oosterpark. The bridge looks very similar to the Klaartje de Zwarte-Walvischbrug.

name: Jac. P. Thijsseplein

en: The Jacoba van Tongerenbrug (bridge number 602) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam Nieuw-West, Slotermeer. The traffic bridge is located in Burgemeester Fockstraat and spans the Afwateringstocht. It leads to the southern Gerbrandypark. The bridge was built in 1953 according to a design by Piet Kramer from 1950 (the date stones mention 1951).

name: Jacobibrug
en: The Jacobibrug is a nationally protected arched bridge in the Utrecht city center that spans the Oudegracht. The bridge has two spans and in the bridge abutments are bridge cellars. Adjacent to the Jacobibrug are workshop cellars and yards. Around 1300, people could already cross the Oudegracht here. The nearby Jacobikerk was built a little earlier.

name: James Rosskade
en: The James Rosskade is a street in the Bos en Lommer district in the Amsterdam municipality of West. The street runs south-north in terms of numbering and begins as such at the ventweg on the north side of the Jan van Galenstraat and ends on the southern quay of the Erasmusgracht. It runs parallel to the Einsteinweg.

name: Jan Evertsenbrug
en: The Jan Evertsenbrug (145p) is a structure in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. Although it carries the name of a bridge, it is a system of viaducts and bridges; Amsterdam usually calls viaducts bridges. The viaduct and bridge system, entirely made of concrete, is located in the Ringweg Amsterdam and spans the Jan Evertsen and a parallel waterway.

name: Jan Kuitenbrug
en: The Jan Kuitenbrug is a bascule bridge over the Old Harbor and the Wine Harbor in the center of the Dutch city of Rotterdam. It is one of the oldest bridges in the city: there was already a bridge here in 1610. The bridge was replaced in 1931 and served as an important connection for traffic entering and leaving the city during the time of the Maas Bridges.

name: Jan Pieterszoon Coenbrug
en: The Jan Pieterszoon Coenbrug is a double lift bridge in the Dutch city of Utrecht. The bridge, named after Jan Pieterszoon Coen, was built in 1897 by the contractor W. van Straten from Utrecht. name: Jan Schaeferbrug
en: The Jan Schaeferbrug (bridge number 2000) crosses the IJhaven and connects the Piet Heinkade with Java-eiland in Amsterdam's Eastern Docklands. It was designed by the architect Ton Venhoeven and is named after the politician Jan Schaefer (1940-1994). Bus line 43 runs over the bridge.

name: Jan Swammerdambrug
en: The Jan Swammerdambrug (bridge 2291) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam Oud-West. The bridge connects the Bilderdijkkade (the western bank of the Bilderdijkgracht) with the Tweede Constantijn Huygensstraat. It spans the Jacob van Lennepkanaal.

name: Jan Tooropstraat
en: The Jan Tooropstraat is a street in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The street is located in the Overtoomse Veld district and runs from Johan Jongkindstraat to Jan van Galenstraat.

name: Jan van Galenbrug
en: Bridge 382 is a bascule bridge located in Amsterdam-West. The traffic bridge (over which bus lines 18 and 80 also run) is located in Jan van Galenstraat and spans the Western Market Canal. The bridge is located just near the Centrale Markt (now called Foodcenter) which was opened in 1934.

name: Jan van Galenstraat
en: Bridge 382 is a bascule bridge located in Amsterdam-West. The traffic bridge (over which bus lines 18 and 80 also run) is located in Jan van Galenstraat and spans the Westelijk Marktkanaal. The bridge is located just near the Centrale Markt (now called Foodcenter) which was opened in 1934.

name: Jan van Galenstraat
en: The Jan van Galenstraat is a street in the Amsterdam neighborhoods of West and Nieuw-West. The street was named in 1925. It is named after the Dutch naval commander Jan van Galen (1604-1653) who died in the battle of Livorno against the English.

name: Jan van Scorelstraat
en: The Jan van Scorelstraat is a street in the Dutch city of Utrecht, which runs from the Adriaen van Ostadelaan to the Rembrandtkade and Stadhoudersbrug, after which it transitions into the Stadhouderslaan.

name: Jan van Zutphenplantsoen
en: The Jan van Zutphenplantsoen is a park and green strip in the Amsterdam district of Osdorp. name: Jansbrug
en: The Jansbrug is a national monument arched bridge in the Utrecht city center that spans the Oudegracht. The bridge has one span and in the bridge abutments there are one or more bridge cellars. name: Janskerk
en: The Janskerk stands on the Janskerkhof in the Dutch city of Utrecht. It was founded shortly after 1040 by Bishop Bernold and dedicated to John the Baptist. It was one of the five chapter churches of the city in the Middle Ages (the others were the Cathedral, the Salvatorkerk, the Pieterskerk and the Mariakerk).

name: Janskerkhof
en: The Janskerkhof is a square in Utrecht, the capital of the Dutch province of Utrecht. It is the square on which the Janskerk and the former State Chamber (Brotherhood Monastery) stand. name: Jeremiebrug
en: The Jeremiebrug is a bridge in the Dutch city of Utrecht. The current bridge spans the Kruisvaart since 2012, just before the point where it flows into the Vaartsche Rijn. The previous Jeremiebrug from 1912, a municipal monument, has been located in the Máximapark in Vleuten since 2015.

name: Jeruzalemkerk
en: The Jeruzalemkerk is a Protestant church on the Jan Maijenstraat in the West borough of Amsterdam, in the De Baarsjes district near the Mercatorplein.

name: Jewish WW2 resistance memorial
en: The Monument to Jewish Resistance 1940-1945 is a monument in Amsterdam that has stood on the corner of the Amstel and the Zwanenburgwal, on the side of the Stopera since 1988. name: Joep Langebrug
en: Joep Langebrug (bridge 417) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid.

name: Joes Kloppenburgbrug
en: The Joes Kloppenburgbrug, bridge no. 5, is a slab bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It connects the Raamsteeg with the Oude Spiegelstraat and crosses the Singel. It is a relatively narrow and slightly humped bridge with three openings for shipping, decorated with a granite artwork.

name: Johan Cruijffbrug
en: The Johan Cruijffbrug (bridge 2238) is a structure in the Dutch district of Amsterdam-Oost. The bridge is a pedestrian and bicycle bridge; it forms the connection between the Esplanade de Meer square and the Anfieldroad (street) towards Middenweg. It lies parallel to the Johan Neeskensbrug over a decorative water.

name: Johan de Witt
en: The statue of Johan de Witt is a 20th-century monument on the Place in The Hague, in memory of councillor pensioner Johan de Witt. It was made by Frederik Engel Jeltsema.

name: Johan Huizingalaan
en: The Johan Huizingalaan in Amsterdam Nieuw-West is along the Oostoever, from Robert Fruinlaan to Nieuwe Haagseweg. Along the extension is Oude Haagseweg.

name: Johan Neeskensbrug
en: The Johan Neeskensbrug (bridge 2237) is a structure in Amsterdam-Oost. The bridge is one of the few traffic bridges (most are only for slow traffic); it is located on Wembleylaan over a decorative water in the area near Park de Meer, Watergraafsmeer that rose from the ground here between 1998 and 2002.

en: The Johanna Borskibrug (bridge number 41) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It lies in the Vijzelstraat and spans the Keizersgracht.

name: Johanneskerk
en: The Johanneskerk, also known as the Johannes Center, is a Protestant church building in the Overvecht district (Moezeldreef 400) in the Dutch city of Utrecht. The church is dedicated to the evangelist John.

name: John Rädeckerbrug
en: The John Rädeckerbrug (bridge 1916) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Oost. It is located in the Th. K. van Lohuizenlaan, formerly called IJburglaan until 1998 and crosses the Lozingskanaal. Together with the similar Ad Grimmonbrug (bridge 1915), it forms the connection between the Zeeburg district and the Cruquiuseiland.

name: Johnny & Jonesbrug
en: The Johnny & Jonesbrug (bridge 433) is a fixed bridge in the Prinses Irenebuurt in Amsterdam-Zuid. The pedestrian bridge is located over the entrance to the circular central large pond of Beatrixpark. It is located next to the "permanent botanical garden". In the immediate vicinity stands the sculpture Penguins by Jan Trapman.

name: Jonas Daniël Meijerplein
en: The Jonas Daniël Meijerplein, often abbreviated as J.D. Meijerplein, is a square in Amsterdam. On the north side, the square is bordered by Mr. Visserplein and on the south side by the Nieuwe Herengracht, near the Hortusplantsoen. The M.S. Vaz Dias Bridge connects the square to the Weesperstraat. The square is located on urban route S112.

name: Joods Kindermonument
en: The Joods Kindermonument in Rotterdam is a monument on the Kop van Zuid in memory of the Rotterdam Jewish children who were deported and killed in World War II. en: The Joods monument in Utrecht is a memorial for the Jewish victims of World War II from Utrecht. Over 1600 people were deported in 1942 and 1943, only four hundred of them returned. en: Juliana van Stolberg and her five sons is a monument in the South Holland city of The Hague. It was made in 1927 by the sculptor Bon Ingen-Housz and the architect Dirk Roosenburg. name: Julianabrug
en: The Julianabrug is a monumental bridge in the Dutch city of Utrecht. It spans the Minstroom and forms a connection between the Adriaen van Ostadelaan and the Julianalaan. name: Julianapark
en: The Julianapark, named in 1939 after Princess Juliana, was a park but is now a residential area in Amsterdam Watergraafsmeer. The park was located north of Hugo de Vrieslaan, east of Amstel station and Julianaplein and was further enclosed by the Gooiseweg. The park was created after the opening of the Amstel station in 1939. Part of the park

name: Julianapark
en: The Julianapark is a city park near Julianapark and the surrounding area in the Northwest district of Utrecht. The 9.5 hectare park is bordered by the neighborhoods of Elinkwijk, Egelantier-, Mariëndaalstraat and surroundings, the Utrecht - Amsterdam railway line and the Amsterdamsestraatweg.

name: Julianaplein
en: The Julianaplein is a square in the Amsterdam neighborhood of Watergraafsmeer, Amsterdam-Oost, located near Amsterdam Amstel station.

name: Jungle River
en: Jungle River is a tree trunk attraction in the Dutch amusement park Familiepark Drievliet. The attraction was built by Reverchon and opened in 1997.

name: Jutfaseweg
en: The Jutfaseweg is a street in the Dutch city of Utrecht in the Rivierenwijk district, which runs from the Vondellaan and the Westerkade to the Giessenplein and to the place where the Vaartsche Rijn and the Merwedekanaal meet. Parallel to the Jutfaseweg runs the Vaartsche Rijn.

name: Jutphasebrug
en: The Jutphasebrug (or Jutfase Bridge) is a bridge that connects the city of Utrecht and Nieuwegein. It spans the Amsterdam-Rhine Canal. Directly next to the bridge is a railway bridge for the Utrecht light rail; the Jutphasespoorbrug. In 1984, the steel deck was replaced by a concrete deck.

name: Jutphasespoorbrug
en: The Jutphasespoorbrug (or Jutfasespoorbrug) is a tram bridge that connects the city of Utrecht and Nieuwegein. It spans the Amsterdam-Rhine Canal and is part of the Sneltramlijn Utrecht – Nieuwegein / IJsselstein. The bridge is one of the few railway bridges of the tube bridge type, alongside the Suurhoffbrug, among others.

name: Kabouterbrug
en: The Kabouterbrug (Bridge 360) is a steel lift bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid that is only accessible to pedestrians and cyclists. The bridge is located on a continuous cycling route from Vondelpark via Schinkelhavenstraat towards Amsterdam Nieuw-West to Theophile de Bockstraat.

en: The Kadoelenbrug (bridge 1787) is a bridge in Amsterdam-Noord. The name refers to the Kadoelen area north of the bridge. It was built between 29 August 2011 and May 2013 for just under 2.5 million euros, although the official opening took place on 4 July 2012.

name: Kamperfoelieweg
en: The Kamperfoelieweg is a street in Amsterdam-North.

name: Kanaalweg
en: The Kanaalweg is a road in the Dutch city of Utrecht. The Kanaalweg runs from the bicycle path under the Socrates Bridge that branches off from the Zeehaenkade, to where the Merwedekanaal flows into the Amsterdam-Rhine Canal and the city beach is located.

name: Kandelaarbrug
en: The Kandelaarbrug is a pedestrian and cyclist lift bridge, over the Delft Schie, in the Dutch province of South Holland. The lift bridge is hydraulically driven by a cylinder under the bridge deck. The bridge has, on the west side, the longest ramp in the entire area and there is a 'bend' in this ramp. en: The Karel van het Revebrug (Bridge 676) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The bridge is located in a separate pedestrian and bicycle path. That path runs partly parallel to Christoffel Plantijnpad in Sloterpark Oost, a park-like environment on the eastern bank of the Sloterplas in the Western Garden Cities.

name: Karspeldreef
en: The Karspeldreef is a dreef in the Bijlmermeer in Amsterdam-Zuidoost and runs from west to east just like the Bijlmerdreef and Daalwijkdreef.

name: Kasteel Oudaen
en: Oudaen is a fortified medieval house (also called a city castle) on the Oudegracht in the Dutch city of Utrecht. The building, with house number 99, is one of the most important monuments of the city.

name: Kattenburgerbrug
en: The Kattenburgerbrug (bridge 274) is a bascule bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The wide traffic bridge forms the connection between on one side the Prins Hendrikkade and the Kadijksplein (both southwest) and on the other side the Kattenburgerstraat, Kattenburgerplein and the Kattenburgergracht (northeast).

name: Kattenburgergracht
en: The Kattenburgergracht is a street in the center of Amsterdam that runs from Kattenburgerplein to Wittenburgergracht. North of Kattenburgerplein and canal lies the island of Kattenburg, on the southern side of it is the Nieuwe Vaart. en: The Kattenburgerplein is a square in Kattenburg in Amsterdam-Centrum. It lies along the Prins Hendrikkade, opposite Kadijksplein, across the Kattenburgerbrug over the Nieuwe Vaart. name: Kattenburgerstraat
en: The Kattenburgerstraat is a street on the island of Kattenburg between Kattenburgerplein and the Marinierskade. Before the demolition of the buildings on Kattenburg, there were two narrow streets running parallel to each other here: the Grote Kattenburgerstraat and the Kleine Kattenburgerstraat.

name: Kattenrugbrug
en: The Katterug (bridge no. 1935) is a bridge over the Hugo de Grootgracht in Amsterdam-West. The bridge connects the foot and bicycle path joining the Van Reigersbergenstraat and the Hugo de Grootkade to the Bilderdijkpark, and lies in line with the Bilderdijkkade.

en: The Kattenslootbrug (bridge 155) is a bascule bridge in Amsterdam-West.

en: The Kazernestraat is a street in the center of The Hague, which runs from Parkstraat to Denneweg. name: Kees Fensbrug
en: The Kees Fensbrug (bridge number 49) is a fixed vaulted bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge forms the connection between the Hartenstraat and Reestraat and spans the Keizersgracht. There had already been a bridge here for at least a century when the municipality of Amsterdam decided in 1881 that it should be lowered.

name: Keilehaven

name: Keileweg
en: The Keileweg is an approximately 800-meter-long side road of the Vierhavensstraat in the Nieuw-Mathenesse business park near the Nieuwe Maas in Rotterdam - Delfshaven. Between 1990 and 2000, this was the tipping zone of Rotterdam. The Keileweg is named after the former Keilepolder in which it lies and runs parallel to the Keilehaven.

name: Keizersbrug

name: Keizersgracht
en: The Keizersgracht is the third of the four Amsterdam main canals that together form the canal belt. With a width of one hundred Amsterdam feet, it is the widest canal in the center of Amsterdam.

name: Keizersgrachtkerk
en: The Keizersgrachtkerk is a church of 1888, originally Reformed, on the Amsterdam Keizersgracht. The building at number 566, between the Leidsestraat and the Nieuwe Spiegelstraat, was designed by the architects Gerlof Bartholomeus Salm and Abraham Salm, father and son.

name: Kerk van Eikenduinen
en: The Kerk van Eikenduinen, better known as the Ruine or Chapel of Eikenduinen, was a Roman Catholic church building located in the old dunes between Loosduinen and The Hague. name: Kerk van Zunderdorp
en: The Kerk van Zunderdorp is the Reformed Dutch Kerk van Zunderdorp in Amsterdam-North. It is a plastered hall church with buttresses, built in 1711 against the late Gothic tower without buttresses of the previous church. The tower dates back to the 15th century, has three floors and is equipped with a balustrade and a tent roof.

name: Ketelhuis
en: Het Ketelhuis is a Dutch film theater that has been located in the Westergasfabriek cultural park in Amsterdam since 1999. Dutch films, European arthouse films, documentaries and family films are screened.

name: Keulsekade
en: The Keulsekade is a street in the Dutch city of Utrecht, which runs from just past the Adikade to the Havenweg. name: Kids Marina
en: Kids Marina is a children's harbor where electric boats sail in the heart of Rotterdam. The special thing is that such a police boat, fire brigade boat, container boat, harbor service vessel or even a rainbow boat may be operated independently by children from three years of age. However, of course, at least 1 adult must always be on board.

name: KidZcity
en: KidZcity is an indoor amusement park in Utrecht, also known as an indoor attraction park. Here children up to 12 years old can climb, slide, run and jump. There are several attractions including Ferris wheels, laser game and bumper cars.

name: Kinkerbrug
en: The Kinkerbrug (bridge no. 266) is a bridge over the Kostverlorenvaart in Amsterdam-West. It connects the Kinkerstraat with the Postjesweg and the Witte de Withstraat, and between 1990 and 2010 formed the boundary between the former boroughs of De Baarsjes and Oud-West.

name: KINO

en: The Kinselmeer is a Dutch lake in the province of North Holland north of Durgerdam and east of Ransdorp (Amsterdam municipality). It is located on the IJsselmeerdijk (Uitdammerdijk) between Durgerdam and Uitdam, and was formed during the Saint Elizabeth's Flood of 1421. en: The Kleine-Gartmanplantsoen is a square and park in the center of Amsterdam. It lies along Leidseplein and is often considered part of this square. On the southeast side, the Weteringschans flows into the Kleine-Gartmanplantsoen. The park also borders the eastern part of the Lijnbaansgracht and the Ziesenisk here at bridge 198.

name: Kleinesingel
en: The Kleinesingel, also spelled Kleine Singel, is a street in the Dutch city of Utrecht in the district de Wittevrouwen, which runs from the Wittevrouwensingel to the Kapelstraat, Gildstraat and the Blauwkapelseweg where it merges into it.

name: Kleinpolderplein
en: The Kleinpolderplein is a Dutch traffic junction in the north of Rotterdam. It forms the connection between the A13 in north-south direction and the A20 in east-west direction. en: The Klimopbrug (bridge 999) is a fixed bridge in the form of a viaduct in Amsterdam-Noord. It is located over the Nieuwe Leeuwarderweg, which is surrounded here by the Noorderpark and formerly the Volewijkspark.

en: The Kolksluis is a fixed bridge (bridge 302) and lock (lock 108) in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge is located in the Zeedijk and spans the Oudezijds Kolk in the heart of Amsterdam. The bridge is located in the Wallengebied. The bridge is surrounded by national monuments on both the dike and the kolk.

name: Koningin Emmaplein
en: The Koningin Emmaplein is a square in the Shipping Quarter of Rotterdam, bordering the Westzeedijk, directly opposite the Museum Park. The Koningin Emmaplein was built between 1888 and 1891 according to a design by architect J.C. van Wijk. On the square are 15 townhouses, designed in the style of the neo-Renaissance. en: The Koningin Wilhelminahaven or 'New Harbor' is a (municipal) commercial and fishing harbor in the Dutch municipality of Vlaardingen that was built along the Nieuwe Maas from the end of the nineteenth century. name: Koninginnebrug
en: The Koninginnebrug is a bridge over the Koningshaven in the Dutch city of Rotterdam, next to De Hef.

Over the Koningshaven lie two monumental bridges: the Koninginnebrug for urban traffic and the disused railway bridge "de Hef" (Koningshavenbrug). name: Koningskerk
en: The Koningskerk is a church in the Amsterdam district of Watergraafsmeer. It is located on Van 't Hofflaan. The Koningskerk was built between 1954 (first pile August/September 1954) and 1956 (the tower is still on the scaffolding in January; dedication March 21, 1956) as a Reformed church. name: Koningstunnel
en: The Koningstunnel is a traffic tunnel in the center of The Hague. The route connects Lekstraat and Koningskade, where the tunnel gets its name. There is an underground exit to Bezuidenhoutseweg. name: Koningsweg
en: The provincial road N411 runs from Utrecht to Bunnik. The road begins in Utrecht as Koningsweg, is called Koningslaan from the municipal boundary to the hamlet of Vechten and from there simply Provincialeweg. The N411 ends in Bunnik at the junction with the A12, where the road continues on to the N229 towards Wijk bij Duurstede.

name: Korrelbrug
en: The Korrelbrug (bridge 143) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid.

name: Kors van Bennekombrug
en: Kors van Bennekombrug (Bridge 2009) is a structure in Amsterdam-Oost. The bridge is located in the Vennepluimstraat and provides the connection between the northern and southern part of the Westelijk Haveneiland in IJburg. It crosses the Groene Tunnel canal.

en: The Korte Minrebroederstraat is a street in the center of the Dutch city of Utrecht. The Korte Minrebroederstraat runs from the Ganzenmarkt and Minrebroederstraat to the Oudkerkhof. The only side street of the Korte Minrebroederstraat is the Annastraat.

name: Korte Nieuwe Uitleg
en: The Hague canal belt is the (partly 16th and especially early) 17th-century Singelsgracht that is still intact. A belt is ring-shaped, or circular, the Singelsgracht in The Hague has a different (angular) shape. That is not unique. Old Rotterdam had a triangular shape. A canal belt should not be confused with a system of interconnected waterways.

name: Korte Ouderkerkerbrug
en: The Korte Ouderkerkerbrug (bridge 1962) is a bicycle and pedestrian bridge located in the Overamstel district on the right Amstel Riverbank in Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Korte Prinsengracht
en: The Unicorn Lock (lock no. 103) is a lock in the Haarlemmerdijk between the Prinsengracht and the Korte Prinsengracht in Amsterdam. name: Kortenoordsehaven
en: The Kortenoordsehaven is a dug harbor in Rotterdam Charlois, on the left bank of the Maas at kilometer 1004. The length is 360 meters, width 70 meters, depth NAP -4.50 meters. The harbor entrance is linked to that of the Barendrecht harbor. The harbor is accessible by land via the Sluisjesdijk.

name: Korzo Theater
en: Korzo is a theater and production company from The Hague. The theater and production company was founded in the early 1910s and organizes music and dance performances from Australia, Asia, Europe, North, South and Central America. It is the largest dance production company in the Netherlands.

name: Kostverlorenvaart
en: The Kostverlorenvaart in Amsterdam-West is the connection between the Schinkel and the IJ. Since the end of the 19th century, the connection with the IJ has been formed by the Kattensloot, Singelgracht and the Westerkanaal.

name: Koushaven
en: The Koushaven, dug in 1912 in Nieuw-Mathenesse in Rotterdam-West, was the last designed, but the first completed port in the Four Harbors area. The port owes its name to the Kous, a navigable ditch that in earlier times separated Delfshaven from the Ruigeplaat, which had formed in front of the Delfshaven harbor entrance in the Nieuwe Maas.

name: Kraan 2868
en: Kraan 2868, also called the Figeekraan, is a former harbour crane on KNSM-eiland in Amsterdam-Oost. It is a luffing crane, with a jib adjustable in height rather than fixed, and has been a municipal monument since 29 November 2011.

name: Kraansluis
en: The Kraansluis (bridge 300) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge is located in the Prins Hendrikkade and crosses the mouth of the Waalseilandgracht to the Open Havenfront. The bridge is located in the aforementioned quay in the extension of bridge 301 (Kolkwaterkering) and bridge 299 (Hoofdbrug).

name: Kralingse Verlaat
en: The Kralingse Verlaat is a lock with pointed doors between the Hoge Boezem and the Kralingse Plas in the municipality of Rotterdam, in the Dutch province of South Holland. The waterway is CEMT class 0, access to the pond is almost exclusively important for pleasure boating.

name: Krattenbrug
en: The Krattenbrug is a fixed bridge over the Delftsevaart in the Dutch city of Rotterdam. The original bridge probably existed since the fifteenth century and was one of the few structures that had survived the bombing on May 14, 1940. name: Kreeksehaven
en: The Kreeksehaven is a section of an former drainage canal of the irrigation system of the island of IJsselmonde that flowed into the Zuiddiepje. name: Krijtbergbrug
en: The Krijtbergsluis (bridge no. 3) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge is located on the southwestern quay of the Singel and spans the Beulingsloot in the Amsterdam canal belt.

name: Kriterion
en: Film theater Kriterion, officially the Association for Mutual Student Support Kriterion (V.O.S.S. Kriterion), is a student-run cinema and student association at Roetersstraat 170 in Amsterdam. It emerged from the student resistance during World War II.

name: Kromme Nieuwegracht
en: The Kromme Nieuwegracht is a canal in the center of the Dutch city of Utrecht. Side streets of the Kromme Nieuwegracht are Ambachtstraat, Muntstraat, Pieterstraat, Nobeldwarsstraat and the Jeruzalemstraat. During excavations, Roman soil finds were found, which indicate that water already flowed here at the time when the Romans were in Utrecht

name: Krommerijnbrug
en: The Krommerijnbrug is a fixed bridge in the Dutch city of Utrecht. It spans the Kromme Rijn, which flows into the Stadsbuitengracht below. The Ledig Erf transitions onto the bridge into the Tolsteegsingel and the Abstederdijk. The bridge has two spans and is designed in stone with iron balustrades. In its current form, it was built in 1905

name: Kromwijkdreef
en: The Kromwijkdreef, part of urban route S113, connects Karspeldreef in the Bijlmermeer in Amsterdam-Zuidoost with Langbroekdreef and Loosdrechtdreef in Gaasperdam near the Gaasperpark.

name: Krugerplein
en: The Krugerplein is a square in the Transvaalbuurt in Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Kruisvaart
en: The Kruisvaart is a waterway in the Dutch city of Utrecht that was formerly also known as Bloemgracht.

name: Kunstbrug
en: Kunst (bridge 1987) is a structure and a structure in Amsterdam-Oost. The wrought iron footbridge is located on the island of Java and spans the Majanggracht. That canal was dug at a time when the island of Java became a residential destination with gardens in between.

name: Kunstliefde
en: The Kunstliefde society is an Utrecht association of artists and art lovers, founded in 1807. It is one of the oldest art societies in the Netherlands. At the two-hundredth anniversary in 2007, there were more than a hundred artists affiliated with the society. Kunstliefde is located at Nobelstraat in Utrecht.

name: KV Fiducia
en: KV Fiducia is a korfball club founded on March 22, 1963 in Vleuten. The club plays at "Sportpark Fletiomare-Oost" on the outskirts of Vleuterweide, part of the Vleuten-De Meern district in Utrecht.

name: L.H. Sarlouisbrug
en: The L.H. Sarlouisbrug (bridge 240) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The traffic bridge is located in the Weesperstraat and spans the Nieuwe Keizersgracht. name: Laak
en: The Laak is an ancient peat river that runs through The Hague. Through the Laak, the water was discharged towards the Haagvliet. The Laakmolen and the Broekslootmolen were tasked with grinding the excess water in the Noordpolder into the Vliet's basin. The district around the peat stream is called Laakkwartier and Spoorwijk.

name: Laakhaven
en: The Laakhaven in The Hague was built in 1900 as a branch of the Haagvliet. Thus, the port is connected to the Vliet between Leiden and Delft. Part of the Laakhaven lies parallel to the Neherkade. The port developed into an important inland port, but that is over: partly the port serves as a transit port.

name: Laakkanaal
en: The Laakkanaal in The Hague (street name: Soestdijksekade, Troelstrakade) was dug in 1924 as a connection between the Loosduinsevaart and the Laakhaven in connection with the transport over water of horticultural products from the Westland. In 1932, the wholesale market for vegetables and fruit moved from the Veenkade to a site near the Laakkanaal.

name: Laaktheater
en: The Laaktheater is a list theater located on Ferrandweg in the Spoorwijk district in The Hague. The theater has a theater hall with 135 seats on a semicircular balcony, a large studio for dance lessons, among other things, and a small studio. Regular users are Laaks Youth Theater, Medea theater and Filmclub Laak.

name: Laan Copes van Cattenburch
en: The Laan Copes van Cattenburch is a busy, stately avenue in the Archipelbuurt neighborhood in The Hague. The avenue was laid out in 1870 and is named after mayor Lodewijk Constantijn Rabo Copes van Cattenburch and is part of the Centrumring around the Hague city center.

name: Laan op Zuid
en: The Laan op Zuid is a 2.5 km long avenue in the Rotterdam district of Feijenoord.

name: Laan van Spartaan
en: Laan van Spartaan is a residential neighborhood in the Amsterdam district of West, formerly district of Bos en Lommer. The neighborhood is bordered by the dike of the Ringspoorbaan in the west, Jan van Galenstraat in the south, the Ringweg (A10) in the east and the Erasmusgracht in the north.

name: Lage Erfbrug
en: The Lage Erfbrug is a steel bascule bridge over the Delfshavense Schie, in the district of Delfshaven in the Dutch municipality of Rotterdam. The Lage Erfbrug lies along the Nieuwe Binnenweg. name: Lamonggracht
en: The Lamonggracht is a canal with associated embankments in Amsterdam-Oost, classified under the Indian Quarter.

name: Landelijk monument spoorwegongevallen
en: The Landelijk monument spoorwegongevallen in Utrecht is located in Park Nieuweroord, near the NS main buildings, De Inktpot and Utrecht Central Station. The monument was designed and made by Anton Broos and was unveiled in 2004.

name: Landscheidingsweg
en: The S200 is a city route in The Hague that forms the northwest part of the Ring Road of The Hague.

name: Langbroekdreef
en: The Langbroekdreef is a dike in the subdistrict Nellestein in the Gaasperdam district in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The dike is largely elevated in accordance with the starting points of the urban planning plan for the expansion that was then still called Zuid Bijlmer.

name: Lange Bretten
en: De Bretten, and sometimes also called the Lange Bretten, is a nature reserve in the Amsterdam municipality of Nieuw-West with an area of 130 ha. name: Lange Nieuwstraat
en: The Lange Nieuwstraat is a street in the city center of the Dutch city of Utrecht.

name: Lange Vliet
en: The Lange Vliet is a canal dug around 1385 in the province of Utrecht. This river running from south to north has a length of more than 3 km. The beginning of this river is in the Heicop polder south of the A12 motorway near De Meern, and its end is the confluence into the Leidse Rijn, close to the Meern Bridge. name: Langeweg
en: Langeweg is a village in the Dutch municipality of Moerdijk, province of North Brabant. The village has about 895 inhabitants and 258 houses and is the smallest core of the municipality of Moerdijk. The village of ten streets is surrounded by agricultural land on which arable farming and horticulture is carried out.

name: Lapjesmarkt
en: The Lapjesmarkt in Utrecht is a textile and stationery market. The market is held in the Breedstraat every Saturday from 8:00 am to 1:00 pm. During the coronavirus crisis in 2021, the patchwork market was canceled, while other Utrecht markets continued.

name: Lau Mazirelbrug
en: The Lau Mazirelbrug (bridge 259) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge was named in 1982 after lawyer and resistance fighter Lau Mazirel (1907-1974). The traffic bridge forms the connection between the quay of the Nieuwe Keizersgracht, the Nieuwe Kerkstraat and Roetersstraat from the southwest and the Plantage Kerklaan from the northeast.

name: Laurenskerk
en: The Grote or Laurenskerk is a church building on Kerkstraat/Nieuwstraat in the center of the North Holland town of Weesp. The church was built between 1429 and 1462 as a late Gothic cruciform church, on the site where a Romanesque church had previously stood. From 1489, a seven-hour college was attached to the church with paid and professional singers.

name: Le Mairegracht
en: The Le Mairegracht is a canal in the West district of Amsterdam. The name was established by council decision of November 20, 1878. name: Lee Millerbrug
en: The Lee Millerbrug (bridge 2080) is a bridge still to be built in Amsterdam-Oost. The bridge will be built in 2023 and 2024 and will provide the connection between Centrumeiland and Strandeiland within the IJburg district in Pampuslaan. The bridge will then span the Merdekagracht.

name: Leeghwaterbrug
en: The Leeghwaterbrug is a bridge in The Hague, in the southern district of Laak. The bridge was named this in 1956 and was previously known as the "Slachthuisbrug" (Slaughterhouse Bridge). The road surface of the bridge is part of the Leeghwaterplein. The Hague tram lines 1, 16 and 17 run over the square and the bridge. The bridge spans the Laakhaven, a canal.

name: Leeuwenputbrug
en: The Leeuwenputbrug (bridge 371) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Noord. This traffic bridge is located in the Grasweg and spans the Buiksloterkanaal. On the east side of the canal, the Grasweg exits onto the Ranonkelkade.

name: Lekstraatsynagoge
en: The Lekstraat Synagogue stands at Lekstraat 63 in the Rivierenbuurt in Amsterdam. It is an important centre for the Haredi Jews living in Amsterdam and the surrounding area. Several hundred Haredim live in Amstelveen and Amsterdam, mainly in the Rivierenbuurt and Buitenveldert.

name: Leliesluis

name: Leonard Springerbrug

name: Leuvehaven
en: The Leuvehaven is a port in Rotterdam located near the center of Rotterdam and the Erasmus Bridge. The port is used, among other things, as an outdoor museum for the Maritime Museum Rotterdam. The Leuvehaven has a direct connection to the Nieuwe Maas via a passage between the Mainland and the Boompjes.

en: The Nieuwe Doelenstraat is a street in the city center of Amsterdam. The street runs along the Kloveniersburgwal and runs from the corner with Staalstraat in a southwest direction to the Oude Turfmarkt, where the Doelensluis crosses the Rokin. en: The Hemweg in the Western Harbor Area of Amsterdam was named in 1938 and was named after the former promontory the Hem in the former IJ, south of Zaandam. The word is the same as 'ham', which is only known as 'inham' anymore.

The 141-meter-long traffic bridge forms a connection with the existing Nieuwe Houtenseweg, one side of which begins at the Oude Mereveldseweg and ends at the Furkabaan in the Lunetten district.

name: Nieuwe Passeerdersstraat
en: The Nieuwe Passeerdersstraat is a street in the Jordaan in Amsterdam-Centrum.

name: Nieuwe Tolbrug
en: The Nieuwe Tolbrug in the Dutch town of Voorburg (also known as Kippetjesbrug or Kippenbruggetje) is a lift bridge over the Vliet dating back to 1891/1892. During construction, the bridge was built as a fixed bridge. In 1919, the bridge was converted into a lift bridge. The bridge is a national monument.

name: Nieuwe-Wercksbrug
en: The Nieuwe-Wercksbrug (bridge no. 63) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It connects the Westermarkt with the Rozengracht, spanning the Prinsengracht at the Oude Wester.

name: Nieuwegracht
en: The Nieuwegracht is one of the most famous canals in the city center of the Dutch city of Utrecht. It is also the name for the two streets on either side of this canal. Characteristic are the many monumental canal houses, the warehouse cellars, yards with trees, and bridges.

name: Nieuwendammerkerk
en: The Nieuwendammerkerk is the village church of the dyke village of Nieuwendam in Amsterdam-Noord. It does not stand along the Nieuwendammerdijk but slightly lower behind it on the Brede Kerkepad. It is a handsomely sited village church with a graveyard around it.

name: Nieuwendammersluis
en: The Nieuwendammersluis is a historic lock in the Nieuwendammerdijk in Amsterdam-North. It was originally a sea lock in the Nieuwendammerdijk, which was part of the Waterlandse Zeedijk and the Noorder IJ and Zeedijk.

name: Nijlhaven

en: The Noorder Amstelkanaal is a canal in Amsterdam-Zuid. The canal was dug as part of the Plan Zuid by architect H.P. Berlage. It was built to facilitate the development of Nieuw Zuid.

name: Noorder IJplas
en: The Noorder IJplas is a sand mining pond in the former Noorder IJpolder in northwest Amsterdam. The polder is one of the IJpolders drained in 1872 along the North Sea Canal.

name: Noorderbrug
en: The Noorderbrug in the Dutch city of Rotterdam is a bridge over the Rotte near the Noordplein. The bridge forms the connection between the Oude Noorden and Crooswijk. It is 40 meters long and 20 meters wide.

name: Noorderkanaal
en: The Bergsluis is a lock in the Noorderkanaal in Rotterdam, in the Dutch province of South Holland. The lock is located between the Rotterdam Schie and the lower Rotte. The waterway is CEMT class 0. The lock dates back to 1938. The lock is 86.00 m long and 6.00 m wide. The threshold depth on the west side is KP −2.35 m, on the east side KP −2.30 m.

name: Noorderpark
en: The Noorderpark is a park in Amsterdam-North. It was created in 2014 after the merger of the Florapark and Volewijkspark located on either side of the North Holland Canal.

name: Noordersluis
en: Noordersluis is an industrial area in the Lelystad-Haven district in Lelystad. The district has an area of 2 km². In addition to companies, there is a vocational school located in the east of the industrial area and there are some residential neighborhoods in the industrial area. In Noordersluis there live 402 people, of whom 226 men and 176 women.

name: Noordsche Compagniebrug
en: The Noordsche Compagniebrug (bridge 54) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge connects Herenstraat with Prinsenstraat and crosses the Keizersgracht. The bridge, itself a municipal monument since 1995, is surrounded by national monuments.

name: Noordzeeweg
en: The Noordzeeweg is a connecting road in Amsterdam Westpoort and connects the Basisweg at the T-intersection with the Hornweg with the Westpoortweg and Luvernes. The road was named after the North Sea by a council decision of April 26, 1978.

name: Noordzijde
en: The Noordzijde is a street in Amsterdam Slotermeer. This is also the north bank of the Sloterplas. Since 2017, the Noordzijde, along with the northern bank of the Sloterplas, has been designated as a Municipal Protected Urban Landscape.

name: Oesjesduiker

en: The Oetewalerbrug (bridge no. 189) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Oost. It spans the Ringvaart of the Amsterdam Watergraafsmeer. It provides the connection between Linnaeusstraat, until 1878 Oetewalerweg, and Middenweg in the former Overamstelse Polder with the Watergraafsmeer drainage works.

name: Old Harbour Rotterdam
en: The Old Harbor, also Oudehaven and Oude haven, is one of the oldest harbors in Rotterdam, in the Dutch province of South Holland. It is located in the center of the city, southeast of Rotterdam Blaak station.

name: Oldegaarde
en: The Oldegaarde is a road in Charlois on Rotterdam-Zuid. The road connects the Groene Kruisweg via the Zuiderparkweg with the Vaanweg. It forms the northern border of the Pendrecht and Zuidwijk neighborhoods and the southern border of the Zuiderpark.

en: The Omar-Al-Faroukmoskee is a mosque on Winterboeidreef in Utrecht. The building was originally built as the Roman Catholic Emmaus Church.

name: Onbevlekt Hart van Maria
en: The Onbevlekt Hart of Mariakerk, also known as the Marlotkerk, is a Roman Catholic church building on Bloklandenplein in The Hague.

en: The Onze Lieve Vrouw Hemelvaartkerk is a Roman Catholic church in Loosduinen in the Dutch city of The Hague. The church belongs to the community of "Maria van Eik en Duinen", part of the parish of the Parish of the Four Evangelists. The church is located on the Loosduinse Hoofdstraat.

name: Onze Lieve Vrouwe Kapel

name: Ookmeerweg
en: The Ookmeerweg is a continuous road in Amsterdam-Nieuw-West. The name of the street was established by a municipal council decision on April 17, 1957. en: The Oostelijk Marktkanaal is a canal in Amsterdam-West. name: Oosterparkkerk
en: The Oosterparkkerk stands on the west side of the Oosterpark in Amsterdam, in the Oosterparkbuurt.

name: Oosterstroom
en: The Oosterstroom is an ancient canal in the Dutch city of Utrecht. The watercourse lies directly north of the city center on the border of the neighborhoods Lauwerecht and Vogelenbuurt. On the south side, this approximately 400-meter-long canal runs towards the Stadsbuitengracht (Weerdsingel).

name: Oostertocht
en: Oostertocht is a district, located in the town of Heerhugowaard in the Netherlands. The district borders 't Kruis, Huygenhoek, the Molenwijk and the Rivierenwijk. Construction began in the district around 1994 and around 2001 the district was completed as a whole. In 2012-2013 drainage was replaced in part of the district due to a high groundwater level.

name: Oostertoegang
en: The Oostertoegang is a short canal in Amsterdam-Centrum, directly east of Central Station, that connects the IJ to the Geldersekade and the Open Havenfront between Stationsplein and Prins Hendrikkade.

name: Oostmolenwerf
en: The Oostmolenwerf is a street in the Dutch city of Rotterdam, which runs from the Maasboulevard to the Burgemeester Van Walsumweg, Oostzeedijk and the Oostplein, where it merges into it. Side streets of the Oostmolenwerf are the Admiraliteitskade, the Haringvliet and the Nieuwehaven.

name: Oostoever
en: Oostoever is a street in Amsterdam Nieuw-West, located mostly in the Oostoever Sloterplas neighborhood.

name: Oostplein
en: The Oostplein is a traffic square in Rotterdam. The Oostplein is the eastern point of the city triangle and is located on the site of the former Oostpoort.

name: Open Havenfront
en: The Open Havenfront is the water between the Prins Hendrikkade and the Stationseiland in Amsterdam. Over this water lie three wide bridges, equipped with separate lanes for cars or footpaths and tram rails: the Western Access Bridge (bridge no. 13), the Sint Nicolaas Bridge (Middle Access Bridge; bridge no. 306) and the Kamper Bridge (bridge no. 285).

name: Opstandingskerk
en: The Opstandingskerk is a monumental church building in the Dutch city of Utrecht. The church is located in the Zuilen district. It was built in 1957 for the Apostolic Society according to a design by Anthonie de Ridder. The building is valued as a municipal monument. Currently, a Dutch Reformed church is located there.

name: Opstandingskerk
en: The Opstandingskerk is a church in Amsterdam West, at Bos en Lommerplein 325 on the western part of the square. While it was still being built it acquired the nickname Kolenkit, coal scuttle, because its 48-metre bell tower resembles one. The name stuck so well that the surrounding neighbourhood was named after it: the Kolenkitbuurt.

name: Oranjeboomstraat
en: The Oranjeboomstraat is a street in the Rotterdam district of Feijenoord. While the rest of the Dutch people emphasize the second syllable when pronouncing the name (Oránjeboomstraat), the Rotterdammers do so only on the fourth, and they pronounce the name as Oranjebóómstraat.

name: Oranjebrug
en: The Oranjebrug is a bascule bridge in the city of Utrecht, spanning the Vaartsche Rijn. The bridge has a single passage opening for ships up to and including CEMT class II. It forms a relatively important link between the Hoograven neighborhood (eastern bank) and the Rivierenwijk (western bank), and is located between the Waalstraat and the Diamantweg.

name: Oranjebrug

en: The Orgelpark is an art center in Amsterdam where the organ is central. It was opened on January 20, 2007. The Orgelpark provides the opportunity to combine organ music with other forms of art, such as dance, ballet and theater. There are several organs, but also other keyboard instruments present.

name: Osdorpergracht
en: The Osdorpergracht is a short canal in the Osdorp district in the city of Amsterdam. The canal was dug during the construction of the district and runs from the Sloterplas, near the apartment buildings of Torenwijck, along Osdorpplein and L. van Sonsbeeckstraat to the Hoekenesgracht at Tussen Meer.

name: Osdorperwegbrug
en: The Osdorperwegbrug, also known as Viaduct Rijksweg 5 - Osdorperweg, designated by its operator Rijkswaterstaat as Kunstwerk 512, is a viaduct over the Osdorperweg in the municipality of Amsterdam. name: Oude Haagseweg

en: The Oude Hortus refers to the garden, which from 1723 to 1920 was the botanical garden (hortus botanicus) of the University of Utrecht. The Oude Hortus is located between Lange Nieuwstraat and Nieuwegracht.

name: Oude Kerk Charlois

The tower was ready as early as 1660. The Reformed Neighborhood Church Charlois of the Protestant Kerk in the Netherlands uses the church building.

name: Oude Kinkerbrug

The Appeltjesmarkt lies to its north-east and Amsterdam's police headquarters of 1941 to its south-east. The Europarking car park is also nearby.

name: Oude Lutherse Kerk

name: Oude Waalsdorperweg

name: Oudekerksbrug

name: Oudemanhuispoort

name: Oudkerkhof
en: The Oudkerkhof is a street in the Dutch city of Utrecht, running from the Stadhuisbrug in the west to the Domstraat in the east. A side street is the Korte Minrebroederstraat on the north side. The Oudkerkhof is located in the city center near one of the oldest places in the city. Between 690 and 780 AD, there was a cemetery here next to the castle Trecht.

name: Our Lady of Good Counsel Church
en: The Onze-Lieve-Vrouw-van-Goede-Raadkerk, or simply the Goede-Raadkerk, is a Roman Catholic church building on Bezuidenhoutseweg in the Hague district of Bezuidenhout. The church is dedicated to Our Lady of Good Counsel. Today, the church is used by the English-speaking Catholic parish Church or Our Savior.

name: Overschiebrug-Noord
en: The Overschiebrug-Noord (bridge 655) and Overschiebrug-Zuid (bridge 665) are two works of art in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The two viaducts span the Overschiestraat. They provide the connection between the Henk Sneevlietweg and the Rijksweg 10/Ringweg-West.

name: Overschiebrug-Zuid
en: The Overschiebrug-Noord (bridge 655) and Overschiebrug-Zuid (bridge 665) are two structures in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The two viaducts span the Overschiestraat. They provide the connection between the Henk Sneevlietweg and the Rijksweg 10/Ringweg-West.

name: Overtoom
en: The Overtoom is a street in the West district of Amsterdam, between the Stadhouderskade and the Amstelveenseweg. The current Overtoom was called the Heiligeweg from 1345, because it led to the Miracle of Amsterdam. Along the Heiligeweg ran the Heiligewegsevaart, later called the Overtoomsevaart. A section of Overtoom was called Vondelkade for a short time.

name: P.W. Janssen
en: The Monument Peter Wilhelm Janssen is a monument on Bellamyplein in Amsterdam-West. The image made by Bart van Hove was unveiled on May 29, 1908 by Jacob Theodoor Cremer, former minister of colonies and also chairman of the committee, who wanted to commemorate Peter Wilhelm Janssen, entrepreneur, philanthropist and co-founder of the Deli Maatsch

name: Paardenkathedraal
en: The Paardenkathedraal is a theater on Veeartsenijstraat in the Wittevrouwen district in the Dutch city of Utrecht. The building is a former riding school of the Rijks Veeartsenijschool, the later Faculty of Veterinary Medicine of the University of Utrecht.

name: Paddepoel
en: Paddepoel is an area north of the city of Groningen, located globally between the Reitdiep and the Paddepoelsterweg, with Wierumerschouw as the northernmost point. This area also contains the Paddepoel urban district. Paddepoel is located in the municipality of Groningen as well as the municipality of Het Hogeland.

name: Paerlduiker
en: Paerlduiker is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge connects the Kattenburgergracht and Wittenburgergracht, both "canals" being only quays of the Nieuwe Vaart. It therefore also forms a connection between Kattenburg and Wittenburg. It spans the southern extension of the Kattenburgervaart.

name: Paleis Lofen
en: Lofen was a palace of the German emperors that was built around 1020 in Utrecht on the Trecht castle. This palace was located between the current Domplein and the Oudegracht and bordered the immunity of the ecclesiastical area within the castle. name: Paleis voor Volksvlijtbrug
en: The Paleis voor Volksvlijtbrug (bridge no. 248) is a fixed bridge on the boundary of Amsterdam-Centrum and Amsterdam Oud-Zuid. It connects the Westeinde on the north side with the Stadhouderskade, the south quay of the Singelgracht, and the Van Woustraat, spanning the Singelgracht. Tram line 4 runs over it.

name: Paleiskerk
en: The Paleiskerk or Baptist church in The Hague is a neo-Romanesque church from 1886 on Paleisstraat, near Paleis Noordeinde.

name: Pancratiuskerk
en: The Sint-Pancratiuskerk is a Roman Catholic church in the village of Sloten. The first Sloterkerk is first mentioned in a charter of Bishop Willem I (van Gelre) from 1063. name: Papiermolensluis
en: The Papiermolensluis is a vaulted bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. Sluis is the "old" word for a stone bridge, although there was also a lock here. The traffic bridge forms the connection between the eastern quay and the odd side of the Prinsengracht and the corresponding quay and side of the Korte Prinsengracht. It crosses the Brouwersgracht.

name: Paradijskerk
en: The Paradijskerk is an old Catholic church building on the Nieuwe Binnenweg in Rotterdam.

name: Park de Gagel
en: Park de Gagel is a park in the Overvecht district of the city of Utrecht. The name comes from the nearby Fort De Gagel. name: Park De Kuil
en: Park de Kuil is a park in Amsterdam Nieuw-West.

name: Park de Schinkeleilanden
en: The Park Schinkeleilanden is located in Amsterdam-Zuid west of the Olympic Stadium along the Schinkel. From the Olympic Quarter, the park can be reached via the Jan Wilsbrug. The railway line from Haarlemmermeer station in the direction of Amstelveen is located over two (almost) islands between the Schinkel and the Stadiongracht.

name: Park de Watertoren
en: Park de Watertoren is a large park in the Overvecht district in the Dutch city of Utrecht. The park was laid out around 1975, around the 1935 water tower. The park is crossed by the Marnedreef and the Moezeldreef.

name: Park Groot Zandveld
en: Park Groot Zandveld is a partly built city park in the Utrecht neighborhood/subdistrict Het Zand, which is part of the Leidsche Rijn district. The relatively small-scale area was developed at the beginning of the 21st century with the construction of the Vinex site Leidsche Rijn.

name: Park Nieuweroord
en: Park Nieuweroord is a park in the Dutch city of Utrecht. It is located on the west side of the Inner City. Previously, Nieuweroord consisted of a country house and a park on and around this location.

name: Park Somerlust
en: Park Somerlust is a park in Amsterdam-Oost

name: Park Transwijk
en: Park Transwijk is a city park in the Dutch city of Utrecht. The park was built between 1956 and 1964, at the same time as the construction of the southwestern districts of Transwijk and Kanaleneiland. A strict design was used in the layout. In 2001, the park was redesigned again. The park includes a children's farm, among other things.

name: Parkhaven
en: The Parkhaven is a harbor from the period of the turn of the century to the twentieth century, located between the Lloyd Quarter and the Park in Rotterdam. The Parkhaven was dug between 1890 and 1893 and was equipped between 1903 and 1908 for the transfer of bulk goods, as on the east side, where warehouses of Van Ommeren stood.

name: Parnassusweg
en: The Parnassusweg is a street in the Amsterdam district of Zuid. The street was named in 1929 after the Greek mountain Parnassus.

name: Pastoorsbrug
en: The Pastoorsbrug (bridge 55) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge is located on the southern quay of the Brouwersgracht and crosses the Keizersgracht. It is therefore the northernmost bridge over that canal that does not continue on the other side of the Brouwersgracht.

name: Pathé Buitenhof
en: Pathé Buitenhof is a cinema in The Hague at the Buitenhof of Pathé Nederland.

name: Pathé City
en: The Pathé City is a Pathé cinema at Kleine-Gartmanplantsoen 15-19 in Amsterdam, 40 meters from Leidseplein and diagonally opposite De Balie. The cinema is located in the City Theater building, a theater building from 1935. Initially, it was set up with a single large theater hall. name: Pathé de Kuip
en: Pathé de Kuip was opened in 2002 and is a megaplex operated by Pathé Netherlands. The cinema has 14 halls spread over 3 floors with a total of 2746 seats. name: Pathé de Munt
en: Pathé de Munt is a large cinema in the center of Amsterdam of cinema operator Pathé. The cinema is located on Vijzelstraat not far from another Pathé cinema: Pathé Tuschinski in Reguliersbreestraat. Both cinemas border each other behind the shops on Reguliersbreestraat. The cinema has 13 rooms, divided over three

name: Pathé Rembrandt Utrecht
en: Pathé Rembrandt Utrecht is a cinema on the Oudegracht in the Dutch city of Utrecht. The cinema is part of the Pathé cinema chain and has three halls (the smallest number of all Pathé cinemas in the Netherlands) with a total of 683 seats.

name: Pathé Utrecht Leidsche Rijn
en: Pathé Utrecht Leidsche Rijn is a Dutch cinema in Utrecht. The building is located on Berlinplein, on the roof of the Leidsche Rijntunnel on the A2. The cinema has seven halls (1574 seats), the largest of which can accommodate over 284 visitors. The theater also has a rooftop terrace with views of the city. Since 2017, in

name: Paulusbroedersluis
en: The Paulusbroedersluis (bridge no. 215) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It spans the Oudezijds Achterburgwal in the Wallengebied in Amsterdam. The bridge thus connects the Oude Doelenstraat with the Oude Hoogstraat. The bridge owes its name to the Sint-Paulusbroederklooster that stood here in the Middle Ages.

name: Paulusbrug
en: The Paulusbrug is a national monument arched bridge in the center of the Dutch city of Utrecht. The bridge spans the Nieuwegracht and has a single span. On the bridge border are yards, a stone yard staircase and yard cellars. The Hamburgerstraat and Herenstraat run along the Paulusbrug. The Paulusbrug is one of the oldest bridges over this end-14th-century

name: Pauluskerk
en: The Willem de Zwijgerkerk or Sint-Pauluskerk is a Roman Catholic parish church on the Willem de Zwijgerplantsoen in the Dutch city of Utrecht. The church has a hexagonal shape and is built according to the central building. On the roof there is a bell tower.

name: Pauluskerk
en: Pauluskerk is a church building on Mauritsweg in the center of Rotterdam. The first Pauluskerk there was inaugurated in 1960 by the Reformed Church of Rotterdam (now part of the Protestant Church in the Netherlands) and was demolished in 2007. At the same location, church activities resumed in 2013 in a new futuristic-looking building.

name: Pelikaanbrug
en: The Pelikaanbrug (bridge number 277) is a lifting bridge from 1984 in Amsterdam-Centrum, near the Oosterkerk. The bridge spans the Nieuwe Vaart, from the Hoogte Kadijk in the south to the Wittenburgergracht in the north. The bridge is exclusively accessible to pedestrians and cyclists.

name: Persoonshaven
en: The Persoonshaven is a port on Feijenoord in Rotterdam, on the left bank of the Nieuwe Maas.

name: Pesthuysbrug
en: The Pesthuysbrug (bridge 181) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam Oud-West.
machine: The Pesthuysbrug (bridge 181) is a permanent bridge in Amsterdam Oud-West.

name: Petemayenbrug
en: The Petemayenbrug is a double drawbridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The name is said to be derived from petemoeien (godmother), also a term for old women. It connects Bokkinghangen with Zandhoek, both western docks of the Westerdok. Bokkinghangen is located on the former Bolwerk Blauwhoofd (Zeeheldenbuurt), Zandhoek on the Realeneiland.

name: Peter Postbrug
en: The Peter Postbrug (bridge 2162) is a structure in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The district Laan van Spartaan, in which this bridge is located, was developed in the early 21st century. Sports fields, once located on the outskirts of the city, were increasingly built on and Amsterdam needed space for housing.

name: Petroleumhaven
en: The Petroleumhaven is a port in the Amsterdam port area.

name: Petruskerk
en: The Petruskerk is a Protestant church in the former village of Sloterdijk, now part of Amsterdam-West.

name: Philips Willembrug
en: The Philips Willembrug is a bridge in the Dutch city of Rotterdam, in the Hillegersberg district. The bridge has a free passage height of KP +2.82 m and the width is 9.44 m. The bridge crosses the Rotte at the height of the Hillegersberg-Zuid district. The bridge is named after Prince Philip Willem of Orange (1554-1618).

name: Pia Beckbrug
en: The Pia Beckbrug (bridge number 1868) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Slotervaart in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The bridge was built to open up a neighbourhood whose streets are named after jazz musicians such as Louis Armstrong, Duke Ellington and Count Basie.

name: Pianola Museum
en: The Pianola Museum in the Jordaan is a music museum in Amsterdam that offers an overview of the history and way of playing the pianola, a 'self-playing' musical instrument that was built between 1900 and around 1935. The museum's collection includes more than 100 instruments from that time. Regular concerts with kl take place in the museum

name: Piet Bakkerbrug
en: The Piet Bakkerbrug (bridge number 715) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The traffic bridge, over which bus line 63 also runs, is located in Pieter Calandlaan and spans the Christoffel Plantijngracht.

name: Piet Dickentmanbrug
en: The Pieter Dickentmanbrug is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Oost. It is located on the edge of the Sportheldenbuurt on the Zeeburgereiland. It lies along the Nida Senffstraat and crosses the moat to the IJburglaan. The bridge was built in a package of five, which all have the same design.

name: Piet Heinkade
en: The Piet Heinkade is a street in the Eastern Harbor Area of Amsterdam. The quay runs along the extension of the De Ruijterkade (along the north side of Central Station) in an easterly direction to Rietlandpark, where it transitions into the Panamalaan. The street is part of the ring road S100. The Piet Heinkade was named after vice admiral Piet Hein in 1919

name: Piet Keizerbrug
en: The Piet Keizerbrug (bridge 2234) is a structure in Amsterdam-Oost. The bridge is a pedestrian and bicycle bridge; it forms the connection between the Esplanade de Meer square and the Stade de Colombes (street). It lies parallel to the Sjaak Swartbrug over a decorative water.

name: Piet Meerburgbrug
en: The Piet Meerburgbrug (bridge 234) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The traffic bridge spans two parallel culverts. These culverts connect an ornamental pond in the Hortus Botanicus Amsterdam with the water of the Nieuwe Keizersgracht.

name: Piet Peelenbrug
en: The Piet Peelenbrug (bridge 786) is a fixed bridge in Osdorp, Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The foot and bicycle bridge from 1984 forms the connection between the Verlengde Hoekenespad and Stadspark Osdorp and spans the Hoekenesgracht. On the west side of the bridge are two of the four sculptures from the sculpture group Markering by Adriaan Rees.

name: Piet Wiedijkpark
en: The Piet Wiedijkpark is a park in the Amsterdam district of Osdorp, Amsterdam Nieuw-West.

name: Pieter Calandlaan
en: The Pieter Calandlaan is a street in Amsterdam Nieuw-West.

name: Pieter de Hoochbrug
en: The Pieter de Hoochbrug is a double bascule bridge from 1932 in the Delfshaven district in the Dutch municipality of Rotterdam. It is a bridge over the Coolhaven, which was dug in 1922, the connection between the Nieuwe Maas and the Delfshavense Schie. The bridge is located along the Pieter de Hoochweg. name: Pieter Goemansbrug
en: The Pieter Goemansbrug is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is named after lyricist Pieter Goemans and was previously unofficially known as Bestedelingenbrug and/or Bestedelingensluis after the once nearby Bestedelingenhuis (a home for orphans and paupers, or bestedelingen).

name: Pistoolhaven
en: The Pistoolhaven is a port in Rotterdam's Europoort on the Beerkanaal. The main user is the Loodswezen, but among others the Rotterdam Port Authority also uses it. Heliport Maasvlakte was or is also located here, used by the Loodswezen.

name: Planciusspoorbrug
en: The Planciusspoorbrug is a railway viaduct in Amsterdam-Centrum in the Netherlands. The bridge spans the north-south running Planciusstraat, its direct namesake, both are named after Petrus Plancius. Until November 2017, the bridge was known as S6 and S7 (rail bridge 6 and 7).

name: Plantage Doklaan
en: The Plantage Doklaan is a street in the Plantagebuurt of Amsterdam. The street runs along the Entrepotdok, which was built in 1857, and is named after it. name: Plaquette Chet Baker
en: The Plaquette Chet Baker is an artistic work of art in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is a small tribute to the trumpeter Chet Baker. He died on the night of May 12 to 13, 1988, presumably under the influence, falling out of the window of Hotel Prins Hendrik, located at Prins Hendrikkade 52-58. He was almost unrecognizable after falling on a canal boat in Amsterdam.

name: Plein Theater
en: The PleinTheater in Amsterdam-Oost is a stage for small-scale theatre, dance, contemporary classical music, youth theatre and neighbourhood activities.

name: Pleinweg
en: The Pleinweg is an important traffic artery on Rotterdam-Zuid in the district of Charlois. The road connects Maastunnelplein with Strevelsweg at Zuidplein. It is part of the tunnel traverse.

name: Plesmanlaan
en: The Plesmanlaan is a street in Amsterdam - Nieuw West. The street runs along the Heemstedestraat, from the viaduct (Heemstedespoorbrug) of the Ring Line. The road runs to the village of Sloten, where the Plesmanlaan crosses the Osdorperweg into the Langsom street that leads to the Sloterbrug to Badhoevedorp.

name: Plompetorenbrug
en: The Plompetorenbrug is a nationally protected arched bridge in the center of the Dutch city of Utrecht. It is also the name of a street at this location. The bridge spans the Plompetorengracht which flows out under the bridge into the Stadsbuitengracht. The bridge has a single span and south of it are unused construction basements.

name: Plompetorengracht
en: The Plompetorengracht is a short canal and street in the city center of Utrecht.

name: Pniëlkerk
en: The Pniëlkerk is a monumental church building in the Dutch city of Utrecht. The church named after the biblical place Pniniel, originally built for Reformed people, is located near Oog in Al. name: Poldervaart
en: The Poldervaart is a partially canalized waterway in the Netherlands, between the Schie south of the Kandelaar and the Nieuwe Maas between Schiedam and Vlaardingen.

name: Polderweg
en: The Polderweg is a street in Amsterdam-Oost. The Polderweg runs from Linnaeusstraat in a northeast direction. At the railway line between Amsterdam Muiderpoort and Amsterdam Science Park there is a bend and the street continues in a southeast direction to bridge 2360 over the Ringvaart.

name: Pompenburg
en: The Pompenburg is a street in the Dutch city of Rotterdam, between the Goudsesingel and the Hofplein. It is part of the city route S100 Centrumring. The street was named in 1949. Before World War II, this place was located on the Pompenburgsingel, which ran along the medieval city wall.

name: Poortershaven
en: Poortershaven is a small industrial area and a former port in the east of the Rotterdam municipality of Hoek van Holland. It is located on the Nieuwe Waterweg, just before the Schenkeldijk, against the municipal border with Maassluis.

name: Posthoornkerk
en: The Posthoornkerk, official name Our Lady of the Immaculate Conception, is a church building on Haarlemmerstraat in Amsterdam. The architect of the Posthoornkerk was P.J.H. name: Postjeswetering
en: The Postjeswetering in Amsterdam-West was built in its current form in the 1920s as part of Plan West. The canal has been in the De Baarsjes district since 1990.

name: President Allendelaan
en: The President Allendelaan is an important main street in Amsterdam-West (S207) that connects the districts Slotermeer and Osdorp. The avenue runs from north to west, runs along the Slotermeerlaan and begins at the Sloterparkbad and the end point of tram line 7.
