name: President Kennedylaan
en: The President Kennedylaan is a street in the Amsterdam Rivierenbuurt in the Zuid district.

name: Prins Bernhardplein
en: The Prins Bernhardplein is a square in the Amsterdam district of Watergraafsmeer. The square is located north of Amstel station and Julianaplein, south of Wibautstraat, west of Gooiseweg and east of Mr. Treublaan. The square was put into use on October 15, 1939 at the same time as the opening of Amstel station.

name: Prins Hendrikkade
en: The Kattenburgerplein is a square in Kattenburg in Amsterdam-Centrum. It lies along the Prins Hendrikkade, opposite Kadijksplein, across the Kattenburgerbrug over the Nieuwe Vaart. From the square, traffic can continue to the island of Kattenburg via Kattenburgerstraat, or via Kattenburgergracht to the other Eastern

name: Prins Maurits en de burgers van Den Haag
en: Prins Maurits en de burgers van Den Haag is a monument in honor of Prince Maurice located on the Heerenbrug in The Hague. The monument commemorates the fact that between 1613 and 1619 the citizens of The Hague, at the request of Maurice, dug a moat around the city that served as a defense of the city.

name: Prins Willem-Alexandersluis
en: The Oranjesluizen are a complex of sluice gates in the IJssel River. They form the border between the Inner and Outer IJssel and contribute to keeping the water level in the North Sea Canal at a constant level. They also ensure that too much salty water does not enter the IJsselmeer from the North Sea Canal.

name: Prinsengracht
en: The Prinsengracht is a canal in Amsterdam that runs parallel to the Keizersgracht. The canal, named after the Prince of Orange, is the fourth of the four main canals belonging to the Amsterdam canal belt.

name: Prinsensluis
en: The Prinsensluis (bridge no. 60) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum.

name: Prinses Alexiahaven
en: The Prinses Alexiahaven is a Dutch port on the Rotterdam Second Maasvlakte. The port has a length of 7.62 km and is named after Princess Alexia of the Netherlands.

name: Prinses Amaliahaven
en: The Prinses Amaliahaven is a container port on the Rotterdam Second Maasvlakte. The port is located next to a 380 kV high-voltage substation and has a length of 5.76 km. The port is named after Princess Catharina-Amalia. On February 22, 2021, it was announced that the expansion of the port with 2.4 km of harbor quay walls was to be awarded.

name: Prinses Amaliaplein
en: The Prinses Amaliaplein is a square in Amsterdam-Zuid. The square can already be seen on Hendrik Petrus Berlage's Plan Zuid from 1917. It forms the final piece of the Minervalaan towards the Zuiderstation. However, it would take several years before the city reached this point, but the site plan has hardly changed. name: Prinses Arianehaven
en: The Prinses Arianehaven is a port on the Rotterdam Second Maasvlakte. The port has a length of 4.76 km and is named after Princess Ariane of the Netherlands.

name: Prinses Irenebrug
en: The Prinses Irenebrug is a bridge in the Dutch city of Rotterdam, in the Hillegersberg district. The bridge has a height in closed position of KP +1.30 m, in raised position KP +2.90 m since its replacement in 2005, and the width is 5.70 m. The bridge crosses the Rotte and connects the Molenlaankwartier and Terbregge districts.

name: Prinses Irenestraat
en: The Prinses Irenestraat is a street in the Amsterdam district of Zuid, on the edge of the Zuidas. The street was named in 1953 and was named after Princess Irene, daughter of the then queen Juliana. The western part of the street changed its name after the renaming of Parnassusweg in 1977. name: Prinses Julianakerk
en: The Prinses Julianakerk in The Hague is a church in the Scheveningen district of Duindorp. The church was built in a commercial-expressionist style and is located at the corner of Nieboerweg, Tesselsestraat and Vlielandsestraat. The architect W.Ch. Kuijpers also designed the Nieuwe Badkapel in Scheveningen.

name: Prinses Margriethaven
en: The Prinses Margriethaven is a port on the Rotterdam Second Maasvlakte and is named after Princess Margriet of the Netherlands. The port is located next to the APM Terminal and the Futureland visitor center.

name: Prinsessegracht
en: The bridges in The Hague were given names and numbers by the Hague Municipal Works, later incorporated into the Department of Urban Management, which were also applied to the bridges themselves through a GW number. Later these became DSB numbers.

name: Prinsestheater
en: The Prinses Theater is a theater in Delfshaven, Rotterdam. The American actress Jayne Mansfield promoted her film The Girl Can't Help It there in 1957, Lee Towers received the Wolfert van Borselenpenning there in 2000.

name: Professor Joop van Stigtpark
en: Professor Joop van Stigtpark is the unofficial name of a park-like environment in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The park was named in 2013, when neighbors developed an initiative for naming a green strip with watercourse between the Gouden Leeuw and Groenhoven apartment blocks. This collection of apartments was built around 1974 according to the design of architect

name: Puntbrug
en: The Puntbrug is a swing bridge in the center of the Dutch city of Rotterdam. The bridge spans the Wijnhaven and connects the tip of the island between the Wijnhaven and the Scheepmakershaven to the north side of the Wijnhaven. The bridge is named after that point. In popular parlance, it is also known as the Kronkel (after its shape).

name: Puntegaalstraat
en: The Puntegaalstraat is a street in the Rotterdam district of Delfshaven. Among the inhabitants of the city, the street is better known as the Plukmekaalstraat; this after the office of the Tax and Customs Administration, which was located on this street from 1948 to 1996, where people felt "plucked bald".

name: Purmerplein
en: The Purmerplein in Amsterdam-North is a square in the village of Nieuwendam, which has belonged to the municipality of Amsterdam since 1921. The Purmerplein forms the center of Tuindorp Nieuwendam, an expansion district with mainly worker housing that was built between 1924 and 1934 under the direction of the Municipal Housing Service Amsterdam.

name: PVCV
en: PVCV (Patronaats Voetbalclub Vleuten) is an amateur football club from Vleuten in the Dutch municipality of Utrecht in the province of the same name.

name: Quintijnsbrug
en: The Quintijnsbrug is a nationally protected arched bridge in the center of the Dutch city of Utrecht. The bridge spans the Nieuwegracht, a canal that was built at the end of the 14th century. The stone bridge has a single span and one or more bridge cellars. On the bridge border a stone dockyard staircase, docks and dockyards.

name: Rachel Ruyschbrug
en: Bridge 25 is a bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It forms the connection between the Oude Spiegelstraat and the Wolvenstraat in the area of the Negen Straatjes in the Amsterdam canal belt. It spans the Herengracht. The bridge has three passage openings, the widest is 5.65 meters wide and has a height of 1.79 meters.

name: Radio Museum
en: The Rotterdams Radio Museum Foundation was founded in 1988 by Harry de Jong sr., a former director of the Correct company. Volunteers work in the museum, located near NS Station Noord in the South Holland city of Rotterdam. The museum is open on Thursdays, Fridays, Saturdays and Sundays in the afternoon and is free to enter.

name: Radioweg
en: The Velibor Vasovićbrug (bridge 1906) is a structure in Amsterdam-Oost. A concrete bridge, but then under number 426, provided the connection between the Watergraafsmeer district and the neighboring municipality of Diemen from 1983. These were then separated by the Ringweg-Oost and a ring ditch of Diemen. A single span was chosen at the time.

name: Railway bridge over the Vliet
en: The Spoorbrug over de Vliet (also known as the High Bridge) is a railway bridge over the Vliet, located between the Dutch towns of Leidschendam and Voorburg.

name: Ravensbrück memorial
en: Vrouwen van Ravensbrück 1940-1945 is a monument on the Museumplein in Amsterdam commemorating the Dutch victims of Ravensbrück, the Nazi concentration camp for women in Germany.

name: Raw Aron Schuster Synagoge
en: The Raw Aron Schuster Synagoge or the Obrechtsjoel (בית כנסת רב אהרן שוסטר) is the largest still functioning Ashkenazi synagogue (shoe) in Amsterdam. The synagogue, located at the corner of Jacob Obrechtplein and Heinzestraat in Amsterdam-Zuid, is part of the Jewish Community in Amsterdam, the NIHS. Most choepot (Jewish weddings) are held here.

name: RDM Campus
en: The RDM Campus is a campus on the site of the former Rotterdam Dry Dock Company (RDM), in the middle of Rotterdam's City Harbors. The area is being developed in phases into an attractive location for educational institutions and companies with an emphasis on sustainability. name: Recreatieplas Strijkviertel
en: The Strijkviertelplas, official name Recreatieplas Strijkviertel, is a recreational lake in the city of Utrecht. The name Strijkviertel is that of a road nearby.

name: Rederijbrug
en: The Rederijbrug is a bascule bridge in the center of the Dutch city of Rotterdam. The bridge spans the Scheepmakershaven and forms the transition from the Rederijstraat to the Glashaven. This is the second bridge in this place.

name: Reesluis
en: The Reesluis (bridge 64) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum.

name: Regentessebrug
en: The Regentessebrug is a fixed bridge in the Dutch city of Rotterdam. The bridge connects the Posthoornstraat with the Glashaven over the Wijnhaven. The Regentessebrug was built in 1898 to replace a wooden drawbridge and is one of the few pre-war structures that survived the bombing on May 14, 1940. The bridge is also popularly known as the

name: Rembrandt van Rijn statue
en: The Rembrandt monument is a 19th-century memorial to the painter Rembrandt van Rijn on the Rembrandtplein in Amsterdam. It is the oldest surviving statue in Amsterdam and was the first statue of a visual artist in the Netherlands.

name: Retirobrug
en: The Retirobrug (bridge 920) is a structure in Amsterdam-Noord.

name: Rhijnspoorplein
en: The Rhijnspoorplein is a square in Amsterdam-East and -Center. It is located between Weesperplein and Wibautstraat and is part of the Amsterdam city route s112, between the IJtunnel and the Gooiseweg. The square got its name in 1939. Previously, this was the Weesperpoort station from 1843 to 1939.

name: Rhijnspoorplein
en: The Rhijnspoorplein is a square in Amsterdam-East and -Center. It is located between Weesperplein and Wibautstraat and is part of the Amsterdam city route s112, between the IJtunnel and the Gooiseweg.

name: Riekerhavenbrug
en: Bridge 307 is a metal lifting bridge in southwest Amsterdam. The pedestrian and cyclist bridge is located in the Jaagpad and spans the dividing line between the Riekerhaven and Schinkel. Less than 10 meters west lies the Uiverbrug (bridge 2208), a "real" traffic bridge that has been connecting the Generaal Vetterstraat with the Valschermkade since 2003.

name: RiF010
en: RiF010 is an artificial water sports area with a water basin in and around the Steigersgracht, in the heart of Rotterdam. The area is located between the Hoogstraat and the Blaak; the water basin is located between the Grotemarkt and the Wezenbrug, just behind the Markthal.

name: Rijksakademie van beeldende kunsten
en: The Royal Academy of Fine Arts (also Royal Academy of Fine Arts) in Amsterdam was the highest art training institution in the Kingdom of the Netherlands from 1820 to 1870. name: Rijnhaven
en: Rijnhaven is a former port of Rotterdam in transformation into a residential and working area within the Kop van Zuid district. The Rijnhaven is one of the oldest ports on the south bank of the Nieuwe Maas.

name: Rijnhavenbrug
en: The Rijnhavenbrug, locally known as the Hoerenloper, is a pedestrian and cyclist bridge over the Rotterdam Port in the Dutch city of Rotterdam. The bridge forms a connection between the Wilhelminapier at Hotel New York and Katendrecht.

name: Rijswijkseplein
en: The Rijswijkseplein is one of the busiest squares in The Hague. It is located between the Hoefkade and the Weteringkade, in the cross direction between the Zieken and the Rijswijkseweg, and close to Hollands Spoor station.

name: Rijswijkseweg
en: The Rijswijkseweg in The Hague, together with its extension, the Haagweg in Rijswijk, forms the connection between the Hoornbrug and the Rijswijkseplein. Traditionally, this was an important access road to The Hague from Utrecht and Rotterdam. This only changed with the opening of the Utrechtsebaan.

name: Ringvaart
en: The Ringvaart in Amsterdam-Oost is the name of the northern and eastern part of the ring canal around the Watergraafsmeer polder, which was reclaimed in 1629. The Ringvaart also forms the border of the Watergraafsmeer district (until 1921 a separate municipality and from 1987 to 1998 a district of Amsterdam).

name: Ringvaart van de Haarlemmermeerpolder
en: The Ringvaart van de Haarlemmermeerpolder is the more than 60 kilometer long ring road that runs around the Haarlemmermeerpolder.

name: Ringvaart van de Zuidplaspolder
en: The Ringvaart van de Zuidplaspolder is a canal in South Holland with a length of approximately 34 kilometers. The canal has a flexible water level of -2.30 m above sea level to -2.05 m above sea level. If mills and intakes are not used, the level is approximately at -2.15 above sea level everywhere.

name: Ringvaartbrug A5
en: The Ringvaartbrug A5, designated as Kunstwerk 511, is a structure in the province of North Holland. The structure is located on the Rijksweg 5 / Westrandweg and crosses the Ringvaart of the Haarlemmermeer. The architectural firm Zwarts & Jansma Architecten was responsible for the design of this national road and all its structures.

name: Rita Reysbrug
en: The Rita Reysbrug (bridge number 1866) is a fixed bridge in Slotervaart, Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The bridge was built to open up a neighbourhood whose streets are named after jazz musicians such as Chet Baker, Duke Ellington and Count Basie.

name: Rooseveltlaan
en: The Rooseveltlaan is a street in the Rivierenbuurt in Amsterdam-Zuid. The avenue is characterized by the poplars standing on either side of the carriageway. Unlike originally the Amstellaan and the Noorder Amstellaan, there is no wide central lawn.

name: Rosa Overbeekbrug
en: The Rosa Overbeekbrug (bridge no. 121) is a bridge over the Bloemgracht in the Jordaan in Amsterdam. The bridge connects the Eerste Bloemdwarsstraat with the Tweede Leliedwarsstraat. There has been a bridge here for centuries. Both Balthasar Florisz. van Berckenrode and Joan Blaeu included a bridge in their plans from 1625 and 1649.

name: Rosarium
en: The Rosarium Oudwijk in the Dutch city of Utrecht is a rose garden in the Wilhelminapark neighborhood and surroundings on the east side of the city. name: Sartreweg

en: The Schenkkade in the Hague district of Bezuidenhout runs parallel to the Schenkwetering, which was mentioned as early as the 14th century. name: Scheurhaven
en: The Scheurhaven is a port in Rotterdam's Europoort on the Caland Canal. It is located at the head of the North Sea Road on the Landtong of Rozenburg between the Caland Canal and the Nieuwe Waterweg. The port is mainly used by tugboats, but also by oil-containment vessels from HEBO.

name: Scheveningsebrug
en: Scheveningsebrug is the name of a bridge in the northwest of the historic city center of The Hague. This bridge is the connection of the Noordeinde over the Noord Singelsgracht to the Zeestraat. In the past, the bridge was also often called the Noord-Valbrug and the Noordeinde Brug.

name: Scheveningseweg
en: The Scheveningseweg is a long, straight street between the old center of The Hague and Scheveningen, which was built in 1665 according to a design by Constantijn Huygens.

name: Schie-Schiekanaal

name: Schiedamsedijk

name: Schiehaven

name: Schieweg
en: Schieweg (Schieoevers) is a district in Delft, in the Dutch province of South Holland. The district borders the Delft Schie. There are few houses, it is mainly an industrial area. name: Schinkel
en: The Schinkel is a small canalized river in Amsterdam, in the Dutch province of North Holland. The river runs from the (former) Overtoomse Sluis to the Nieuwe Meer.

name: Schollenbrug

name: Schottenburchsbrug

name: Seinehaven
en: The Seinehaven is a port in the east of the Europoort area in Rotterdam on the Hartel Canal. The port was built in 1969. Districenter Botlek, the Botlek factory of Lyondell Chemical Company and the Holland Terminals of PSA-HNN are located here, among others.

name: Seranggracht

name: Servaasbrug

There it forms the southernmost bridge over the Nieuwegracht that flows out under the bridge into the Stadsbuitengracht.

name: Seychellen

name: Shadow quay
en: De Schaduwkade is a monument to two hundred Jewish residents of the Nieuwe Keizersgracht in Amsterdam who were murdered in the Second World War. It consists of two hundred metal plates bearing the residents' names, grouped around the number of the house where they lived on the other side of the water.

name: Siegerpark
en: The Siegerpark is a small city park on the Sloterweg in the Riekerpolder in Amsterdam-Nieuw-West. The name is not recorded in the Basic Registration of Addresses and Buildings.

name: Simon Carmiggelt
en: The Bust of Simon Carmiggelt is a work of art in Amsterdam-Centrum. In November 1987, writer Simon Carmiggelt, a well-known Amsterdam personality, died. Soon after, the idea came up to have a statue erected in the city as a tribute. Friends, acquaintances of the writer and the public under the leadership of actor Ton van Duinhoven raised money. name: Singelgrachtbrug
en: The Houtmanspoorbrug, colloquially known as the Singelgrachtbrug, is a system of lift bridges in Amsterdam-Centrum, near the Spaarndammerbuurt district. The bridge spans the Westerkanaal with its western quay, the Houtmankade. Until November 2017, the bridge was known as S4 (rail bridge 4) or Singelgrachtbrug.

name: Singelkerk
en: The Singelkerk is a church of the Mennonite congregation in Amsterdam, lying between the Singel and the Herengracht. It is a clandestine church, one that is not recognisable as a church from the outside.

name: Sint Agneskerk
en: The Sint-Agneskerk is a Roman Catholic church on Beeklaan in The Hague. The church building and the congregation are part of the parish of Maria Sterre der Zee. The church was built in 1902 and 1903 under the direction of the architectural firm of Albert Margry and Jozef Snickers.

name: Sint Jobshaven
en: The Sint Jobshaven is a pre-war port in the Rotterdam municipality of Delfshaven. The Sint Jobshaven was dug between 1906 and 1908 and built for the transhipment of bulk goods. The port is named after the demolished Sint Jobskapel during the construction of the port in the former village of Schoonderloo.

name: Sint Martinusbrug
en: The Sint Martinusbrug or simply Martinusbrug is a fixed bridge in the center of the Dutch city of Utrecht. It spans the Stadsbuitengracht (Catharijnesingel) It is a pedestrian tunnel bridge made of steel with a concrete bridge deck. It was built according to the design of the Dutch architect Wiek Röling. name: Sint Nicolaasbrug
en: The Sint Nicolaasbrug (bridge 306) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge spans the Open Havenfront and extends along the Damrak. The bridge connects the Prins Hendrikkade with the Stationsplein in front of Amsterdam Central Station. This led to its unofficial name Stationsbrug.

name: Sint Olofskapel
en: The Sint-Olofkapel, or Oudezijds Kapel, is a building in the Dutch city of Amsterdam. The former church building is located in the city center of Amsterdam, between the Zeedijk and the Nieuwebrugsteeg, near the Damrak. The first Sint Olofskapel was built between 1440 and 1450 against a large city gate, the Sint Olofspoort.

name: Sint Paschalis Baylon
en: The Sint-Paschalis Baylon Church on the Wassenaarseweg in The Hague was built between 1919 and 1921. The church is named after the Spanish saint Paschalis Baylon. The nearby school is also named after the church. The church is a good example of the traditionalist architectural style of A.J. Kropholler, who had not built such a large church before.

name: Sint-Agneskerk
en: The Sint-Agneskerk in Amsterdam is a Catholic parish church, located at the corner of Amstelveenseweg 163 and Cornelis Krusemanstraat, on the Haarlemmermeercircuit and on the edge of the Willemspark neighborhood.

name: Sint-Aloysiuskerk
en: The Sint-Aloysiuskerk is a Roman Catholic church building in the Dutch city of Utrecht, in the subdistrict/neighborhood Abstede in the Oost district. The church is dedicated to the saint Aloysius.

name: Sint-Augustinuskerk
en: The Sint-Augustinuskerk is a Roman Catholic church in the Dutch city of Utrecht, on the northern part of the Oudegracht (no. 69), dedicated to Augustine of Hippo.

name: Sint-Bavo
en: The Sint-Bavokerk is a Roman Catholic parish church in the Rotterdam district of Pendrecht. The church is the church building of the 'O.L.V. van Lourdes parish' which is part of the 'Parish Federation Maria Magdalena'. As part of the 'Designation Program Reconstruction 1940-1945', the church building was designated as a national monument in 2019.

name: Sint-Gertrudiskerk
en: The Sint-Gertrudiskerk is a former Roman Catholic church building in the village of Ruigoord in the municipality of Amsterdam in the Dutch province of North Holland. The church was designed by C.P.W. Dessing and was dedicated to the Holy Gertrude of Nijvel. In the church there is a statue of Gertrudis with a staff with mice.

name: Sint-Jacobsbrug
en: The Sint-Jacobsbrug is a fixed bridge in the center of the Dutch city of Rotterdam. The bridge spans the Stokviswater and is part of the Binnenrotte. The bridge was built around 1960 as a temporary bridge on the site of the Stokkenbrug in the Schiedamsedijk over the Zalmhaven, which had been demolished due to the construction of the subway.

name: Sint-Jacobsstraat
en: The Monicabrug is a fixed bridge in the Dutch city of Utrecht. The bridge is located in the northern part of the center. It spans the Stadsbuitengracht (Weerdsingel) and forms a direct connection between the Sint Jacobsstraat and the Oudenoord. The bridge was built according to the design of the Dutch architect Wiek Röling and was opened in 2001.

name: Sint-Jacobus de Meerderekerk
en: The Sint-Jacobus de Meerderekerk (also: Jacobuskerk) is a Roman Catholic church on Parkstraat in the center of The Hague. The church building and the congregation are part of the parish Maria Sterre der Zee.

name: Sint-Jansbrug
en: Sint Jansbrug is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum in the De Wallen area.
machine: Sint Jansbrug is a permanent bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum in the De Wallen area.

name: Sint-Lambertuskerk
en: The Sint-Lambertuskerk is a Roman Catholic church in Rotterdam-Kralingen. The Lambertus Church is located at the corner of the Beneden Oostzeedijk and the Hoflaan. It was designed in neo-Gothic style by Evert Margry, a pupil of P.J.H. Cuypers, and built in the period 1875-1878.

name: Sint-Laurenshaven
en: The Sint Laurenshaven is a port in the Botlek area in Rotterdam. The main companies at the Sint Laurenshaven are Vopak with a tank storage company and EBS with a specialized transhipment company for dry mineral bulk products. In addition to storage outdoors, storage also takes place in tanks with a conical roof for those products that are humid

name: Sint-Liduina
en: The Sint-Liduinakerk is a Catholic church on Burgemeester Le Fèvre de Montignylaan in Hillegersberg (Rotterdam municipality). The church is named after Liduina van Schiedam. Due to the growth of the village, the Sint-Hildegard church was no longer sufficient to serve the Catholic community.

name: Sint-Pauluskerk
en: The Sint-Pauluskerk is a church building at Larikslaan 182 in Schiebroek, a part of Rotterdam.

name: Sint-Petrus-en-Pauluskerk
en: The Sint-Petrus-en-Pauluskerk is a Dutch Old Catholic church building on Ruysdaelstraat in the Duivelseiland district of Amsterdam. The church, parsonage and teaching room form a whole and were designed by Johan W.F. Hartkamp jr., a pupil of Hendrik Petrus Berlage. The church complex was completed in 1914 as a precursor to the secret church 'De Ooievaar'

name: Sint-Rafaëlkerk
en: The Sint-Rafaëlkerk is a church building of the Roman Catholic Church in the Overvecht district in the Dutch city of Utrecht. The church is located at the corner of Lichtenberchdreef with the Neckardreef and on the edge of the Park de Watertoren. The church is dedicated to the archangel Raphael and is used by the Ludgerus parish.

name: Sinti- en Roma monument
en: The Roma and Sinti monument in the Haagse Vondelstraat opposite the Bilderdijkstraat is a cube-shaped object with a bronze commemorative plaque.

name: Sisyfusgemaal
en: The Sisyfusgemaal is both a structural and artistic work of art (applied art) in Amsterdam Nieuw-West.

name: Sleutelbrug
en: The Sleutelbrug is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The vaulted bridge with three openings is located on the southern quay of the Grimburgwal and spans the Oudezijds Voorburgwal. From the bridge you have full visibility of the buildings of the former Binnengasthuis. The bridge is surrounded by municipal and national monuments.

name: Slinge
en: The Slinge is the central axis of the Rotterdam neighborhoods of Zuidwijk and Pendrecht. The Slinge is almost 3.5 kilometers long and runs from the Groene Kruisweg in the west to the Dordtsestraatweg in the east. The house numbering starts at 3 at the Dordtsestraatweg and goes up to 901 at the Groene Kruisweg.

name: Sloterbrug
en: The Sloterbrug (bridge 9P) is a drawbridge within the municipality of Haarlemmermeer. The bridge belongs to Haarlemmermeer but is known in Amsterdam as bridge 9P, the P meaning not maintained by Amsterdam. Officially the bridge has no name.

name: Sloterdijkerbrug
en: The Sloterdijkerbrug (bridge 321) is a double wooden drawbridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It spans the Prinseneilandsgracht. It not only forms the main route between Sloterdijkstraat on the mainland and Galgenstraat on Prinseneiland, but also between both quays of that canal Nieuwe Teertuinen and Prinseneiland, the street.

name: Sloterkerk
en: The Sloterkerk is a Protestant church in Sloten, North Holland.

name: Slotermeerlaan

name: Sloterplas
en: The Sloterplas is located in the center of the Western Garden Cities in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The pond was dug between 1948 and 1956 and has a maximum depth of 37 meters.

name: Slufter
en: The Slufter is a large-scale storage facility for contaminated sludge in the southwestern part of the Rotterdam Maasvlakte on the North Sea coast near Voorne. Construction took place in 1986 and 1987. name: Sluis Haarlemmervaart
en: The Schutsluis Haarlemmervaart stands in the Haarlemmervaart in Amsterdam-West at Van Slingelandtstraat. The lock, with a chamber length of 36.44 metres and a passage width of 6 metres, was built after the Haarlemmervaart lost its tow-canal role in the 19th century and a direct connection was made near Nassauplein.

name: Smal Weesp
en: Smal Weesp is a channeled stream between the Vecht River and the Amsterdam-Rhine Canal. It flows across Weesp. In Driemond, the Smal Weesp joined the Gein and Gaasp streams. That explains the naming of that place.

name: Smederij Meisterbrug
en: The Smederij Meisterbrug (bridge 164) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam Oud-West. It spans the Bilderdijkgracht and forms the connection between the Kwakersplein (center side) and the Kwakersstraat and both quays of the canal.

name: Smeebrug
en: The Smeebrug is a nationally protected arched bridge in the city center of Utrecht. The bridge spans the Oudegracht. The name of the bridge is derived from the guild of blacksmiths, who lived in this area.

name: Smidswater
en: The Hague canal belt is the (partly 16th and especially early) 17th-century Singelsgracht that is still intact. A belt is ring-shaped, or circular, the Singelsgracht in The Hague has a different (angular) shape. That is not unique. Old Rotterdam had a triangular shape. A canal belt should not be confused with a system of interconnected waterways.

name: Snodenhoekpark
en: The Snodenhoekpark is a small park and a street in the Gaasperdam district in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The park is located south of the Schoonhovendreef and north of De Hoge Dijk. The Steengroevenpad runs through the park. The park was built in the mid-1980s, at the same time as the Reigersbos district, part of Gaasperdam. The park is named after d

name: Snoekjesbrug
en: The Snoekjesbrug (bridge 289) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The traffic bridge is located over the Snoekjesgracht and extends along the Snoekjessteeg. The bridge is located halfway across the already short canal. On the southwest side of the bridge are a number of municipal and national monuments.

name: Sociëteit De Vereeniging
en: Sociëteit De Vereeniging in The Hague is a gentlemen's society founded on April 30, 1851. The first members were 79 gentlemen, who temporarily met in a rented building at Kazernestraat 198 in The Hague, where seven years later the Hotel Des Indes would be built. name: Socratesbrug
en: The Socratesbrug is a bascule bridge over the Merwedekanaal in the city of Utrecht. The bridge was opened in 1964 and forms a connection between the Transwijk and Rivierenwijk districts, respectively the Beneluxlaan and the Socrateslaan, in the south of the city.

name: Soestwetering
en: The Soestwetering is a main watercourse in Salland in the Dutch province of Overijssel. It springs from the foot of the Holterberg. The ditch runs from the Holtense hamlet of Dijkerhoek through a large part of Salland towards Zwolle. Here it joins the Nieuwe Wetering and the Almelose Canal. name: Solebayplein
en: Solebayplein is an unofficial name for a square in the Landlust district in Amsterdam-West.

name: Solitudobrug
en: The Solitudobrug (bridge 2190) is a structure in Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Solitudolaanspoorbrug
en: The Solitudolaanspoorbrug and its namesakes, the Solitudolaan and the Solitudopad, lie in Amsterdam-Oost. The Solitudolaan and -pad received their names in 2015, when new residential buildings were built in this area and road redevelopment took place. The railway bridge was named after the avenue in February 2018.

name: Sonneveld House
en: House Sonneveld in the South Holland city of Rotterdam was built between 1932 and 1933 by architect Leendert van der Vlugt of Bureau Brinkman & van der Vlugt on behalf of A.H. Sonneveld, then member of the board of directors of the Rotterdam company Erven De Weduwe J. van Nelle.

name: Spaansebrug
en: The Spanish Bridge is a steel drawbridge over the Delfshavense Schie, in the district of Overschie of the Dutch municipality of Rotterdam. The first Spanish Bridge was opened in 1952 and formed the connection between the Second High Railway in Overschie and the industrial area Spaanse Polder.

name: Spaarndammerdijk
en: The Spaarndammerdijk is a dike that was built from the first half of the 13th century to protect the peatland grazing area south of the still not drained IJ. name: Spaarndammerstraat
en: The Spaarndammerstraat is a residential and shopping street in the Spaarndammerbuurt in Amsterdam Oud-West.

name: Spaarndammertunnel
en: The Spaarndammertunnel is a tunnel for car traffic in Amsterdam-West.

name: Spaklerweg
en: The Spaklerweg is a street in the Amsterdam neighborhoods of Watergraafsmeer and Overamstel and in Amsterdam-Duivendrecht, which belongs to the municipality of Ouder-Amstel. The street was opened to traffic around 1960 to open up the then newly built industrial district of Overamstel.

name: Spanjaardsbrug
en: The Spanjaardsbrug is a double bascule bridge over the harbor "het Haringvliet" in the city triangle (the center) of the Dutch city Rotterdam, next to the Oude Haven. name: Spanjemonument
en: The Spanjemonument is an artistic work and war memorial in Amsterdam-Noord.

name: Speelmanstraat
en: Speelmanstraat is a street in the Amsterdam garden city of Slotermeer. The street was named after resistance fighter Wim Speelman on July 9, 1952.

name: Spijkenisserbrug
en: The Spijkenisserbrug is a traffic bridge over the Oude Maas between the Dutch towns of Hoogvliet and Spijkenisse. The S102 (the Green Cross Road) runs on this bridge. Until 2016, the bridge was part of the N492.

name: Spinoza
en: The statue of Spinoza is a 19th-century monument in The Hague, in memory of the philosopher Benedictus de Spinoza.

name: Spinozabrug
en: The Spinozabrug is a bascule bridge with two parallel bridge decks in the Dutch city of Utrecht. It lies between the Lessinglaan and the Spinozaweg over the Merwedekanaal. Adjacent streets are also the Keulsekade and the Kanaalweg. The bridge was already under construction before 1940 but in 1942 the German occupiers announced a halt to construction.

name: Spinozahuis
en: Domus Spinozana or Spinozahuis is a house on Paviljoensgracht 72 in The Hague, Netherlands, where the philosopher Spinoza lived until his death. The house was built in 1646 at the behest of the painter Jan van Goyen who sold it to Havick Steen, the father of Jan Steen. name: Spoorbrug Nootdorpboog
en: The Spoorbrug Nootdorpboog is a railway bridge in the Dutch province of South Holland, on the border between Nootdorp and Leidschenveen-Ypenburg. The bridge over the A12 motorway is part of the Nootdorpboog railway line.

name: Spoordijk
en: A railway, track or railway line is a road of railway rails or tracks. Locomotives, such as trains and subways, are suitable for running over a railway. A railway consists of one or more tracks. name: Spoorsingel
en: The Spoorsingel is a street in Rotterdam on the north side of Rotterdam Central Station. The Spoorsingel runs from Walenburgerweg to Proveniersplein.

name: Spoorwegbassin
en: The Spoorwegbassin is a port in the Eastern Port Area of Amsterdam. The port is located east of the Cornelis van Eesterenlaan and flows into the Amsterdam-Rhine Canal.

name: Spoorweghavenbrug
en: The Spoorweghavenbrug is a lift bridge in the Feijenoord district of the Dutch municipality of Rotterdam, part of the Stieltjesstraat. The bridge spans the Spoorweghaven and is named after it. This is the third bridge in this place. The first bridge, a swing bridge, was built in 1880 and was popularly known as the Koffiemolenbrug.

name: Sportlaan
en: The Sportlaan is one of the north-east to south-west running, about two kilometer long avenue in the southwest of The Hague that runs from Houtrustweg to De Savornin Lohmanlaan. name: Spuihaven
en: The Spuihaven is a harbor in Schiedam. The harbor is 400 meters long, 20 meters wide and the depth is NAP -4 meters. The entrance is located at kilometer post 1007.3 on the right bank of the Nieuwe Maas. There is a green fixed light on the west side of the entrance. At the end of the harbor there is a sluice gate in the Havendijk.

name: St. Dominicuskerk
en: The Sint-Dominicuskerk is a Roman Catholic parish church in the Dutch city of Utrecht, located in the Oog in Al district. The church was built in 1951 and designed by Herman van Putten in the style of the Bossche School. On November 22, 1951, the church was inaugurated by Bishop Alfrink.

name: St. Jacobuskerk
en: The Sint-Jacobuskerk is a church building in the Utrecht district of Zuilen. Today it no longer bears this name, but is known as the Best Life Church, after the evangelical congregation with the same name. The church building was originally dedicated to James the Greater. In 2017 the building was removed from the Eucharistic celebration.

name: Staalmanpark
en: The Staalmanpark is a city park in Amsterdam-Nieuw-West.

name: Staalmeestersbrug
en: The Staalmeestersbrug (bridge 227) is a drawbridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It spans the Groenburgwal and is located in Staalstraat, which lies on both sides of the Groenburgwal. It is next to bridge 226, the only bridge over the canal.

name: Staatsliedenbrug
en: The Staatsliedenbrug (bridge 139) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam Oud-West. The bridge forms the connection between the Van Limburg Stirumstraat and the Tweede Nassaustraat. It spans the Kostverlorenvaart with its quays De Wittenkade.

name: Stadhouderskade
en: The Stadhouderskade is a street in Amsterdam-West and Amsterdam-Zuid, on the west and south bank of the Singelgracht from the Overtoom to the Amstel.

name: Stadhouderspoort
en: The Stadhouderspoort is a gate that connects the Binnenhof and Buitenhof in The Hague. It is one of the four (most western) still existing gates of the Binnenhof complex.

name: Stadhuisbrug
en: The Stadhuisbrug is a bridge over the Oudegracht in the city center of Utrecht. In addition to the town hall and the main branch of the municipal library, several shops are located on the Stadhuisbrug. A windmill is visible in the paving of the bridge. name: Stadiongracht
en: The Stadiongracht is a canal in Amsterdam-Zuid; dug around 1928.

name: Stadionlaan
en: The Stadionlaan is a street in the Dutch city of Utrecht. The street runs from Rubenslaan and Adriaen van Ostadelaan to Herculeslaan. A side street of the Stadionlaan is the Laan van Minsweerd. name: Stadionplein
en: The Stadionplein is a square in Amsterdam-Zuid, which was built in the 1920s at the intersection of Stadionweg and Amstelveenseweg to better control car traffic to the site of the 1928 Summer Olympic Games in Amsterdam. name: Stadionweg
en: The Stadionweg is a street in the Zuid district of Amsterdam. The street is the access road to the Olympic Stadium, but is named after the stadium designed by architect Harry Elte that stood at the corner of the current Stadionweg and Stadionplein between 1914 and 1929.

name: Stadsbuitengracht
en: The Stadsbuitengracht is the canal around the old city center of the Dutch city of Utrecht. The Stadsbuitengracht was built in the twelfth century as a defensive work of the city. name: Stadsgraanzuiger 19
en: Stadsgraanzuiger No.19 is an Antwerp grain elevator owned by the Maritime Museum in Rotterdam. It is the only remaining floating grain elevator in Europe and is operated both in Antwerp and Rotterdam as a museum ship and floating monument. The ship consists of a pontoon with a steel construction, in which two steam engines are located at the top.

name: Stadspark Osdorp
en: The Stadspark Osdorp is a park in the Amsterdam district of Osdorp. It is a fairly new park, it was expanded in 1990 and took its current form in the years following as part of the large-scale urban renewal of Osdorp. name: Stadsschouwburg Utrecht
en: The Stadsschouwburg is the largest theater building in the Dutch city of Utrecht. It was designed in 1937 by the famous architect Willem Dudok. The building is located on the Lucasfort, on the edge of the Utrecht city center. The city theater was opened on September 3, 1941 and housed the Esplanade restaurant (with balcony terrace) at the time.

name: Stadswerf Koningspoort
en: The Koningspoort ship slip is a museum ship slip built in 1983 on the site where the passageway from the Maas to the Old Port of Rotterdam used to be. name: Statentunnel
en: The Statentunnel is a traffic tunnel with a length of over 100 meters in the center of Rotterdam and is part of the Tunneltraverse. The tunnel lies between the intersection with the Beukelsdijk and the Weena and the Bentinckplein in the Blijdorp district and crosses the platform of Rotterdam Central station.

name: Steen van de miljoenen tranen
en: The Steen van de miljoenen tranen is a memorial monument on Willem Ruyslaan in Rotterdam. name: Steenhouwerijbrug
en: The Steenhouwerijbrug or Steenhouwerijsluis (bridge 45) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The arched bridge is located on the northeast bank of the Keizersgracht and crosses the Leidsegracht. The bridge gets its name from the Stadsmetseltuin that was located on the Leidsegracht during the planning of this neighborhood.

name: Stieltjesmonument
en: The Stieltjesmonument is a monument on the North Island in the Dutch municipality of Rotterdam in memory of Th.J. Stieltjes.

name: Strandweg
en: The municipality of Westland has eight official beach access points, listed below from north to south. Along the dunes is a cycling path that is part of the National Cycling Route 1 and the Dune and Greenhouse Route.

name: Strevelsweg
en: The Strevelsweg is a street in Rotterdam. It belongs partly to the Bloemhof district, and the Vreewijk district, although it still uses the postal code of Bloemhof. en: The Noorderkerk is a monumental building in the Dutch city of Utrecht. The building on Royaards van den Hamkade 20 was built around 1922 for the Reformed Church in the new Ondiep district. The architect D.J. Heusinkveld designed the church building in a predominantly sober style of the Amsterdam School with a connection to the surrounding area.

name: Suurhoffbrug
en: The Suurhoffbrug connects the two banks of the Hartel Canal in the Dutch city of Rotterdam. The bridge consists of, side by side, a railway bridge and a bridge for car traffic; these two bridges have the same name. The bridge is part of the A15 and has 2×2 lanes here. The railway bridge of the Rotterdam Harbour Line is located on the west side

name: Syphonsluis
en: The Merwedekanaal siphon is a feeder tunnel, or water transport tunnel, that connects two branches of the Merwedekanaal on the south side of the city of Utrecht under the Amsterdam-Rhine Canal (ARK). name: Tante Saarbrug
en: The Tante Saarbrug (bridge 31) is a fixed arch bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum.

name: Tasmanstraat
en: The Tasmanstraat is a residential street in the Amsterdam Spaarndammer neighborhood.

name: Tennesseehaven
en: The Tennesseehaven is a port in Rotterdam's Europoort on the Beerkanaal. The pet factory of Indorama (formerly Voridian-Eastman Chemical Company) is located at this port. The port was dredged in 1996 and first used in 1997. The name is derived from the American state of Tennessee where Eastman's headquarters is located.

name: Terbregseweg
en: Terbregseweg is a "never opened station" on the Utrecht - Rotterdam railway line. It was located in the east of Rotterdam, on the so-called Ceintuurbaan.

name: Tetje de Jongbrug
en: Tetje de Jongbrug (bridge 100) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge is located on the eastern quay of the Lijnbaansgracht and spans the Looiersgracht. This canal has only three bridges, the Looierssluis (bridge 103), bridge 102 and this bridge 100. Bridge 101, the Nieuwe Amstelbrug, spans the Amstel, so elsewhere in the city.

en: The Movies is a cinema in Amsterdam. The Movies is the oldest still in use cinema in Amsterdam. The complex is located at Haarlemmerdijk 161-163 on the outskirts of the Jordaan. name: Theater aan het Spui
en: Theater aan het Spui is a medium-sized flat-floor theater located on the Spui, the cultural heart of The Hague. It is located next to the Nieuwe Kerk and the Filmhuis Den Haag. name: Theater Amsterdam
en: Theater Amsterdam is a theater in Amsterdam. It is for the time being the only theater in Amsterdam that is intended for performances that run as long as the public is interested. name: Theater De Regentes
en: Theater De Regentes (officially "De Nieuwe Regentes" after a restart) in The Hague was originally called Theater Zwembad de Regentes and was founded in 1996.

name: Theater Kikker
en: Theater Kikker is a theater on the Ganzenmarkt in the city center of Utrecht. The theater has two rooms in which a mixture of contemporary theater and modern dance is performed. Kikker works a lot with volunteers.

name: Theater PePijn
en: PePijn is a theater in The Hague that has focused on cabaret, stand-up comedy and small arts.

name: Theater Zuidplein
en: The Theater Zuidplein is a theater on the Zuidplein in Rotterdam, near the Zuidplein Shopping Center.

en: The Theo Fransmanbrug (bridge number 1788) is a structure in Amsterdam-Noord. The Papaverweg in the Buiksloterham area was a dead-end road from buildings to Zijkanaal I for almost a century. name: Theo Thijssen Museum
en: The Theo Thijssen Museum is a museum in Amsterdam devoted to the writer, teacher and politician Theo Thijssen. It is run by the Stichting Theo Thijssen and occupies the ground floor of Thijssen's birthplace at Eerste Leliedwarsstraat 16.

name: Theo van Goghpark
en: The Theo van Goghpark is a city park in the Amsterdam district of IJburg. The park is located on Haveneiland-Oost, south of the Pampuslaan, near the terminus of tram line 26 (IJtram). The park is partially built in a recessed manner but on the side of Pampuslaan it is actually built in an elevated manner and accessible by a wide staircase.

name: Theresia van Gelderen
en: The list of Stolpersteine in Utrecht (municipality) gives an overview of the commemorative stones that have been placed in the municipality of Utrecht in the Dutch province of Utrecht as part of the Stolpersteine project of the German sculptor-artist Gunter Demnig. Stolpersteine are dedicated to victims of Nazism, all those who were murdered by it.

name: Theresiastraat
en: The Theresiastraat is a shopping street located in the Hague district of Bezuidenhout. The street is named after Queen Regent Emma, the second wife of King William III. Her first names were Adelheid Emma Wilhelmina Theresia. Her three other first names can be found in the naming of some side streets of the Theresiastraat.

name: This is Holland
en: THIS IS HOLLAND is a tourist attraction with a panoramic flight simulator in Amsterdam. It opened in 2017 in Amsterdam-Noord, next to the Eye Filmmuseum, in a 24-metre-high cylindrical pavilion on the former Shell site Overhoeks, above the underground car park of the A'DAM Toren.

name: Thomaskerk
en: The Thomaskerk, or De Thomas, on the Prinses Irenestraat in Amsterdam-Zuid was built in 1966 and belongs to the Protestant Church of Amsterdam.

name: Thorbecke statue
en: The statue of Johan Rudolph Thorbecke, or Thorbecke monument, is a 19th-century memorial in Amsterdam to the liberal politician Thorbecke.

name: Tijnmuidenbrug
en: The Tijnmuidenbrug, designated KW517, is a structure in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The structure is located on the Westrandweg, part of the A5 motorway. It spans the Amsterdam traffic road Dortmuiden. The architectural firm Zwarts & Jansma Architecten was responsible for the design of this national road and all its structures.

en: The Titus Brandsmabrug (bridge 792) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The traffic bridge is located in the De Aker district in the Middelveldsche Akerpolder. The bridge dating from around 1990 forms the connection between the Geertruida van Lierstraat and Nisserstraat and crosses the Ernst Cahnsingel.

name: Tobacco Theater
en: The Tobacco Theater is a national monument, located on the "theaterstraat" Nes in Amsterdam (odd house numbers 75 to 87). The building was originally, as well as other buildings in the Nes such as the Comedy Theater, Theater De Engelenbak and Frascati, a tobacco factory.

name: Tolsteegbarrière
en: The Tolsteegbarrière is a culvert at the southern end of the Oudegracht. Together with the Tolsteeg Bridge over the Stadsbuitengracht (singel), it forms a small square in the far south of the Old Town of Utrecht. The square is located at the end of the Oudegracht. The square is often colloquially referred to as Ledig Erf, but this is the official name.

name: Tolsteegbrug
en: The Tolsteegbrug is a bridge and street name in the Dutch city of Utrecht. The arched bridge was built around 1925 in the south of the Utrecht city center over the Stadsbuitengracht. name: Torenfort aan de Ossenmarkt
en: The Torenfort aan de Ossenmarkt is a tower fort in Weesp in the province of North Holland.

name: Torensluis
en: The Torensluis (bridge no. 9) is a characteristic arched bridge over the Singel in the inner city of Amsterdam and with 42 meters one of the widest in the city. The reason for this is that a tower stood on the bridge, the Jan Roodenpoortstoren.

en: The Torontobrug (bridge 350) in Amsterdam is a double bascule bridge on the border between Amsterdam-Zuid, De Pijp and Amsterdam-Oost. It spans the Amstel. On the west side it lies along the Stadhouderskade and is perpendicular to the Amsteldijk (formerly Utrechtsezijde). On the east side it lies along the Mauritskade.

name: Torontohaven
en: The Torontohaven is a port in the Botlek area in Rotterdam. On the north side is Vopak Terminal TTR, on the east side is Service Terminal Rotterdam.

name: Tranen
en: Tranen for the Resistance or Two Tears is an artistic work by Bernard Heesen in one of the passages of the Max Euweplein in the center of Amsterdam. name: Transformatorweg
en: The Transformatorweg is an important thoroughfare in Amsterdam, in the Westpoort district.

name: Trapjesbrug
en: Bridge 130 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The pedestrian bridge, colloquially known as the Trapjesbrug, forms the connection between Tuinstraat and Nieuwe Tuinstraat. It spans the Lijnbaansgracht and lands on the Westerkade (western quay of the Lijnbaansgracht).

name: Treurende vrouw
en: Treurende vrouw is a war monument in Rotterdam. It commemorates the twenty Dutch resistance fighters (including Teunis Abbenbroek) who were executed on March 12, 1945 on the spot in Goereesestraat near the Pleinweg in Rotterdam-Zuid by the German occupiers. name: Trêveszaal
en: The Trêveszaal is a historic meeting room from 1697 in the Binnenhof in The Hague and is part of the buildings of the Ministry of General Affairs. Since 1977 it has been the permanent meeting room of the Dutch Council of Ministers. name: Triumfatorkerk
en: The Triumfatorkerk is a monumental church building in the Dutch city of Utrecht. The church is located in the Kanaleneiland subdistrict. It was built in 1965 to the design of Jos and Leo de Jonge. The building is valued as a municipal monument. The church was originally used by Reformed and Reformed people.

name: Truus Wijsmullerbrug
en: The Truus Wijsmullerbrug (bridge 793) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The traffic bridge is located in the De Aker district in the Middelveldsche Akerpolder. The bridge dating from around 1990 forms the connection between Jacob Paffstraat and Inaristraat and crosses the Ernst Cahnsingel.

name: Tuindorpkerk
en: The Tuindorpkerk is a Protestant church on the corner of Professor Suringarlaan and the H.F. van Riellaan in the Tuindorp district in the Dutch city of Utrecht. This church building was opened in 1936 as a Reformed church. It was designed by architect Abraham van der Kraan. The simple nave church has a slender church tower with a tapered spire

name: Tulpbrug
en: The Tulpbrug (bridge 255) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam, on the border of the districts Centrum and Oost. The bridge forms the connection between Professor Tulpplein with the Amstel Hotel and the Huddekade on the one hand and the Weesperzijde on the other. It spans the Singelgracht.

name: u.c.s. EDO
en: UCS EDO is a Dutch amateur football club from the city of Utrecht, founded in 1921. The club has 11 men's senior teams, 2 veteran teams and 3 women's teams. The club's first team plays in the 2nd class B(2022/2023). The club plays at Overvecht-Noord sports park in the Utrecht district of Overvecht.

name: Uilenburger Synagoge
en: The Uilenburger Synagoge or Uilenburgersjoel is a synagogue on the Nieuwe Uilenburgerstraat on the island of Uilenburg in the former Amsterdam Jewish Quarter. The synagogue was built in Louis XV style in 1766 for the Ashkenazi Jews. The progressive Jewish community Beit Ha'Chidush has been meeting there several times a month since 1997.

name: Uitdammer Die
en: The Uitdammer Die is a creek, called "die", in Waterland in North Holland. The water is located northeast of the village of Holysloot, which belongs to the municipality of Amsterdam, southeast of Broek in Waterland and southwest of Uitdam. It is a remnant of the former Waterlandse Die, a peat river in Waterland.

name: Uithoflijn

name: Uiverbrug
en: The Uiverbrug (bridge 2208) is a bascule bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid. It is located in the Generaal Vetterstraat and spans the Riekerhaven to the Valschermkade. The Uiverbrug is intended as a traffic bridge, the adjacent bridge 307 (also known as the Riekerhavenbrug) of the Jaagpad is intended only for pedestrians and cyclists.

name: Utrechtsebaan
en: The Utrechtsebaan is a road in The Hague. The road connects from the west to the A12 from The Hague via Utrecht to the border with Germany. The road begins on the Zuid-Hollandlaan/Benoordenhoutseweg and then runs through between the Malieveld and the Haagse Bos. The road continues between the Beatrixkwartier and the Bezuidenhout until the municipal boundary.

name: Utrechtsebrug
en: The Utrechtsebrug (bridge number 439, signed as Utrechtse Brug) is an Amsterdam bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid.

name: Utrechtseweg
en: National Highway 2 (A2/N2) is a national highway in the Netherlands and forms an important north-south connection between Amsterdam, Utrecht, 's-Hertogenbosch, Eindhoven, Maastricht and the border with Belgium. At Eijsden, the route connects to the Belgian A25 towards Liège. According to Rijkswaterstaat, the A2 has a length of 217 kilometers.

name: Vaaltbrug
en: The Vaaltbrug is a lifting bridge in the Dutch city of Utrecht. The bridge spans the Biltsche Grift. The Vaaltbrug is located at the mouth of the Biltsche Grift into the Stadsbuitengracht.

name: Vaanweg
en: The Vaanweg is an important highway in the Rotterdam municipality of Charlois and is an extension of the A29 motorway. The Vaanweg is an important route for traffic from and to Rotterdam-Zuid, in particular to Ahoy and the shopping center and bus station Zuidplein.

name: Vaartscherijnbrug
en: The Vaartscherijnbrug is a monumental bridge in the Dutch city of Utrecht. It spans the Vaartsche Rijn where it flows into the Stadsbuitengracht. It is a bascule bridge. name: Vaillantlaan
en: The Vaillantlaan is a 1.5 kilometer long avenue in The Hague. It is named after the former Hague alderman for finance and welfare Mr. Johan Pieter Vaillant. Built between 1896 and 1900, it was almost completely demolished between 1985 and 1995 and rebuilt again between 1990 and 2009 according to a master plan by architect Jo Coenen.

name: Valkenburgerstraat
en: The Valkenburgerstraat is a street in the Nieuwmarkt neighborhood in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is the main street of the former island of Valkenburg (Marken).

name: Van Alkemadelaan
en: The Van Alkemadelaan in The Hague is a district bypass road of the Benoordenhout district and is constructed for the entire length of about 3 km as a through road with four lanes, partly with separated lanes. name: Van Buurenmonument
en: The Van Buurenmonument is a memorial in Amsterdam commemorating Lucas van Buuren.

en: The Van de Sande Bakhuijzenstraat is a street in Amsterdam in the Overtoomse Veld district in the Nieuw-West district. The street connects Jan Tooropstraat with Jan van Galenstraat. The street borders GVB-Garage West.

name: Van der Kunstraat
en: The Van der Kunstraat is a relatively short street in Amsterdam-Oost, Van der Kunbuurt.

name: Van Diemenstraat
en: The Van Diemenstraat is a street in the Zeeheldenbuurt of Amsterdam-Centrum. The street, which is part of the ring road s100, begins at Barentszplein in the east and ends at the Westerkeersluisbrug bridge that spans the Westerkanaal. name: Van Eesteren Museum
en: The Van Eesteren Museum is a museum in Amsterdam Nieuw-West devoted entirely to the architect and town planner Cornelis van Eesteren. Since 22 October 2017 it has been housed in the Van Eesteren Paviljoen at Noordzijde 31.

name: Van Gendt Hallen
en: The Hallen van Stork, Van Gendthallen or Werkspoorhallen are five interconnected halls of the former Werkspoor-Stork factory in Oostenburg in Amsterdam. en: The Van Heukelompark is a park in the Utrecht district of Zuilen. The park is named after the Utrecht architect George van Heukelom. Construction of the park began in 2012. The park still had the working name Springerpark at the time. The Van Heukelompark is a redesign of a park-like area that was known in official circles as the Van Heukelomlob.

en: The Van Karnebeekbron is a sandstone monument that commemorates the Carnegie Foundation and the opening of the Peace Palace in The Hague on August 28, 1913. name: Van Limburg Stirumplein
en: The Van Limburg Stirumplein is a square in Amsterdam-West. The square is located in the Staatsliedenbuurt, between the Van Limburg Stirumstraat and the Van der Hoopstraat. The Bentinckstraat also crosses the square.

name: Van Mierlobrug
en: Van Mierlobrug (bridge 18) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The traffic bridge connects the southern quay of the Blauwburgwal with Herenstraat. It spans Herengracht in the process. The bridge forms a whole with bridge 19 on the eastern quay of Herengracht and over the Blauwburgwal.

name: Van Nijenrodeweg
en: The Van Nijenrodeweg is a connecting street (access road) in the Amsterdam district of Buitenveldert and was named in 1958. The street is named after Gijsbrecht II of Nijenrode, bailiff of Amstelland, Waterland and Gooiland (1357-'58). name: Van Noordtgracht
en: The Van Noordtgracht is a canal in the West district of Amsterdam. The name was established by council decision of November 20, 1878. The canal is named after Olivier van Noort (1558-1627), a explorer, who was the first Dutchman to circumnavigate the world via street Magelhaens from 1598 to 1601.

en: The Van Oldenbarneveltstraat with the Van Oldenbarneveltplaats in the extension is a street in the center of Rotterdam. The street runs from the Mauritsweg to the Coolsingel. name: Varkenssluis
en: The Varkenssluis (bridge no. 204) is a bridge over the Oudezijds Voorburgwal in the Wallengebied area of Amsterdam. The bridge connects Damstraat with Oude Doelenstraat. A bridge has been lying here for centuries. It can already be seen on city maps by Pieter Bast (1599) and Balthasar Florisz. van Berckenrode (1625).

name: Vasteland
en: The Vasteland is a road south of the center of Rotterdam and is part of the Centrumring S100. The road runs along the Westzeedijk and extends to the Nieuwe Leuvebrug. Unused tram rails are located in the middle barrier of the motorway. At the corner with the Schiedamsedijk is the Maastorenflat, which was the highest building for a while after construction.

name: Veebrug

name: Veilinghaven
en: The Veilinghaven (or Parkhaven) in the Dutch city of Utrecht is the former port of the Utrecht vegetable auction on the Merwedekanaal. Around this port, the eponymous residential area was developed between 1997 and 2014.

name: Ver Huellbank
en: The Ver Huellbank is a memorial bench that was established in 1881 in The Hague in memory of Mr. Henry Christiaan Arnoud Ver Huell (1820-1881).

name: Verversingskanaal
en: The Verversingskanaal is a canal in The Hague that until 2016 was called the Wastewater Canal or Drainage Canal. The name Verversingskanaal was also already widely used before the official name change. The canal runs from the city center along Houtrustweg, Suezkade and Conradkade.

name: Viebrug
en: The Viebrug is a arched bridge in the Utrecht city center that spans the Oudegracht. Adjacent to the bridge are connecting workshops and yards. The former main post office is located next to Viebrug. The Lange Viestraat continues over the bridge into the Potterstraat. An old mention of the Viebrug dates back to 1289.

name: Vier Heemskinderenbrug
en: The Vier Heemskinderenbrug, also known as Vier Heemskinderensluis, is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is located on the western quay of the Herengracht and crosses the Leidsegracht. It has been a municipal monument since 1995 and is surrounded by national monuments.
machine: The Vier Heemskinderenbrug, also known as Vier Heemskinderensluis, is a permanent bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is located on the western quay of the Herengracht and crosses the Leidsegracht. It has been a municipal monument since 1995 and is surrounded by national monuments.

name: Vierhavensstraat
en: The Vierhavensstraat is a street in Nieuw-Mathenesse in Rotterdam-West, which owes its name to the four harbors whose quay borders this street. name: Vierkant eiland in de plas
en: Vierkant eiland in de plas is a large monumental work of art made by artist Frans de Wit (Leiden, 1942-2004). The work of art is located in the Dutch city of Rotterdam, in the Prinsenland district. It marks the historically lowest point in the Netherlands, which is more than 7 meters below sea level. The work of art was unveiled on October 2, 1996.

name: Vierwindstrekenbrug
en: The Vierwindstrekenbrug (bridge no. 381) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-West.

name: Vikingrijn
en: The Vikingrijn is a newly excavated section of an original course of the Rhine River in the Máximapark in the municipality of Utrecht.

name: Villa Zebra
en: Villa Zebra is an art laboratory for children from 2 to 12 years old in Rotterdam. The organization develops art programs in which children are introduced to contemporary art in an accessible way. At Villa Zebra, children are encouraged to experiment, discover and express themselves in their own way. For children from 2 to

name: Vincentiuskerk
en: The Sint-Vincentiuskerk, named after patron saint Vincentius a Paulo, was a Catholic church building in Amsterdam Oud-West. The starting signal was given in July 1899 when the congregation purchased a 50 by 40 meter plot of land for a church and school.

name: Vissersmonument
en: Scheveningen has three Fishermen's Monuments. The oldest of them was unveiled on September 26, 1922 in memory of those Scheveningen fishermen who lost their lives during World War I due to war violence at sea.

name: Vlaams Cultuurhuis de Brakke Grond
en: De Brakke Grond, full name Vlaams Cultuurhuis de Brakke Grond, is a Flemish cultural center at Nes 45 in Amsterdam. The current building is a design by architect Arthur Staal. De Brakke Grond, located on a square in the middle of the theater district on the Nes, offers performances in the field of performing arts, visual arts, music and other forms of art

name: Vleutense Wetering
en: The Vleutense Wetering is a watercourse in the western part of the Dutch municipality of Utrecht that is formed by part of the old course of the Rhine River. From the 8th century until around 1935, there was an artificial watercourse between the current city center and this river course, which was also sometimes called and was also known as Vleutense.

name: Vleutensespoorbrug
en: The Vleutensespoorbrug is the northernmost of the two railway bridges that connect the city of Utrecht with the Leidsche Rijn district. The bridge spans the Amsterdam-Rhine Canal and is part of the Utrecht-Rotterdam railway line.

name: Vleutensespoorbrug 2
en: The Vleutensespoorbrug 2 is the second railway bridge next to the Vleutense railway bridge. Like the Vleutense railway bridge, the bridge spans the Amsterdam-Rhine Canal and is part of the Utrecht-Rotterdam railway line. The bridge is located between the Hogeweide Bridge and the Vleutense railway bridge, on the site of the former Vleutense Bridge.

name: Vleutenseweg
en: The Vleutenseweg is a street in the Dutch city of Utrecht, which runs from the Westplein near Utrecht Central Station, via the Hogeweidebrug over the Amsterdam-Rhine Canal to the Leidsche Rijn district. Here the street connects to the Vleutensebaan.

name: Vlothaven
en: The Vlothaven is a port in the Amsterdam Western Port Area south of the Coenhaven, north of the Nieuwe Hemweg, east of the Einsteinweg and north of the Neptunushaven. The port is named after the raft. The port was dug in 1931 near the Mercuriushaven and provided space for ships and activities in the Eastern Harbor Area

name: Vluchthavenbrug
en: The Vluchthavenbrug (bridge 1927) is a bascule bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. This pedestrian bridge was built around 2012 around a harbor that had emerged between the Westerdoksdijk and a new building complex called IJdock. The bridge was designed by architectural and engineering firm Ney & Partners.

name: Voetiusstraat
en: The Voetiusstraat is a street in the center of the Dutch city of Utrecht. It runs with a length of about 60 meters from the Domplein to the Pieterskerkhof. The street already existed around 1300. It was located around 1400 on the immunity of the Cathedral. Until his death in 1660, the painter Cornelis van Poelenburg lived in this then narrow alley. Ron

name: Volewijckbrug
en: The Volewijckbrug (bridge 2475) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Noord.

name: Volharding 1
en: The Volharding 1 is a steam-powered Dutch tugboat. The ship was built as Harmonie 6 at Scheepswerf de Hoop in Hardinxveld for Mr. Van Loon from Vreeswijk. He ordered the ship as a "Zeeland-type" with open bunker hatches and with the mast retractable forward. The power should have been at least 28 HP. During the trial run, it served as

name: Vollersbrug
en: The Vollersbrug is a nationally protected arched bridge in the city center of Utrecht. The bridge spans the Oudegracht and has two spans. On the bridge border are workshop basements and yards. In the past, it was also sometimes referred to as the Volders Bridge. The name of the bridge is related to the volders who lived here.

name: Vondelbrug
en: The Vondelbrug (bridge 200) is a fixed bridge in the form of a viaduct in Amsterdam-Zuid, connecting Amsterdam Oud-Zuid with Amsterdam Oud-West.

name: Vondelbrug
en: The Vondelbrug is a fixed bridge in the form of a viaduct in Amsterdam-Zuid and connects Amsterdam Oud-Zuid with Amsterdam Oud-West.

name: Vondelmonument
en: The Vondel monument, also known as the Vondelbeeld, is a large statue of the 17th-century Dutch poet and playwright Joost van den Vondel in the Vondelpark in Amsterdam. It was unveiled on 18 October 1867, after which the park itself came to be called the Vondelpark, which became its official name in 1880.

name: Vondelpark Open Air Theater
en: The Vondelpark Open-Air Theater in Amsterdam has been organizing concerts and performances by amateurs and professional performers in the field of cabaret, dance, children's shows and music in the heart of Vondelpark every summer since 1974. The performances are free to attend, but a voluntary donation is requested. Every weekend in the months of June, July

name: Voorboezem
en: The Voorboezem is an old watercourse along the southern sea wall of the former island of Wieringen, near the Polder Waard-Nieuwland in Hollands Kroon in the Dutch province of North Holland.

name: Voorhaven
en: The Voorhaven is the old harbor in Rotterdam-Delfshaven. The harbor was dug in 1389 as part of the construction of the Delfshavense Schie between Overschie and the Nieuwe Maas and served as a feeder harbor for the city of Delft.

name: Voorveldse Polder
en: Park de Voorveldse Polder is a park on the northeastern edge of the city of Utrecht. The park was reclaimed in the Middle Ages at the request of Bishop Godebald and is enclosed between the A27, Biltsestraatweg (N237), Sartreweg and the Biltse Rading. In the park is Fort De Bilt, one of the defensive works of the New Holland Water Line. In the seventies

name: Vredenburgerbrug
en: The Vredenburgerbrug (bridge no. 209) is a pedestrian bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It spans the Oudezijds Achterburgwal in the Wallengebied and is therefore the northernmost bridge over that canal before it converges with the Oudezijds Voorburgwal to Oudezijds Kolk. The bridge connects the Vredenburgersteeg with the Spooksteeg.

name: Vredenburgplein
en: The Vredenburg, also known as Vreeburg, is a busy square in the Dutch city of Utrecht. It is also the name of the adjacent street, which connects Central Station with the old city center. name: Vredeskapel
en: The Vredeskapel is a former church building of the Reformed Church in the Malakkastraat (Archipelbuurt) in the Dutch city of The Hague. Since 2018 it has been converted into four residential units.

name: Vredeskerk
en: The Parish Church of Our Lady Queen of Peace or Vredeskerk is a Roman Catholic church between Pijnackerstraat and Van Hilligaertstraat in the southwest corner of the Pijp in Amsterdam-Zuid. The church has been the namesake of Vredeskerkplein since 2004.

name: Vrijburg
en: Diepenbrockstraat 46 is a church building on Diepenbrockstraat in Amsterdam-Zuid. The side facade is on Herman Gorterstraat. Here, between 1931 and 1933, a church building was erected for the Remonstrant Reformed Church in Amsterdam.

name: Vrijheidscarillon
en: The Vrijheidscarillon in Amsterdam is a clockwork toy that was manufactured in 1952 by the company A.H. van Bergen in Heiligerlee at the initiative of the Dutch Committee for National Commemoration. name: Vrijheidslaan
en: The Vrijheidslaan (formerly Amstellaan and Stalinlaan) is a main street in Amsterdam-Zuid, which together with the Berlagebrug forms the eastern entrance to the Rivierenbuurt. The avenue is an important main axis within the monumental urban planning Plan Zuid by architect Berlage and splits into two equal parts west of the Rijnstraat, on the Victorieplein.

name: Vrijmetselarij Museum
en: The Cultural Masonic Center 'Prince Frederick' (CMC) in The Hague, in the Dutch province of South Holland, is a museum, archive and library of the Order of Freemasons under the Grand Orient of the Netherlands. name: Vulcaanhaven
en: The Vulcaanhaven is a private seaport on the east side of Vlaardingen on the Nieuwe Maas, between the Koningin Wilhelminahaven and Schiedam. name: VVJ
en: Football club Jaffa, also known as VVJ, is a Dutch amateur football club from the city of Utrecht, founded in 1931. The club is named after the Utrecht Machinefabriek Jaffa. VVJ plays at Sportpark Overvecht-Noord in the Utrecht district of Overvecht. The club's first team plays in the Fourth Division on Saturday (season 2020/21).

name: W.H. Vliegenbos
en: The W.H. Vliegenbos is located in Amsterdam-North, between Meeuwenlaan, Nieuwendammerdijk, Nieuwendammerkade and Zamenhofstraat. It is the oldest urban forest of the municipality of Amsterdam.

name: Waalsdorperweg
en: The Waalsdorperweg is a quiet residential street in the Benoordenhout in The Hague, but was for many years from around 1975 to 2008 a busy main road to Wassenaar. As early as 1559, the Waelstorperlaen was named, it is probably named after an even older place called Walinxdorp.

name: Waalse Kerk
en: The Waalse Kerk with adjacent caretaker's house in Rotterdam is located in the Center on the Schiedamse Vest and is a national monument, the church and the caretaker's house were built in 1923-1925 in a traditionalist style, somewhat in the style of Kropholler, designed by J. Verheul Dzn. and J. van Wijngaarden.

name: Waalseilandbrug
en: Bridge 283 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge over the Waalseilandsgracht forms the connection between the Lastage or Nieuwmarktbuurt and the Waalseiland. On the northeast side are the Buiten Bantammerstraat and the Binnenkant quay.

name: Wachterliedplantsoen
en: The Wachterliedplantsoen is a park in the Bos en Lommer district in the Amsterdam municipality of West. The park, which was established in the early 1950s, is located between Egidiusstraat (west), Reinaert de Vosstraat (north), Heer Halewijnstraat (east) and Erasmusgracht (south). en: The Walenweessluis (bridge 70) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. Sluis here means a stone bridge. The bridge forms the connection between Vijzelstraat and the filled-in Vijzelgracht. It is located over the Prinsengracht. The name Walenweessluis is a name derived from the Walenweeshuis, the orphanage for children from the French or Walloon church.

name: Walk of Fame
en: The Walk of Fame in Utrecht is located in Vinkenburgstraat in the center of Utrecht. The Walk of Fame consists of bronze plaques with hand and footprints of celebrities from the film world. name: Wasknijper
en: De Wasknijper (bridge 177) is a drawbridge in Amsterdam-Noord. The traffic bridge lies in the Distelweg and crosses the Buiksloterkanaal. It is the northernmost bridge over that canal.

name: Waterlinieweg
en: The Waterlinieweg is a road, partly uneven, in the east of the city of Utrecht. The road owes its name to its location parallel to the Lunetten on the Houtense Vlakte, part of the Nieuwe Hollandse Waterlinie.

name: Wederkomst des Herenkerk
en: The Wederkomst des Herenkerk is a Roman Catholic church building on Marco Pololaan in the Kanaleneiland district in the Dutch city of Utrecht. The church is dedicated to the Return of the Lord. The church is used by the Martinus parish.

name: Weenatunnel
en: The Weenatunnel is a traffic tunnel in the center of Rotterdam, part of the Weena. The underground passage is located between Stationsplein/Kruisplein in front of Rotterdam Central Station. The tunnel is 350 meters long, and is part of the city route S100 Centrumring.

name: Weerdpoort
en: The Weerdpoort, also known as Amsterdamse Poort, was one of the four city gates of the city of Utrecht from the Middle Ages. The gate was located on the north side of the current city center, where the Oudegracht, the Stadsbuitengracht and the Utrechtse Vecht meet and today lies the Weerdbrug.

name: Weesbrug
en: The Weesbrug (formerly also Reguliersbrug) is a nationally protected arched bridge in the Utrecht city center. The bridge spans the Oudegracht. The bridge can only be used by pedestrians and cyclists. In the abutments of the bridge are bridge basements.

name: Weesperbrug
en: The Weesperbrug is a fixed steel arch bridge over the Amsterdam-Rijnkanaal and forms part of the provincial road N236.

name: Weesperplein
en: The Weesperplein is a square in the center of Amsterdam, between the Singelgracht and the Nieuwe Achtergracht. It connects the Weesperstraat via the Weesperpoortbrug to the Rhijnspoorplein in the direction of the Wibautstraat and is part of the Amsterdam city route s112, which connects the Gooiseweg to the IJtunnel.

name: Weesperstraat
en: The Weesperstraat is a street in Amsterdam-Centrum. The original buildings were demolished in the 1960s, after which the street was widened into a city highway, which connects J.D. name: Weespertrekvaart
en: The Weespertrekvaart is a canal that connects the Amstel in Amsterdam with the Vecht in Weesp. name: Weg der Verenigde Naties
en: The Weg der Verenigde Naties or Southern Ring Road is part of the ring road around Groningen and also part of Rijksweg 7. The road is about twelve kilometers long and runs from the Hoogkerk district to the Euvelgunne district. The road is important for the traffic flows between the city and the rest of the Netherlands but also for the passing car traffic.

name: Welplaathaven
en: The Welplaathaven is a port in the Botlek area in Rotterdam. The port is named after the former island of the Welplaat, which was buried with the eastern part of the island of Rozenburg to form the Botlek industrial area.

name: Werk aan de Hoofddijk
en: Fort Hoofddijk was built in 1877-1879 east of Utrecht as part of the Nieuwe Hollandse Waterlinie. As a result of advances in artillery and explosives, the fort ring built around Utrecht in the 1820s had become outdated, and a new advanced ring of f was built in the 1870s.

name: Werkhaven
en: The Werkhaven is a port in the Rotterdam port area. The port is a branch of the Nieuwe Maas on the south side of the river and is located northwest of Heijplaat. To the southwest is the Eemhaven and to the east is the Heijsehaven. North of the Werkhaven is the Quarantine Station Heijplaat.

name: Werkspoorbrug
en: The Werkspoorbrug is a railway bridge over the Amsterdam-Rhine Canal in Utrecht. The bridge is a steel-concrete arch bridge and was put into use in 2002. The span is 237 meters, making it the railway bridge with the second longest span in the Netherlands (the longest is the Zandhazenbrug near Muiderberg).

name: Wertheimpark
en: The Wertheimpark is a city park in the Plantagebuurt in Amsterdam.

name: West Indian Warehouse
en: The West Indian Warehouse in Amsterdam dates back to 1642 and is located on the western part of Rapenburg, where the Oudeschans flows into the Oosterdok. It was originally owned by the West Indian Company (WIC). The letters GWC on the facade stand for the official name, 'Geoctroyeerde West-Indische Compagnie'. Currently it has the monument status.

name: West Singelsgracht
en: The Hague canal belt is the (partly 16th and especially early) 17th-century Singelsgracht that is still intact. A belt is ring-shaped, or circular, the Singelsgracht of The Hague has a different (angular) shape. That is not unique. Old Rotterdam had a triangular shape. A canal belt should not be confused with a system of interconnected waterways.

name: Westblaak
en: The Westblaak is a wide street in the center of Rotterdam. The Westblaak connects Churchillplein with Eendrachtsplein.

name: Westelijk Marktkanaal
en: The Westelijk Marktkanaal is a canal in Amsterdam-West. The name of the canal refers to the location of the canal relative to the Central Market Halls. The canal was put into use in 1934 for the opening and supply of the Central Market Halls. Today, most transport takes place by truck. Unlike the Kostv

name: Westelijke Zijhaven 1e Petroleumhaven
en: The Eerste Petroleumhaven - until April 21, 1942 called Petroleumhaven - is a pre-war harbor in Rotterdam-Pernis. The Eerste Petroleumhaven was dug between 1929 and 1933 and designed for the supply of crude oil for the refinery of Koninklijke Olie (Shell). Shell had started at the Sluisjesdijk in the Waalhaven area.

name: Westelijke Zijhaven 2e Petroleumhaven
en: The Tweede Petroleumhaven is a port in Rotterdam-Pernis. The Tweede Petroleumhaven was dug between 1938 and 1941 and designed for the transhipment of crude oil for the refinery of Koninklijke Olie (Shell). name: Westerdoksdijk
en: The Westerdokseiland is an island in Amsterdam between the Westerdok and the IJ. It was created in 1832 when the Westerdoksdam was built, separating this part of the IJ and therefore no longer experiencing tides in the IJ, which was still in open connection with the Zuiderzee until 1870.

name: Westerdoksdijkspoorbrug
en: The Spoorbrug Westerdokseiland (bridge no. 19S) is a former railway bridge in Amsterdam. It connected the tracks of Centraal Station with the goods yard then on Westerdokseiland.

name: Westerdoksluis
en: The Westerdoksluis is a bascule bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It crosses the connection between the Westerdok and the IJ, carrying the Stadsroute 100 between the Westerdokskade and De Ruijterkade on the south side and the Westerdoksdijk on Westerdokseiland to the north.

name: Westerdoksluis
en: The Westerdoksluis is a bascule bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum.

name: Westergasbrug
en: The Westergasbrug (bridge 193) is an iron lifting bridge in Amsterdam-West. The bridge is not exactly along the extension of Van Limburg Stirumstraat, on the other side of its intersection with the Haarlemmerweg. It spans the Haarlemmervaart and provides access to the grounds of the former Westergasfabriek, its namesake.

name: Westerkanaal
en: The Westerkanaal is a canal in Amsterdam that connects the Singelgracht and the Haarlemmertrekvaart to the IJ, where the ships on the north side of the canal first have to cross the Oude Houthaven. name: Westerkanaalschutsluis
en: The Westerkanaalschutsluis is a lock in the Westerkanaal, Amsterdam-West. They are located between both Houtmankades.
